# SLSTR VIS/SWIR Bands (S1–S6)\n\nSentin.msgid:
# SLSTR VIS/SWIR Bands (S1–S6)

Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) captures Top-of-Atmosphere radiances in six solar reflective channels at 500 m resolution: S1 (0.555 µm, vegetation/aerosol), S2 (0.659 µm, NDVI/aerosol), S3 (0.865 µm, NDVI/cloud flagging), S4 (1.375 µm, cirrus detection), S5 (1.61 µm, ice/snow/vegetation), and S6 (2.25 µm, vegetation state). Each band is available in nadir and oblique views, enabling dual-angle observation of land and ocean surfaces. The L1B product contains geolocated, calibrated radiances produced by signal calibration, re-gridding, and cloud flagging.



More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).
msgstr:
# Bandi SLSTR VIS/SWIR (S1–S6)

Is-Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) jaqbad ir-radjanzi tas-Top-of-Atmosphere fi sitt kanali riflettivi solari b’riżoluzzjoni ta’ 500 m: S1 (0.555 µm, veġetazzjoni/aerosol), S2 (0.659 µm, NDVI/aerosol), S3 (0.865 µm, NDVI/immarkar tas-sħab), S4 (1.375 µm, detezzjoni taċ-ċirrus), S5 (1.61 µm, silġ/borra/veġetazzjoni), u S6 (2.25 µm, stat tal-veġetazzjoni). Kull band hija disponibbli f’veduti nadir u oblikwi, u dan jippermetti osservazzjoni b’żewġ angoli tal-wċuh tal-art u tal-oċean. Il-prodott L1B fih radjanzi ġeolokalizzati u kalibrati prodotti permezz ta’ kalibrazzjoni tas-sinjal, re-gridding, u l-immarkar tas-sħab.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).

# SLSTR Thermal Infrared Bands (S7–S9)\n.msgid:
# SLSTR Thermal Infrared Bands (S7–S9)

Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) captures Top-of-Atmosphere brightness temperatures in three thermal infrared channels at 1 km resolution: S7 (3.74 µm, sea/land surface temperature and fire detection), S8 (10.85 µm, sea/land surface temperature and fire detection), and S9 (12.0 µm, sea/land surface temperature). Each band is available in nadir and oblique views, enabling dual-angle observation for improved atmospheric correction and surface temperature retrieval. The L1B product contains geolocated, calibrated brightness temperatures produced by signal calibration, re-gridding, and cloud flagging.



More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).
msgstr:
# Bandi SLSTR infra-ħomor termali (S7–S9)

Is-Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) jaqbad it-temperaturi tal-luminożità tas-Top-of-Atmosphere fi tliet kanali infra-ħomor termali b’riżoluzzjoni ta’ 1 km: S7 (3.74 µm, temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-baħar/art u detezzjoni tan-nar), S8 (10.85 µm, temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-baħar/art u detezzjoni tan-nar), u S9 (12.0 µm, temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-baħar/art). Kull band hija disponibbli f’veduti nadir u oblikwi, u dan jippermetti osservazzjoni b’żewġ angoli għal korrezzjoni atmosferika mtejba u rkupru tat-temperatura tal-wiċċ. Il-prodott L1B fih temperaturi tal-luminożità ġeolokalizzati u kalibrati prodotti permezz ta’ kalibrazzjoni tas-sinjal, re-gridding, u l-immarkar tas-sħab.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).

# Thermal IR fire emission bands\n\nSent.msgid:
# Thermal IR fire emission bands

Sentinel-3 Sea and Land Surface Temperature Instrument (SLSTR) has two dedicated channels (F1 and F2) that aim to detect Land Surface Temperature (LST). F2 Channel, with a central wavelength of 10854 nm measures in the thermal infrared, or TIR. It is very useful for fire and high temperature event monitoring at 1 km resolution.



More info [here.](https://sentinel.esa.int/web/sentinel/user-guides/sentinel-3-slstr/overview/geophysical-measurements/land-surface-temperature)
msgstr:
# Bandi tal-emissjoni tan-nar fl-IR termali

L-Istrument tat-Temperatura tal-Wiċċ tal-Baħar u tal-Art tas-Sentinel-3 (SLSTR) għandu żewġ kanali dedikati (F1 u F2) bil-għan li jidentifikaw it-Temperatura tal-Wiċċ tal-Art (LST). Il-Kanal F2, b’tul tal-mewġ ċentrali ta’ 10854 nm, ikejjel fl-infra-aħmar termali, jew TIR. Huwa utli ħafna għall-monitoraġġ tan-nar u ta’ avvenimenti ta’ temperatura għolja b’riżoluzzjoni ta’ 1 km.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://sentinel.esa.int/web/sentinel/user-guides/sentinel-3-slstr/overview/geophysical-measurements/land-surface-temperature)

# Cloud base height\n\nHeight of cloud b.msgid:
# Cloud base height

Height of cloud base measured in meters (m).

# Għoli tal-bażi tas-sħab

L-għoli tal-bażi tas-sħab imkejjel f’metri (m).

# Cloud base pressure\n\nPressure measur.msgid:
# Cloud base pressure

Pressure measured at cloud base in Pascal (Pa).
msgstr:
# Pressjoni tal-bażi tas-sħab

# Effective radiometric cloud fraction\n.msgid:
# Effective radiometric cloud fraction

Effective radiometric cloud fraction represents the portion of the Earth's surface covered by clouds, divided by the total surface. Clouds have shielding, albedo, and in-cloud absorption effects on trace gas retrieval. The effective radiometric cloud fraction is an important parameter to correct these effects.
msgstr:
# Frazzjoni radjometrika effettiva tas-sħab

Il-frazzjoni radjometrika effettiva tas-sħab tirrappreżenta l-porzjon tal-wiċċ tad-Dinja kopert mis-sħab, diviż bil-wiċċ totali. Is-sħab għandhom effetti ta’ tħarsien, albedo, u assorbiment ġewwa s-sħab fuq l-irkupru tal-gassijiet traċċa. Il-frazzjoni radjometrika effettiva tas-sħab hija parametru importanti biex jiġu kkorreġuti dawn l-effetti.

# Cloud optical thickness\n\nThe cloud t.msgid:
# Cloud optical thickness

The cloud thickness is a key parameter to characterise optical properties of clouds. It is a measure of how much sunlight passes through the cloud to reach Earth's surface. The higher a cloud's optical thickness, the more sunlight the cloud is scattering and reflecting. Dark blue shows where there are low cloud optical thickness values and red shows larger cloud optical thickness.
msgstr:
# Ħxuna ottika tas-sħab

L-ħxuna tas-sħab hija parametru ewlieni biex jiġu karatterizzati l-proprjetajiet ottiċi tas-sħab. Hija miżura ta’ kemm id-dawl tax-xemx jgħaddi mis-sħaba biex jilħaq il-wiċċ tad-Dinja. Iktar ma tkun għolja l-ħxuna ottika tas-sħaba, iktar id-dawl tax-xemx li s-sħaba txerred u tirrifletti. Il-blu skur juri fejn hemm valuri baxxi ta’ ħxuna ottika tas-sħab u l-aħmar juri ħxuna ottika akbar tas-sħab.

# Cloud top height\n\nHeight of cloud to.msgid:
# Cloud top height

Height of cloud top measured in meters (m).

# Għoli ta’ fuq is-sħab

L-għoli ta’ fuq is-sħab imkejjel f’metri (m).

# Cloud top pressure\n\nPressure measure.msgid:
# Cloud top pressure

# Thermal band 10\n\nThis thermal visual.msgid:
# Thermal band 10

This thermal visualization is based on band 10 (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). At the central wavelength of 10895 nm it measures in the thermal infrared, or TIR. Instead of measuring the temperature of the air, like weather stations do, band 10 reports on the ground itself, which is often much hotter. Thermal band 10 is useful in providing surface temperatures and is collected with a 100-meter resolution.



More info [here](https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/what-are-band-designations-landsat-satellites?qt-news_science_products=0#qt-news_science_products).
msgstr:
# Band termali 10

Din il-viżwalizzazzjoni termali hija bbażata fuq il-band 10 (band hija reġjun tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku; sensor tas-satellita jista’ jieħu immaġini tad-Dinja f’bandi differenti). Fit-tul tal-mewġ ċentrali ta’ 10895 nm ikejjel fl-infra-aħmar termali, jew TIR. Minflok ma jkejjel it-temperatura tal-arja, bħalma jagħmlu l-istazzjonijiet tat-temp, il-band 10 tirrapporta dwar l-art innifisha, li ħafna drabi tkun ferm aktar sħuna. Il-band termali 10 hija utli biex tipprovdi temperaturi tal-wiċċ u tinġabar b’riżoluzzjoni ta’ 100 metru.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/what-are-band-designations-landsat-satellites?qt-news_science_products=0#qt-news_science_products).

# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)

The normalized difference vegetation index is a simple, but effective index for quantifying green vegetation. It is a measure of the state of vegetation health based on how plants reflect light at certain wavelengths. The value range of the NDVI is -1 to 1. Negative values of NDVI (values approaching -1) correspond to water. Values close to zero (-0.1to 0.1) generally correspond to barren areas of rock, sand, or snow. Low, positive values represent shrub and grassland (approximately 0.2 to 0.4), while high values indicate temperate and tropical rainforests (values approaching 1).

More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndvi/).
msgstr:
# Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Veġetazzjoni (NDVI)

L-indiċi tad-differenza normalizzata tal-veġetazzjoni huwa indiċi sempliċi, iżda effettiv, għall-kwantifikazzjoni tal-veġetazzjoni ħadra. Huwa miżura tal-istat tas-saħħa tal-veġetazzjoni bbażata fuq kif il-pjanti jirriflettu d-dawl f’ċerti tuli tal-mewġ. Il-firxa tal-valuri tal-NDVI hija minn -1 sa 1. Valuri negattivi tal-NDVI (valuri qrib -1) jikkorrispondu għall-ilma. Valuri qrib iż-żero (-0.1 sa 0.1) ġeneralment jikkorrispondu għal żoni sterili ta’ blat, ramel, jew borra. Valuri baxxi, pożittivi jirrappreżentaw arbuxelli u mergħat (madwar 0.2 sa 0.4), filwaqt li valuri għoljin jindikaw foresti tropikali u temperati (valuri qrib 1).

Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndvi/).

# Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI)\n\nThe.msgid:
# Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI)

The enhanced vegetation index (EVI) is an 'optimized' vegetation index as it corrects for soil background signals and atmospheric influences. It is very useful in areas of dense canopy cover. The range of values for EVI is -1 to 1, with healthy vegetation generally around 0.20 to 0.80.





More infos [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/evi/) and [here.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enhanced_vegetation_index)
msgstr:
# Indiċi tal-Veġetazzjoni Mtejjeb (EVI)

L-indiċi tal-veġetazzjoni mtejjeb (EVI) huwa indiċi tal-veġetazzjoni “ottimizzat” peress li jikkoreġi għas-sinjali tal-isfond tal-ħamrija u għall-influwenzi atmosferiċi. Huwa utli ħafna f’żoni b’kopertura densa tal-kanupew. Il-firxa tal-valuri tal-EVI hija minn -1 sa 1, b’veġetazzjoni f’saħħitha ġeneralment madwar 0.20 sa 0.80.





Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/evi/) u [hawnhekk.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enhanced_vegetation_index)

# Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation I.msgid:
# Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index (ARVI)

The Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index (ARVI) is a vegetation index that minimizes the effects of atmospheric scattering. It is most useful for regions with high content of atmospheric aerosol (fog, dust, smoke, air pollution). The range for an ARVI is -1 to 1 where green vegetation generally falls between values of 0.20 to 0.80.





More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/arvi/) and [here.](https://eos.com/blog/6-spectral-indexes-on-top-of-ndvi-to-make-your-vegetation-analysis-complete/)
msgstr:
# Indiċi tal-Veġetazzjoni Reżistenti għall-Atmosfera (ARVI)

L-Indiċi tal-Veġetazzjoni Reżistenti għall-Atmosfera (ARVI) huwa indiċi tal-veġetazzjoni li jimminimizza l-effetti tat-tixrid atmosferiku. Huwa l-aktar utli għal reġjuni b’kontenut għoli ta’ aerosol atmosferiku (ċpar, trab, duħħan, tniġġis tal-arja). Il-firxa għal ARVI hija minn -1 sa 1 fejn il-veġetazzjoni ħadra ġeneralment taqa’ bejn valuri ta’ 0.20 sa 0.80.





Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/arvi/) u [hawnhekk.](https://eos.com/blog/6-spectral-indexes-on-top-of-ndvi-to-make-your-vegetation-analysis-complete/)

# Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index (SAVI)\.msgid:
# Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index (SAVI)

The Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index is similar to Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) but is used in areas where vegetative cover is low (< 40%). The index is a transformation technique that minimizes soil brightness influences from spectral vegetation indices involving red and near-infrared (NIR) wavelengths. The index is helpful when analysing young crops, arid regions with sparse vegetation and exposed soil surfaces.





More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/savi/) and [here.](https://eos.com/blog/6-spectral-indexes-on-top-of-ndvi-to-make-your-vegetation-analysis-complete/)
msgstr:
# Indiċi tal-Veġetazzjoni Aġġustat għall-Ħamrija (SAVI)

L-Indiċi tal-Veġetazzjoni Aġġustat għall-Ħamrija huwa simili għall-Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Veġetazzjoni (NDVI) iżda jintuża f’żoni fejn il-kopertura veġetattiva hija baxxa (< 40%). L-indiċi huwa teknika ta’ trasformazzjoni li timminimizza l-influwenzi tal-luminożità tal-ħamrija mill-indiċijiet spettrali tal-veġetazzjoni li jinvolvu tuli tal-mewġ aħmar u infra-ħomor qrib (NIR). L-indiċi huwa ta’ għajnuna meta jiġu analizzati uċuh żgħar, reġjuni aridi b’veġetazzjoni skarsa u uċuh tal-ħamrija esposti.





Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/savi/) u [hawnhekk.](https://eos.com/blog/6-spectral-indexes-on-top-of-ndvi-to-make-your-vegetation-analysis-complete/)

# Modified Anthocyanin Reflectance Index.msgid:
# Modified Anthocyanin Reflectance Index (mARI/ARI2)

Anthocyanins are pigments common in higher plants, causing their red, blue and purple coloration. They provide valuable information about the physiological status of plants, as they are considered indicators of various types of plant stresses. The reflectance of anthocyanin is highest around 550nm. However, the same wavelengths are reflected by chlorophyll as well. To isolate the anthocyanins, the 700nm spectral band, that reflects only chlorophyll and not anthocyanins, is subtracted.

To correct for leaf density and thickness, the near infrared spectral band (in the recommended wavelengths of 760-800nm), which is related to leaf scattering, is added to the basic ARI index. The new index is called modified ARI or mARI (also ARI2).

mARI values for the examined trees in [this original article](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/mari/) ranged in values from 0 to 8.





More info [here.](https://digitalcommons.unl.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1227&context=natrespapers)
msgstr:
# Indiċi Modifikat tar-Riflettanza tal-Antoċjanini (mARI/ARI2)

L-antoċjanini huma pigmenti komuni fil-pjanti ogħla, li jikkawżaw il-kulur aħmar, blu u vjola tagħhom. Jipprovdu informazzjoni siewja dwar l-istat fiżjoloġiku tal-pjanti, peress li huma kkunsidrati indikaturi ta’ tipi differenti ta’ stress tal-pjanti. Ir-riflettanza tal-antoċjanini hija l-ogħla madwar 550nm. Madankollu, l-istess tuli tal-mewġ jiġu rriflessi wkoll mill-klorofilla. Biex jiġu iżolati l-antoċjanini, il-band spettrali ta’ 700nm, li tirrifletti l-klorofilla biss u mhux l-antoċjanini, titnaqqas.

Biex tiġi kkorreġuta d-densità u l-ħxuna tal-weraq, il-band spettrali infra-ħamra qrib (fit-tuli tal-mewġ rakkomandati ta’ 760-800nm), li hija relatata mat-tixrid tal-weraq, tiżdied mal-indiċi bażiku ARI. L-indiċi l-ġdid jissejjaħ ARI modifikat jew mARI (ukoll ARI2).

Il-valuri mARI għas-siġar eżaminati f’[dan l-artikolu oriġinali](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/mari/) varjaw minn 0 sa 8.





Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://digitalcommons.unl.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1227&context=natrespapers)

# Green City Script\n\nThe Green city sc.msgid:
# Green City Script

The Green city script aims to raise awareness of green areas in cities around the world. The script takes into account the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and true color wavelengths; it separates built up areas from vegetated ones, making it useful for detecting urban areas. Built up areas are displayed in grey and vegetation is displayed in green.





More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/green_city/)
msgstr:
# Skript Green City

L-iskript Green city għandu l-għan li jqajjem kuxjenza dwar iż-żoni ħodor fil-bliet madwar id-dinja. L-iskript jieħu in kunsiderazzjoni l-Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Veġetazzjoni (NDVI) u t-tuli tal-mewġ tal-kulur veru; jifred iż-żoni mibnija minn dawk veġetati, u dan jagħmlu utli għad-detezzjoni taż-żoni urbani. Iż-żoni mibnija jintwerew bil-griż u l-veġetazzjoni tintwera bl-aħdar.





Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/green_city/)

# Urban Classified Script\n\nThe Urban C.msgid:
# Urban Classified Script

The Urban Classified script aims to detect built up areas by separating them from barren ground, vegetation and water. Areas with a high moisture content are returned in blue; areas indicating built up areas are returned in white; vegetated areas are returned in green; everything else indicates barren ground and is displayed in brown colors.





More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/urban_classified/)
msgstr:
# Skript Urban Classified

L-iskript Urban Classified għandu l-għan li jidentifika ż-żoni mibnija billi jifridhom mill-art sterili, mill-veġetazzjoni u mill-ilma. Iż-żoni b’kontenut għoli ta’ umdità jingħataw lura bil-blu; iż-żoni li jindikaw żoni mibnija jingħataw lura bl-abjad; iż-żoni veġetati jingħataw lura bl-aħdar; kull ħaġa oħra tindika art sterili u tintwera f’kuluri kannella.





Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/urban_classified/)

# Urban Land Infrared Color Script\n\nTh.msgid:
# Urban Land Infrared Color Script

This script, made by Leo Tolari, combines true color visualization with near infrared (NIR) and shortwave infrared (SWIR) wavelengths. The script highlights urban areas better than true color, while still looking natural.





More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/urban_land_infrared/)
msgstr:
# Skript tal-Kulur Infra-aħmar tal-Art Urbana

Dan l-iskript, magħmul minn Leo Tolari, jgħaqqad il-viżwalizzazzjoni tal-kulur veru mat-tuli tal-mewġ infra-ħomor qrib (NIR) u infra-ħomor tal-mewġ qasir (SWIR). L-iskript jenfasizza ż-żoni urbani aħjar mill-kulur veru, filwaqt li xorta jidher naturali.





Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/urban_land_infrared/)

# NDMI for Moisture Stress\n\nThe Normal.msgid:
# NDMI for Moisture Stress

The Normalized Difference Moisture Index (NDMI) for moisture stress can be used to detect irrigation. For all the index values above 0, knowing the land use and land cover, it is possible to determine whether irrigation has taken place. Knowing the type of crop grown (e.g. citrus crops), it is possible to identify whether irrigation is being effective or not during the crucial growing summer season, as well as find out if some parts of the farm are being under or over-irrigated.





More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndmi_special/#)
msgstr:
# NDMI għall-Istress tal-Umdità

L-Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Umdità (NDMI) għall-istress tal-umdità jista’ jintuża biex jiġi identifikat l-irrigazzjoni. Għall-valuri kollha tal-indiċi ’l fuq minn 0, meta jkunu magħrufa l-użu tal-art u l-kopertura tal-art, huwa possibbli li jiġi determinat jekk seħħitx irrigazzjoni. Meta jkun magħruf it-tip ta’ għalla li titkabbar (eż. iċ-ċitru), huwa possibbli li jiġi identifikat jekk l-irrigazzjoni hijiex effettiva jew le matul l-istaġun kruċjali tas-sajf tat-tkabbir, kif ukoll jiġi stabbilit jekk xi partijiet tal-azjenda jkunux qed jiġu irrigati b’mod insuffiċjenti jew żejjed.





Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndmi_special/#)

# Normalized Difference Moisture Index (.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Moisture Index (NDMI)

The normalized difference moisture Index (NDMI) is used to determine vegetation water content and monitor droughts. The value range of the NDMI is -1 to 1. Negative values of NDMI (values approaching -1) correspond to barren soil. Values around zero (-0.2 to 0.4) generally correspond to water stress. High, positive values represent high canopy without water stress (approximately 0.4 to 1).



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndmi/)
msgstr:
# Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Umdità (NDMI)

L-indiċi tad-differenza normalizzata tal-umdità (NDMI) jintuża biex jiġi determinat il-kontenut tal-ilma tal-veġetazzjoni u biex jiġu mmonitorjati n-nixfiet. Il-firxa tal-valuri tal-NDMI hija minn -1 sa 1. Valuri negattivi tal-NDMI (valuri qrib -1) jikkorrispondu għal ħamrija sterili. Valuri madwar iż-żero (-0.2 sa 0.4) ġeneralment jikkorrispondu għal stress tal-ilma. Valuri għoljin u pożittivi jirrappreżentaw kanupew għoli mingħajr stress tal-ilma (madwar 0.4 sa 1).



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndmi/)

# Normalized Difference Water Index (NDW.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI)

The normalized difference water index is most appropriate for water body mapping. Values of water bodies are larger than 0.5. Vegetation has smaller values. Built-up features have positive values between zero and 0.2.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndwi/)
msgstr:
# Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Ilma (NDWI)

L-indiċi tad-differenza normalizzata tal-ilma huwa l-aktar xieraq għall-immappjar ta’ korpi tal-ilma. Il-valuri tal-korpi tal-ilma huma akbar minn 0.5. Il-veġetazzjoni għandha valuri iżgħar. Karatteristiċi mibnija għandhom valuri pożittivi bejn żero u 0.2.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndwi/)

# False color composite\n\nA false color.msgid:
# False color composite

A false color composite uses at least one non-visible wavelength to image Earth. The false color composite using near infrared, red and green bands is very popular (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). The false colour composite is most commonly used to assess plant density and health, since plants reflect near infrared and green light, while they absorb red. Cities and exposed ground are grey or tan, and water appears blue or black.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false_color_infrared/) and [here.](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites)
msgstr:
# Kompożitu tal-kulur falz

Kompożitu tal-kulur falz juża mill-inqas tul tal-mewġ wieħed mhux viżibbli biex jieħu immaġni tad-Dinja. Il-kompożitu tal-kulur falz li juża l-bandi infra-ħomor qrib, aħmar u aħdar huwa popolari ħafna (band hija reġjun tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku; sensor tas-satellita jista’ jieħu immaġini tad-Dinja f’bandi differenti). Il-kompożitu tal-kulur falz huwa l-aktar użat komunement biex tiġi vvalutata d-densità u s-saħħa tal-pjanti, peress li l-pjanti jirriflettu d-dawl infra-aħmar qrib u aħdar, filwaqt li jassorbu l-aħmar. Il-bliet u l-art esposta huma griżi jew kannella ċar, u l-ilma jidher blu jew iswed.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false_color_infrared/) u [hawnhekk.](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites)

# True color optimized\n\nThis optimized.msgid:
# True color optimized

This optimized True color script uses the visible light bands red, green and blue in the corresponding red, green and blue color channels, resulting in a product with natural colours that represents the Earth as humans would naturally see it. The visualisation uses highlight compression and improves the contrast and color vividness through minor contrast and saturation enhancement.



More info for [L1C](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/l1c_optimized/) and for [L2A](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/l2a_optimized/).
msgstr:
# Kulur veru ottimizzat

Dan l-iskript ottimizzat tal-Kulur veru juża l-bandi tad-dawl viżibbli aħmar, aħdar u blu fil-kanali tal-kulur korrispondenti aħmar, aħdar u blu, u jirriżulta fi prodott b’kuluri naturali li jirrappreżenta d-Dinja kif il-bnedmin naturalment jarawha. Il-viżwalizzazzjoni tuża kompressjoni tal-highlights u ttejjeb il-kontrast u l-vividezza tal-kulur permezz ta’ titjib żgħir tal-kontrast u tas-saturazzjoni.



Aktar info għal [L1C](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/l1c_optimized/) u għal [L2A](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/l2a_optimized/).

# True color composite\n\nSensors carrie.msgid:
# True color composite

Sensors carried by satellites can image Earth in different regions of the electromagnetic spectrum. Each region in the spectrum is referred to as a band. Landsat 8-9 has 11 bands. True color composite uses visible light bands red, green and blue in the corresponding red, green and blue color channels, resulting in a natural colored product, that is a good representation of the Earth as humans would see it naturally.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/landsat-8/composites/).
msgstr:
# Kompożitu tal-kulur veru

Sensors li jinġarru mis-satelliti jistgħu jieħdu immaġini tad-Dinja f’reġjuni differenti tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku. Kull reġjun fl-ispettru jissejjaħ band. Landsat 8-9 għandu 11-il band. Il-kompożitu tal-kulur veru juża l-bandi tad-dawl viżibbli aħmar, aħdar u blu fil-kanali tal-kulur korrispondenti aħmar, aħdar u blu, u jirriżulta fi prodott bil-kuluri naturali, li huwa rappreżentazzjoni tajba tad-Dinja kif il-bnedmin naturalment jarawha.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/landsat-8/composites/).

# Tristimulus\n\nThe colours of natural.msgid:
# Tristimulus

The colours of natural waters differ markedly across the globe, depending on water composition and illumination conditions. Ocean colour instruments measure water-leaving radiance in narrow spectral bands to retrieve water-quality indicators. The true colour of natural waters is derived by calculating tristimulus values — the three primaries (X, Y, Z) that specify a colour stimulus as perceived by the human eye.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/tristimulus/).
msgstr:
# Tristimulus

Il-kuluri tal-ilmijiet naturali jvarjaw b’mod notevoli madwar id-dinja, skont il-kompożizzjoni tal-ilma u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-illuminazzjoni. L-istrumenti tal-kulur tal-oċean ikejlu r-radjanza li titlaq mill-ilma f’bandi spettrali dojoq biex jinkisbu indikaturi tal-kwalità tal-ilma. Il-kulur veru tal-ilmijiet naturali jinkiseb billi jiġu kkalkulati l-valuri tristimulus — it-tliet primarji (X, Y, Z) li jispeċifikaw stimolu tal-kulur kif jinftiehem mill-għajn tal-bniedem.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/tristimulus/).

# RGB (B17, B05, B02)\n\nThis false colo.msgid:
# RGB (B17, B05, B02)

This false color composite maps Sentinel-3 OLCI bands B17 (865 nm, near-infrared), B05 (510 nm, cyan-green), and B02 (412.5 nm, violet) into the red, green, and blue display channels respectively. B17 is a near-infrared band used for aerosol and atmospheric correction; placing it in the red channel makes vegetation and land surfaces appear bright red while water remains dark. B05 is sensitive to chlorophyll, sediment, turbidity, and red tide, and B02 captures yellow dissolved organic matter (CDOM) and detrital pigments. The composite is useful for ocean colour analysis, coastal water quality monitoring, and distinguishing turbid or sediment-laden waters from clear ocean.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).
msgstr:
# RGB (B17, B05, B02)

Dan il-kompożitu tal-kulur falz jimmappja l-bandi Sentinel-3 OLCI B17 (865 nm, infra-aħmar qrib), B05 (510 nm, ċjan-aħdar), u B02 (412.5 nm, vjola) fil-kanali tal-wiri aħmar, aħdar, u blu rispettivament. B17 hija band infra-ħamra qrib użata għall-korrezzjoni tal-aerosol u atmosferika; li tpoġġiha fil-kanal aħmar tagħmel il-veġetazzjoni u l-uċuh tal-art jidhru aħmar jgħajjat filwaqt li l-ilma jibqa’ skur. B05 hija sensittiva għall-klorofilla, is-sediment, it-torbidità, u l-marea ħamra, u B02 taqbad is-sustanza organika maħlula safra (CDOM) u l-pigmenti detritali. Il-kompożitu huwa utli għall-analiżi tal-kulur tal-oċean, il-monitoraġġ tal-kwalità tal-ilma kostali, u biex jiġu distinti ilmijiet imdardra jew mgħobbija bis-sediment mill-oċean ċar.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).

# RGB (B17, B06, B03)\n\nThis false colo.msgid:
# RGB (B17, B06, B03)

This false color composite maps Sentinel-3 OLCI bands B17 (865 nm, near-infrared), B06 (560 nm, green), and B03 (442.5 nm, blue) into the red, green, and blue display channels respectively. B17 is a near-infrared band used for aerosol and atmospheric correction; placing it in the red channel makes vegetation and land surfaces appear bright red while water remains dark. B06 is the chlorophyll absorption minimum reference band, and B03 captures chlorophyll absorption and biogeochemical properties. Compared to the B17/B05/B02 composite, the shifted green and blue channels offer a different sensitivity to phytoplankton and dissolved organic matter in coastal and open ocean waters.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).
msgstr:
# RGB (B17, B06, B03)

Dan il-kompożitu tal-kulur falz jimmappja l-bandi Sentinel-3 OLCI B17 (865 nm, infra-aħmar qrib), B06 (560 nm, aħdar), u B03 (442.5 nm, blu) fil-kanali tal-wiri aħmar, aħdar, u blu rispettivament. B17 hija band infra-ħamra qrib użata għall-korrezzjoni tal-aerosol u atmosferika; li tpoġġiha fil-kanal aħmar tagħmel il-veġetazzjoni u l-uċuh tal-art jidhru aħmar jgħajjat filwaqt li l-ilma jibqa’ skur. B06 hija l-band ta’ referenza tal-minimu tal-assorbiment tal-klorofilla, u B03 taqbad l-assorbiment tal-klorofilla u l-proprjetajiet bijoġeokimiċi. Meta mqabbel mal-kompożitu B17/B05/B02, il-kanali aħdar u blu mċaqalqa joffru sensittività differenti għall-fitoplankton u s-sustanza organika maħlula fl-ilmijiet kostali u tal-oċean miftuħ.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).

# Enhanced True Color Visualization\n\nT.msgid:
# Enhanced True Color Visualization

This script uses highlight optimization to avoid burnt out pixels and to even out the exposure. It makes clouds look natural and keep as much visual information as possible. Sentinel-3 OLCI tiles cover large areas, making it possible to observe large cloud formations, such as hurricanes.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/true_color_highlight_optimized/)
msgstr:
# Viżwalizzazzjoni mtejba tal-kulur veru

Dan l-iskript juża ottimizzazzjoni tal-highlights biex jevita pikseli maħruqin u biex jagħmel l-espożizzjoni uniformi. Jagħmel is-sħab jidher naturali u jżomm kemm jista’ jkun informazzjoni viżiva. It-tiles tas-Sentinel-3 OLCI ikopru żoni kbar, u dan jagħmilha possibbli li jiġu osservati formazzjonijiet kbar tas-sħab, bħall-uragani.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/true_color_highlight_optimized/)

# Pansharpened True Color\n\nThe panshar.msgid:
# Pansharpened True Color

The pansharpened true color composite is done by using the usual true color data (red, green and blue (RGB)) and enhancing them by using the panchromatic band 8, or pan band (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). An image from the pan band is similar to black-and-white film: it combines light from the red, green, and blue parts of the spectrum into a single measure of overall visible reflectance. Pansharpened images have 4x the resolution of the usual true color composite, greatly enhancing the usefulness of Landsat imagery.



More info [here](https://blog.mapbox.com/pansharpening-for-higher-resolution-in-landsat-live-e4717cd7c356).
msgstr:
# Kulur veru pansharpened

Il-kompożitu tal-kulur veru pansharpened isir bl-użu tad-data tas-soltu tal-kulur veru (aħmar, aħdar u blu (RGB)) u titjibha bl-użu tal-band pankromatika 8, jew band pan (band hija reġjun tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku; sensor tas-satellita jista’ jieħu immaġini tad-Dinja f’bandi differenti). Immaġni mill-band pan hija simili għal film abjad u iswed: tgħaqqad id-dawl mill-partijiet aħmar, aħdar u blu tal-ispettru f’miżura waħda tar-riflettanza viżibbli ġenerali. L-immaġini pansharpened għandhom 4 darbiet ir-riżoluzzjoni tal-kompożitu tas-soltu tal-kulur veru, u dan itejjeb ħafna l-utilità tal-immaġini Landsat.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://blog.mapbox.com/pansharpening-for-higher-resolution-in-landsat-live-e4717cd7c356).

# False Color Urban composite\n\nThis co.msgid:
# False Color Urban composite

This composite is used to visualise urbanized areas more clearly. Vegetation is visible in shades of green, while urbanized areas are represented by white, grey, or purple. Soils, sand, and minerals are shown in a variety of colors. Snow and ice appear as dark blue, and water as black or blue. Flooded areas are very dark blue and almost black. The composite is useful for detecting wildfires and calderas of volcanoes, as they are displayed in shades of red and yellow.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false-color-urban-rgb/) and [here.](https://eos.com/false-color/)
msgstr:
# Kompożitu tal-kulur falz urban

Dan il-kompożitu jintuża biex jiġu viżwalizzati b’mod aktar ċar iż-żoni urbanizzati. Il-veġetazzjoni hija viżibbli f’sfumaturi ta’ aħdar, filwaqt li ż-żoni urbanizzati huma rappreżentati bl-abjad, griż, jew vjola. Il-ħamrija, ir-ramel, u l-minerali jintwerew f’varjetà ta’ kuluri. Il-borra u s-silġ jidhru blu skur, u l-ilma iswed jew blu. Iż-żoni mgħarrqa huma blu skur ħafna u kważi suwed. Il-kompożitu huwa utli għad-detezzjoni ta’ nirien tal-foresti u kalderi tal-vulkani, peress li jintwerew f’sfumaturi ta’ aħmar u isfar.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false-color-urban-rgb/) u [hawnhekk.](https://eos.com/false-color/)

# Agriculture composite\n\nThis composit.msgid:
# Agriculture composite

This composite uses short-wave infrared, near-infrared and blue bands to monitor crop health (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). Both short-wave and near infrared bands are particularly good at highlighting dense vegetation, which appears dark green in the composite. Crops appear in a vibrant green and bare earth appears magenta.



More info [here](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites) and [here.](https://gisgeography.com/sentinel-2-bands-combinations/)
msgstr:
# Kompożitu tal-agrikoltura

Dan il-kompożitu juża l-bandi infra-ħomor tal-mewġ qasir, infra-ħomor qrib u blu biex jimmonitorja s-saħħa tal-uċuh tar-raba’ (band hija reġjun tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku; sensor tas-satellita jista’ jieħu immaġini tad-Dinja f’bandi differenti). Kemm il-bandi tal-mewġ qasir kif ukoll dawk infra-ħomor qrib huma partikolarment tajbin biex jenfasizzaw veġetazzjoni densa, li tidher aħdar skur fil-kompożitu. L-uċuh tar-raba’ jidhru f’aħdar ħaj u l-art mikxufa tidher manġenta.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites) u [hawnhekk.](https://gisgeography.com/sentinel-2-bands-combinations/)

# Snow Classifier\n\nThe Snow Classifier.msgid:
# Snow Classifier

The Snow Classifier algorithm aims to detect snow by classifying pixels based on different brightness and Normalized Difference Snow Index (NDSI) thresholds. Values classified as snow are returned in bright vivid blue. The script can overestimate snow areas over clouds.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/snow_classifier/)
msgstr:
# Klassifikatur tal-borra

L-algoritmu Snow Classifier għandu l-għan li jidentifika l-borra billi jikklassifika l-pikseli abbażi ta’ limiti differenti ta’ luminożità u tal-Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Borra (NDSI). Il-valuri kklassifikati bħala borra jingħataw lura b’blu qawwi u ċar. L-iskript jista’ jipprevedi żżejjed iż-żoni tal-borra fuq is-sħab.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/snow_classifier/)

# Ulyssys Water Quality Viewer (UWQV)\n\.msgid:
# Ulyssys Water Quality Viewer (UWQV)

The script aims to dynamically visualise the chlorophyll and sediment conditions of water bodies, which are primary indicators of water quality. The chlorophyll content ranges in colors from dark blue (low chlorophyll content) through green to red (high chlorophyll content). Sediment concentrations are colored brown; opaque brown indicates high sediment content.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ulyssys_water_quality_viewer/)
msgstr:
# Ulyssys Water Quality Viewer (UWQV)

L-iskript għandu l-għan li jviżwalizza b’mod dinamiku l-kundizzjonijiet tal-klorofilla u tas-sediment tal-korpi tal-ilma, li huma indikaturi primarji tal-kwalità tal-ilma. Il-kontenut tal-klorofilla jvarja fil-kuluri minn blu skur (kontenut baxx ta’ klorofilla) permezz tal-aħdar sal-aħmar (kontenut għoli ta’ klorofilla). Il-konċentrazzjonijiet tas-sediment huma kkuluriti bil-kannella; kannella opak jindika kontenut għoli ta’ sediment.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ulyssys_water_quality_viewer/)

# Short wave infrared composite (SWIR)\n.msgid:
# Short wave infrared composite (SWIR)

Short wave infrared (SWIR) measurements can help scientists estimate how much water is present in plants and soil, as water absorbs SWIR wavelengths. Short wave infrared bands (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands) are also useful for distinguishing between cloud types (water clouds versus ice clouds), snow and ice, all of which appear white in visible light. In this composite vegetation appears in shades of green, soils and built-up areas are in various shades of brown, and water appears black. Newly burned land reflects strongly in SWIR bands, making them valuable for mapping fire damages. Each rock type reflects shortwave infrared light differently, making it possible to map out geology by comparing reflected SWIR light.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/swir-rgb/)
msgstr:
# Kompożitu infra-aħmar tal-mewġ qasir (SWIR)

Il-kejl infra-aħmar tal-mewġ qasir (SWIR) jista’ jgħin lix-xjenzati jistmaw kemm hemm ilma preżenti fil-pjanti u fil-ħamrija, peress li l-ilma jassorbi t-tuli tal-mewġ SWIR. Il-bandi infra-ħomor tal-mewġ qasir (band hija reġjun tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku; sensor tas-satellita jista’ jieħu immaġini tad-Dinja f’bandi differenti) huma utli wkoll biex jiddistingwu bejn tipi ta’ sħab (sħab tal-ilma kontra sħab tas-silġ), borra u silġ, li kollha jidhru bojod fid-dawl viżibbli. F’dan il-kompożitu l-veġetazzjoni tidher f’sfumaturi ta’ aħdar, il-ħamrija u ż-żoni mibnija huma f’sfumaturi differenti ta’ kannella, u l-ilma jidher iswed. Art maħruqa reċentement tirrifletti bil-qawwa fil-bandi SWIR, u dan jagħmilhom siewja għall-immappjar tad-danni tan-nar. Kull tip ta’ blat jirrifletti d-dawl infra-aħmar tal-mewġ qasir b’mod differenti, u dan jagħmilha possibbli li tiġi mmappjata l-ġeoloġija billi jitqabbel id-dawl SWIR riflessi.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/swir-rgb/)

# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI.msgid:
# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI)

The Sentinel-2 normalised difference snow index can be used to differentiate between cloud and snow cover as snow absorbs in the short-wave infrared light, but reflects the visible light, whereas cloud is generally reflective in both wavelengths. Snow cover is represented in bright vivid blue.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).
msgstr:
# Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Borra (NDSI)

L-indiċi tad-differenza normalizzata tal-borra tas-Sentinel-2 jista’ jintuża biex jiġi differenzjat bejn kopertura tas-sħab u tal-borra peress li l-borra tassorbi fid-dawl infra-aħmar tal-mewġ qasir, iżda tirrifletti d-dawl viżibbli, filwaqt li s-sħab ġeneralment huwa riflettiv fiż-żewġ tuli tal-mewġ. Il-kopertura tal-borra hija rappreżentata bi blu qawwi u ċar.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).

# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI.msgid:
# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI)

The normalised difference snow index (NDSI) can be used to differentiate between cloud and snow cover as snow absorbs in the short-wave infrared light, but reflects the visible light, whereas cloud is generally reflective in both wavelengths. Snow cover is represented in bright vivid blue.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).
msgstr:
# Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Borra (NDSI)

L-indiċi tad-differenza normalizzata tal-borra (NDSI) jista’ jintuża biex jiġi differenzjat bejn kopertura tas-sħab u tal-borra peress li l-borra tassorbi fid-dawl infra-aħmar tal-mewġ qasir, iżda tirrifletti d-dawl viżibbli, filwaqt li s-sħab ġeneralment huwa riflettiv fiż-żewġ tuli tal-mewġ. Il-kopertura tal-borra hija rappreżentata bi blu qawwi u ċar.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).

# Highlight Optimized Natural Color\n\nT.msgid:
# Highlight Optimized Natural Color

This script aims to display the Earth in beautiful natural color images. It uses highlight optimization to avoid burnt out pixels and to even out the exposure.



More info [here.](https://sentinel-hub.github.io/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/highlight_optimized_natural_color/#)
msgstr:
# Kulur naturali ottimizzat għall-highlights

Dan l-iskript għandu l-għan li juri d-Dinja f’immaġini sbieħ bil-kulur naturali. Juża ottimizzazzjoni tal-highlights biex jevita pikseli maħruqin u biex jagħmel l-espożizzjoni uniformi.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://sentinel-hub.github.io/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/highlight_optimized_natural_color/#)

# Geology 12, 8, 2 composite\n\nThis com.msgid:
# Geology 12, 8, 2 composite

This composite uses short-wave infrared (SWIR) band 12 to differentiate among different rock types (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). Each rock and mineral type reflects short-wave infrared light differently, making it possible to map out geology by comparing reflected SWIR light. Near infrared (NIR) band 8 highlights vegetation and band 2 detects moisture, both contributing to differentiation of ground materials. The composite is useful for finding geological formations and features (e.g. faults, fractures), lithology (e.g. granite, basalt, etc.) and mining applications.



More info [here.](https://www.euspaceimaging.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/EUSI-SWIR.pdf)
msgstr:
# Kompożitu Ġeoloġija 12, 8, 2

Dan il-kompożitu juża l-band infra-ħamra tal-mewġ qasir (SWIR) 12 biex jiddifferenzja bejn tipi differenti ta’ blat (band hija reġjun tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku; sensor tas-satellita jista’ jieħu immaġini tad-Dinja f’bandi differenti). Kull tip ta’ blat u minerali jirrifletti d-dawl infra-aħmar tal-mewġ qasir b’mod differenti, u dan jagħmilha possibbli li tiġi mmappjata l-ġeoloġija billi jitqabbel id-dawl SWIR riflessi. Il-band 8 infra-ħamra qrib (NIR) tenfasizza l-veġetazzjoni u l-band 2 tidentifika l-umdità, it-tnejn jikkontribwixxu għad-differenzjazzjoni tal-materjali tal-art. Il-kompożitu huwa utli biex jinstabu formazzjonijiet u karatteristiċi ġeoloġiċi (eż. ħsarat, ksur), litoloġija (eż. granit, bażalt, eċċ.) u applikazzjonijiet tal-minjieri.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://www.euspaceimaging.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/EUSI-SWIR.pdf)

# Geology 8, 11, 12 composite\n\nThis co.msgid:
# Geology 8, 11, 12 composite

This composite uses both short-wave infrared (SWIR) bands 11 and 12 to differentiate among different rock types (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). Each rock and mineral type reflects shortwave infrared light differently, making it possible to map out geology by comparing reflected SWIR light. Near Infrared (NIR) band 8 highlights vegetation, contributing to differentiation of ground materials. Vegetation in the composite appears red. The composite is useful for differentiating vegetation, and land especially geologic features that can be useful for mining and mineral exploration.



More info [here.](http://murphygeological.com/new---sentinel-2.html#)
msgstr:
# Kompożitu Ġeoloġija 8, 11, 12

Dan il-kompożitu juża kemm il-bandi infra-ħomor tal-mewġ qasir (SWIR) 11 u 12 biex jiddifferenzja bejn tipi differenti ta’ blat (band hija reġjun tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku; sensor tas-satellita jista’ jieħu immaġini tad-Dinja f’bandi differenti). Kull tip ta’ blat u minerali jirrifletti d-dawl infra-aħmar tal-mewġ qasir b’mod differenti, u dan jagħmilha possibbli li tiġi mmappjata l-ġeoloġija billi jitqabbel id-dawl SWIR riflessi. Il-band 8 infra-ħamra qrib (NIR) tenfasizza l-veġetazzjoni, u tikkontribwixxi għad-differenzjazzjoni tal-materjali tal-art. Il-veġetazzjoni fil-kompożitu tidher bl-aħmar. Il-kompożitu huwa utli biex tiġi differenzjata l-veġetazzjoni, u l-art speċjalment karatteristiċi ġeoloġiċi li jistgħu jkunu utli għall-minjieri u l-esplorazzjoni tal-minerali.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](http://murphygeological.com/new---sentinel-2.html#)

# Wildfires\n\nThis script, created by P.msgid:
# Wildfires

This script, created by Pierre Markuse, visualizes wildfires using Sentinel-2 data. It combines natural color background with some NIR/SWIR data for smoke penetration and more detail, while adding highlights from B11 and B12 to show fires in red and orange colors.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/markuse_fire/)
msgstr:
# Nirien tal-foresti

Dan l-iskript, maħluq minn Pierre Markuse, jviżwalizza nirien tal-foresti bl-użu tad-data tas-Sentinel-2. Jgħaqqad sfond tal-kulur naturali ma’ xi data NIR/SWIR għall-penetrazzjoni tad-duħħan u aktar dettall, filwaqt li jżid highlights minn B11 u B12 biex juru n-nirien f’kuluri aħmar u oranġjo.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/markuse_fire/)

# Wildfires\n\nThis script, based on the.msgid:
# Wildfires

This script, based on the Pierre Markuse wildfire script, detects and visualizes wildfires using Landsat 8/9 thermal and visible bands. It combines natural color (B2, B3, B4) with thermal band (B10) analysis to detect temperature anomalies and create a red-orange-white glow effect highlighting fire locations.



More info [here.](https://github.com/azlinszkysinergise/customscripts_test_az/blob/main/landsat_markuse_fire_v2)
msgstr:
# Nirien tal-foresti

Dan l-iskript, ibbażat fuq l-iskript tan-nirien tal-foresti ta’ Pierre Markuse, jidentifika u jviżwalizza nirien tal-foresti bl-użu tal-bandi termali u viżibbli tal-Landsat 8/9. Jgħaqqad il-kulur naturali (B2, B3, B4) ma’ analiżi tal-band termali (B10) biex jidentifika anomaliji tat-temperatura u joħloq effett ta’ tleqqija aħmar-oranġjo-abjad li jenfasizza l-pożizzjonijiet tan-nirien.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://github.com/azlinszkysinergise/customscripts_test_az/blob/main/landsat_markuse_fire_v2)

# Enhanced True Color\n\nThis script, cr.msgid:

This script, created by Pierre Markuse, uses multiple bands (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands) and saturation and brightness control to enhance the true color visualization.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/enhanced_true_color-2/#)

# Kulur veru mtejjeb

Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/enhanced_true_color-2/#)

# Burned Area Index\n\nBurned Area Index.msgid:
# Burned Area Index

Burned Area Index takes advantage of the wider spectrum of Visible, Red-Edge, NIR and SWIR bands.

Values description:()=> The range of values for the index is `-1` to `1` for burn scars, and `1` - `6` for active fires. Different fire intensities may result in different thresholds; the current values were calibrated, as per original author, on mostly Mediterranen regions.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/bais2/)
msgstr:
# Indiċi taż-Żona Maħruqa

L-Indiċi taż-Żona Maħruqa jieħu vantaġġ mill-ispettru usa’ tal-bandi Viżibbli, Red-Edge, NIR u SWIR.

Deskrizzjoni tal-valuri:()=> Il-firxa tal-valuri tal-indiċi hija `-1` sa `1` għal ċikatriċi tal-ħruq, u `1` - `6` għal nirien attivi. Intensitajiet differenti tan-nar jistgħu jirriżultaw f’limiti differenti; il-valuri attwali ġew ikkalibrati, skont l-awtur oriġinali, fuq reġjuni l-aktar Mediterranji.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/bais2/)

# Normalized Burn Ratio (NBR)\n\nNormali.msgid:
# Normalized Burn Ratio (NBR)

Normalized Burn Ratio is frequently used to estimate burn severity. It uses near-infrared (NIR) and shortwave-infrared (SWIR) wavelengths. Healthy vegetation has a high reflectance in the near-infrared portion of the spectrum, and a low short-wave infrared reflectance. On the other hand, burned areas have a high shortwave infrared reflectance but low reflectance in the near infrared Darker pixels indicate burned areas.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/nbr/).
msgstr:
# Proporzjon Normalizzat tal-Ħruq (NBR)

Il-Proporzjon Normalizzat tal-Ħruq jintuża spiss biex jiġi stmat is-severità tal-ħruq. Juża tuli tal-mewġ infra-ħomor qrib (NIR) u infra-ħomor tal-mewġ qasir (SWIR). Veġetazzjoni f’saħħitha għandha riflettanza għolja fil-parti infra-ħamra qrib tal-ispettru, u riflettanza baxxa infra-ħamra tal-mewġ qasir. Min-naħa l-oħra, żoni maħruqa għandhom riflettanza għolja infra-ħamra tal-mewġ qasir iżda riflettanza baxxa fl-infra-aħmar qrib. Pikseli aktar skuri jindikaw żoni maħruqa.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/nbr/).

# Atmospheric penetration\n\nThis compos.msgid:
# Atmospheric penetration

This composite uses different bands (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands) in the non-visible part of the electromagnetic spectrum to reduce the influence of the atmosphere in the image. Short wave infrared bands 11 and 12 are highly reflected by the heated areas, making them useful for fire and burned area mapping. Near infrared band 8, is on contrary, highly reflected by vegetation, which signifies absence of fire. Vegetation appears blue, displaying details related to the vegetation vigor. Healthy vegetation is shown in light blue while the stressed, sparse or/and arid vegetation appears in dull blue. Urban features are white, grey, cyan or purple.



More info [here.](https://eos.com/atmospheric-penetration/)
msgstr:
# Penetrazzjoni atmosferika

Dan il-kompożitu juża bandi differenti (band hija reġjun tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku; sensor tas-satellita jista’ jieħu immaġini tad-Dinja f’bandi differenti) fil-parti mhux viżibbli tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku biex inaqqas l-influwenza tal-atmosfera fl-immaġni. Il-bandi infra-ħomor tal-mewġ qasir 11 u 12 jiġu rriflessi ħafna miż-żoni msaħħna, u dan jagħmilhom utli għall-immappjar tan-nar u taż-żoni maħruqa. Il-band infra-ħamra qrib 8, għall-kuntrarju, tiġi rriflessa ħafna mill-veġetazzjoni, li tfisser nuqqas ta’ nar. Il-veġetazzjoni tidher blu, u turi dettalji relatati mal-qawwa tal-veġetazzjoni. Veġetazzjoni f’saħħitha tidher blu ċar filwaqt li l-veġetazzjoni stressata, skarsa u/jew arida tidher blu bla ħajja. Karatteristiċi urbani huma bojod, griżi, ċjan jew vjola.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://eos.com/atmospheric-penetration/)

# Barren Soil Visualization\n\nThe Barre.msgid:
# Barren Soil Visualization

The Barren Soil Visualization can be useful for soil mapping, to investigate the location of landslides or the extent of erosion in non-vegetated areas. This visualization shows all vegetation in green and the barren ground in red. Water appears black.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/barren_soil/) and [here.](https://medium.com/sentinel-hub/create-useful-and-beautiful-satellite-images-with-custom-scripts-8ef0e6a474c6)
msgstr:
# Viżwalizzazzjoni tal-ħamrija sterili

Il-Viżwalizzazzjoni tal-ħamrija sterili tista’ tkun utli għall-immappjar tal-ħamrija, biex tiġi investigata l-pożizzjoni ta’ frani jew il-firxa tal-erożjoni f’żoni mingħajr veġetazzjoni. Din il-viżwalizzazzjoni turi l-veġetazzjoni kollha bl-aħdar u l-art sterili bl-aħmar. L-ilma jidher iswed.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/barren_soil/) u [hawnhekk.](https://medium.com/sentinel-hub/create-useful-and-beautiful-satellite-images-with-custom-scripts-8ef0e6a474c6)

# True Color with IR Highlights composite

This composite enhances the true color visualization by adding the shortwave infrared wavelengths to amplify details. It displays heated areas in red/orange.



More info [here.](https://medium.com/sentinel-hub/active-volcanoes-as-seen-from-space-9d1de0133733)
msgstr:
# Kompożitu tal-Kulur veru b’highlights tal-IR

Dan il-kompożitu itejjeb il-viżwalizzazzjoni tal-kulur veru billi jżid it-tuli tal-mewġ infra-ħomor tal-mewġ qasir biex jamplifika d-dettalji. Juri ż-żoni msaħħna bl-aħmar/oranġjo.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://medium.com/sentinel-hub/active-volcanoes-as-seen-from-space-9d1de0133733)

# Detection of Burned Areas\n\nThis scri.msgid:
# Detection of Burned Areas

This script is used to detect large scale recently burned areas. Pixels colored red highlight burned areas, and all other pixels are returned in true color. The script sometimes overestimates burned areas over water and clouds.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/burned_area_ms/)
msgstr:
# Detezzjoni taż-żoni maħruqin

Dan l-iskript jintuża biex jiġu identifikati żoni maħruqin reċentement fuq skala kbira. Pikseli bl-aħmar jenfasizzaw iż-żoni maħruqin, u l-pikseli l-oħra kollha jingħataw lura bil-kulur veru. L-iskript xi drabi jipprevedi żżejjed iż-żoni maħruqin fuq l-ilma u s-sħab.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/burned_area_ms/)

# Scene classification\n\n\n\nScene clas.msgid:
# Scene classification



Scene classification was developed to distinguish between cloudy pixels, clear pixels and water pixels of Sentinel-2 data and is a result of ESA's Scene classification algorithm. Twelve different classifications are provided including classes of clouds, vegetation, soils/desert, water and snow. It does not constitute a land cover classification map in a strict sense.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/scene-classification/).
msgstr:
# Klassifikazzjoni tax-xena



Il-klassifikazzjoni tax-xena ġiet żviluppata biex tiddistingwi bejn pikseli mimlijin sħab, pikseli ċari u pikseli tal-ilma tad-data tas-Sentinel-2 u hija riżultat tal-algoritmu ta’ klassifikazzjoni tax-xena tal-ESA. Jiġu pprovduti tnax-il klassifikazzjoni differenti inklużi klassijiet ta’ sħab, veġetazzjoni, ħamrija/deżert, ilma u borra. Ma tikkostitwixxix mappa ta’ klassifikazzjoni tal-kopertura tal-art fis-sens strett.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/scene-classification/).

# Terrestrial Chlorophyll Index (OTCI)\n.msgid:
# Terrestrial Chlorophyll Index (OTCI)



The Terrestrial Chlorophyll Index (OTCI) is estimated based on the chlorophyll content in terrestrial vegetation and can be used to monitor vegetation condition and health. Low OTCI values usually signify water, sand or snow. Extremely high values, displayed with white, usually suggest the absence of chlorophyll as well. They generally represent either bare ground, rock or clouds. The chlorophyll values in between range from red (low chlorophyll values) to dark green (high chlorophyll values) can be used to determine vegetation health.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/otci/)
msgstr:
# Indiċi tal-Klorofilla Terrestri (OTCI)



L-Indiċi tal-Klorofilla Terrestri (OTCI) jiġi stmat abbażi tal-kontenut tal-klorofilla fil-veġetazzjoni terrestri u jista’ jintuża biex jiġu mmonitorjati l-kundizzjoni u s-saħħa tal-veġetazzjoni. Valuri baxxi tal-OTCI normalment jindikaw ilma, ramel jew borra. Valuri għoljin ħafna, murija bl-abjad, normalment jissuġġerixxu nuqqas ta’ klorofilla wkoll. Ġeneralment jirrappreżentaw jew art mikxufa, blat jew sħab. Il-valuri tal-klorofilla bejniethom, li jvarjaw mill-aħmar (valuri baxxi ta’ klorofilla) sal-aħdar skur (valuri għoljin ta’ klorofilla), jistgħu jintużaw biex tiġi determinata s-saħħa tal-veġetazzjoni.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/otci/)

# Topographic Visualization\n\n\n\nThis.msgid:
# Topographic Visualization



This script returns a visualisation with green colours representing lowland elevations and earth colours as mountainous elevations. The script uses discrete classes rather than the continuous visualisations in the other DEM layers.

It is possible to set custom min and max values in the evalscript by setting defaultVis to false and setting the min and max variables to the desired values.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/dem/dem-topographic/)

Huwa possibbli li jiġu ssettjati valuri min u max personalizzati fl-evalscript billi defaultVis jiġi ssettjat għal false u l-varjabbli min u max jiġu ssettjati għall-valuri mixtieqa.



Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/dem/dem-topographic/)

# Enhanced visualization\n\nThis script.msgid:
# Enhanced visualization

This script combines the gamma0 of the VV and VH polarizations into a false color visualization. It displays water areas in blue (partially black) and land in different shades of yellow/green. Urban areas are displayed in a light green-yellow (towards white), vegetated areas in mustard green and bare ground in a darker green.

For snowy and icy areas, the visualization can vary from light green-yellow over brighter green to dark brown or even black. In order not to confuse cryogenic features with non-cryogenic ones, some general information about the location is helpful in interpreting the image.
msgstr:
# Viżwalizzazzjoni mtejba

Dan l-iskript jgħaqqad il-gamma0 tal-polarizzazzjonijiet VV u VH f’viżwalizzazzjoni tal-kulur falz. Juri ż-żoni tal-ilma bil-blu (parzjalment suwed) u l-art f’sfumaturi differenti ta’ isfar/aħdar. Iż-żoni urbani jintwerew f’aħdar-isfar ċar (lejn l-abjad), iż-żoni veġetati f’aħdar mustarda u l-art mikxufa f’aħdar aktar skur.

Għal żoni miksija bil-borra u bis-silġ, il-viżwalizzazzjoni tista’ tvarja minn aħdar-isfar ċar sa aħdar aktar jgħajjat sa kannella skur jew anke iswed. Biex ma jiġux ikkonfużi karatteristiċi krijoġeniċi ma’ dawk mhux krijoġeniċi, xi informazzjoni ġenerali dwar il-pożizzjoni hija utli fl-interpretazzjoni tal-immaġni.

# SAR False Color Visualization\n\nThis.msgid:
# SAR False Color Visualization

This script combines the gamma0 of the VV and VH polarizations of Sentinel-1 SAR data into a false color visualization. Water areas appear in blue (partially black) and land in different shades of yellow/green. Urban areas are displayed in light green-yellow (towards white), vegetated areas in mustard green, and bare ground in darker green. The visualization supports a wide range of monitoring applications, including ice and ship tracking, agriculture and deforestation monitoring, and emergency response scenarios such as flood and volcano observation.

For snowy and icy areas, the visualization can vary from light green-yellow over brighter green to dark brown or even black. Some general knowledge of the location is helpful to avoid confusing cryogenic features with other land cover types.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_false_color_visualization/).
msgstr:
# Viżwalizzazzjoni SAR bil-kulur falz

Dan l-iskript jgħaqqad il-gamma0 tal-polarizzazzjonijiet VV u VH tad-data SAR tas-Sentinel-1 f’viżwalizzazzjoni tal-kulur falz. Iż-żoni tal-ilma jidhru bil-blu (parzjalment suwed) u l-art f’sfumaturi differenti ta’ isfar/aħdar. Iż-żoni urbani jintwerew f’aħdar-isfar ċar (lejn l-abjad), iż-żoni veġetati f’aħdar mustarda, u l-art mikxufa f’aħdar aktar skur. Il-viżwalizzazzjoni tappoġġja firxa wiesgħa ta’ applikazzjonijiet ta’ monitoraġġ, inklużi t-traċċar tas-silġ u tal-vapuri, il-monitoraġġ tal-agrikoltura u tad-deforestazzjoni, u xenarji ta’ rispons ta’ emerġenza bħall-osservazzjoni tal-għargħar u tal-vulkani.

Għal żoni miksija bil-borra u bis-silġ, il-viżwalizzazzjoni tista’ tvarja minn aħdar-isfar ċar sa aħdar aktar jgħajjat sa kannella skur jew anke iswed. Xi għarfien ġenerali tal-pożizzjoni huwa utli biex jiġi evitat li karatteristiċi krijoġeniċi jiġu kkonfużi ma’ tipi oħra ta’ kopertura tal-art.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_false_color_visualization/).

# Urban Areas\n\nThis script uses Sentin.msgid:
# Urban Areas

This script uses Sentinel-1 SAR VH and VV polarisations to highlight urban areas and buildings. Structures appear in different colours depending on their backscatter characteristics: purple indicates high VH reflectance, green indicates high VV reflectance, and white indicates high reflectance in both. The red channel is restricted to pixels where VH exceeds 0.5, helping separate buildings from bare soil. The script is useful for monitoring urban expansion, assessing building density, and identifying structures in flood-prone areas. Note that in mountainous terrain, steep slopes and snow can produce similar signals, making it difficult to separate urban areas from other features.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/urban_areas/).
msgstr:
# Żoni urbani

Dan l-iskript juża l-polarizzazzjonijiet SAR VH u VV tas-Sentinel-1 biex jenfasizza ż-żoni urbani u l-bini. L-istrutturi jidhru f’kuluri differenti skont il-karatteristiċi tal-backscatter tagħhom: il-vjola tindika riflettanza għolja VH, l-aħdar jindika riflettanza għolja VV, u l-abjad jindika riflettanza għolja fiż-żewġ każijiet. Il-kanal aħmar huwa ristrett għall-pikseli fejn VH jaqbeż 0.5, u dan jgħin biex il-bini jiġi separat mill-ħamrija mikxufa. L-iskript huwa utli għall-monitoraġġ tal-espansjoni urbana, il-valutazzjoni tad-densità tal-bini, u l-identifikazzjoni ta’ strutturi f’żoni suxxettibbli għall-għargħar. Innota li f’terren muntanjuż, għoljiet ċerti u borra jistgħu jipproduċu sinjali simili, u dan jagħmilha diffiċli li ż-żoni urbani jiġu separati minn karatteristiċi oħra.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/urban_areas/).

# SAR Deforestation Detection\n\nThis sc.msgid:
# SAR Deforestation Detection

This script processes Sentinel-1 VV and VH polarisation bands to detect deforestation and forest degradation. It converts the backscatter values into polar form to derive vector length and angle, which discriminate between water, forest, and bare soil. Water and bare soil appear black, forested areas are rendered in green gradients, and degraded or cleared areas appear in red — with stronger colours indicating higher classification confidence. The script is useful for monitoring forest loss and land-use change over time.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_deforestation_detection/).
msgstr:
# Detezzjoni SAR tad-deforestazzjoni

Dan l-iskript jipproċessa l-bandi tal-polarizzazzjoni VV u VH tas-Sentinel-1 biex jidentifika d-deforestazzjoni u d-degradazzjoni tal-foresti. Jikkonverti l-valuri tal-backscatter f’forma polari biex jiddeduċi t-tul u l-angolu tal-vettur, li jiddistingwu bejn l-ilma, il-foresta, u l-ħamrija mikxufa. L-ilma u l-ħamrija mikxufa jidhru sodi, iż-żoni foresti jiġu rrappreżentati f’gradjenti ta’ aħdar, u ż-żoni degradati jew imnaddfa jidhru bl-aħmar — b’kuluri aktar b’saħħithom jindikaw kunfidenza ogħla fil-klassifikazzjoni. L-iskript huwa utli għall-monitoraġġ tat-telf tal-foresti u tal-bidla fl-użu tal-art maż-żmien.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_deforestation_detection/).

# Water Surface Roughness\n\nThis script.msgid:
# Water Surface Roughness

This script visualizes water surface roughness using Sentinel-1 SAR data. SAR backscatter is highly sensitive to the roughness of the water surface: calm water reflects radar energy away from the sensor and appears dark, while rough or wind-driven water scatters energy back and appears brighter. Variations in surface roughness reveal oceanographic and maritime features such as wind patterns, sea currents, internal waves, and ship wakes. Oil spills dampen surface waves and appear as dark patches against the surrounding rougher water. The visualization supports maritime monitoring applications including ship tracking, oil pollution detection, and observation of ocean circulation.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/water_surface_roughness_visualization/).
msgstr:
# Ħruxija tal-wiċċ tal-ilma

Dan l-iskript jviżwalizza l-ħruxija tal-wiċċ tal-ilma bl-użu tad-data SAR tas-Sentinel-1. Il-backscatter SAR huwa sensittiv ħafna għall-ħruxija tal-wiċċ tal-ilma: ilma kalm jirrifletti l-enerġija tar-radar ’il bogħod mis-sensor u jidher skur, filwaqt li ilma mqalleb jew misjuq mir-riħ jitfa’ l-enerġija lura u jidher aktar ċar. Varjazzjonijiet fil-ħruxija tal-wiċċ juru karatteristiċi oċeanografiċi u marittimi bħal xejriet tar-riħ, kurrenti tal-baħar, mewġ intern, u l-mewġ ta’ wara l-vapuri. Tixrid taż-żejt idewwem il-mewġ tal-wiċċ u jidher bħala tikek skuri kontra l-ilma mqalleb tal-madwar. Il-viżwalizzazzjoni tappoġġja applikazzjonijiet ta’ monitoraġġ marittimu inklużi t-traċċar tal-vapuri, id-detezzjoni tat-tniġġis taż-żejt, u l-osservazzjoni taċ-ċirkolazzjoni tal-oċean.



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/water_surface_roughness_visualization/).

# RGB ratio\n\nThis script combines the.msgid:
# RGB ratio

This script combines the gamma0 of the VV and VH polarizations into a false color visualization. It uses the VV polarization in the red channel, the VH polarization in the green channel, and a ratio of VH/VV in the blue channel. It shows water areas in dark red (black), urban areas in yellow, vegetated areas in turquoise, and bare ground in dark purple.

For snowy and icy areas, the visualization can vary from light yellow to blue to red. In order not to confuse cryogenic features with non-cryogenic ones, some general information about the location is helpful in interpreting the image.
msgstr:
# Proporzjon RGB

Dan l-iskript jgħaqqad il-gamma0 tal-polarizzazzjonijiet VV u VH f’viżwalizzazzjoni tal-kulur falz. Juża l-polarizzazzjoni VV fil-kanal aħmar, il-polarizzazzjoni VH fil-kanal aħdar, u proporzjon ta’ VH/VV fil-kanal blu. Juri ż-żoni tal-ilma bl-aħmar skur (iswed), iż-żoni urbani bl-isfar, iż-żoni veġetati bit-turkważ, u l-art mikxufa bil-vjola skur.

Għal żoni miksija bil-borra u bis-silġ, il-viżwalizzazzjoni tista’ tvarja minn isfar ċar għal blu għal aħmar. Biex ma jiġux ikkonfużi karatteristiċi krijoġeniċi ma’ dawk mhux krijoġeniċi, xi informazzjoni ġenerali dwar il-pożizzjoni hija utli fl-interpretazzjoni tal-immaġni.

# SAR Urban\n\nThe script is useful for.msgid:
# SAR Urban

The script is useful for locating urban areas and individual buildings. It uses the gamma0 of the VH polarization and the VV polarizations to highlight different buildings and topology orientations with purple and green colors. It can be used to track urban expansion, estimate building type, or locate buildings in risk areas (e.g., flooding).

For snowy and icy areas, the visualization can vary from white to purple to dark blue or even black. In order not to confuse cryogenic features with non-cryogenic ones, some general information about the location is helpful to interpret the image. 

More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/urban_areas/).
msgstr:
# SAR Urban

L-iskript huwa utli biex jiġu lokalizzati żoni urbani u bini individwali. Juża l-gamma0 tal-polarizzazzjoni VH u tal-polarizzazzjonijiet VV biex jenfasizza bini u orjentazzjonijiet tat-topoloġija differenti b’kuluri vjola u aħdar. Jista’ jintuża biex jiġi traċċat l-espansjoni urbana, jiġi stmat it-tip ta’ bini, jew jiġi lokalizzat bini f’żoni f’riskju (eż., għargħar).

Għal żoni miksija bil-borra u bis-silġ, il-viżwalizzazzjoni tista’ tvarja minn abjad għal vjola għal blu skur jew anke iswed. Biex ma jiġux ikkonfużi karatteristiċi krijoġeniċi ma’ dawk mhux krijoġeniċi, xi informazzjoni ġenerali dwar il-pożizzjoni hija utli biex tiġi interpretata l-immaġni. 

Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/urban_areas/).

# HH - decibel gamma0\n\nThis script dis.msgid:
# HH - decibel gamma0

This script displays a grayscale visualization of the gamma0 of the HH polarization. The HH polarization is less sensitive to surface roughness compared to the VV polarization and is therefore used for detecting objects and hard targets such as ships. It provides good contrast between water and land surfaces. Compared to the linear gamma0 visualization, the decibel gamma0 visualization includes a logarithmic scaling of the data.
msgstr:
# HH - gamma0 f’deċibel

Dan l-iskript juri viżwalizzazzjoni bix-xtajn tal-griż tal-gamma0 tal-polarizzazzjoni HH. Il-polarizzazzjoni HH hija inqas sensittiva għall-ħruxija tal-wiċċ meta mqabbla mal-polarizzazzjoni VV u għalhekk tintuża għad-detezzjoni ta’ oġġetti u miri sodi bħall-vapuri. Tipprovdi kuntrast tajjeb bejn uċuh tal-ilma u tal-art. Meta mqabbla mal-viżwalizzazzjoni lineari tal-gamma0, il-viżwalizzazzjoni tal-gamma0 f’deċibel tinkludi skalar logaritmiku tad-data.

# HV - decibel gamma0\n\nThis script dis.msgid:
# HV - decibel gamma0

This script displays a grayscale visualization of the gamma0 of the HV polarization. The values for the cross polarization (HV) are generally lower (darker visualization) than for the co-polarization (HH, VV). The HV polarization has higher values for surfaces characterized by volume scattering, e.g., branches, dry coil bodies, or canopies (lighter color in the visualization) and lower for surfaces with little to no scattering (darker color in the visualization). Compared to the linear gamma0 visualization, the decibel gamma0 visualization includes a logarithmic scaling of the data.
msgstr:

Il-valuri għall-polarizzazzjoni inkroċjata (HV) huma ġeneralment aktar baxxi (viżwalizzazzjoni aktar skura) minn dawk tal-ko-polarizzazzjoni (HH, VV). Il-polarizzazzjoni HV għandha valuri ogħla għal uċuh ikkaratterizzati minn tixrid volumetriku, eż., friegħi, korpi niexfa tal-ħamrija, jew kanupew (kulur aktar ċar fil-viżwalizzazzjoni) u aktar baxxi għal uċuh b’ftit jew xejn tixrid (kulur aktar skur fil-viżwalizzazzjoni). Meta mqabbla mal-viżwalizzazzjoni lineari tal-gamma0, il-viżwalizzazzjoni tal-gamma0 f’deċibel tinkludi skalar logaritmiku tad-data.

# Total suspended matter concentration\n.msgid:
# Total suspended matter concentration

Satellite-derived total suspended matter (TSM) is a measure of the concentration of particulate material in surface water such as mud, silt and other fine-grainded sedimentss, including organic and inorganic fractions. The TSM product is calculated based on the MERIS 1999 Baseline Atmospheric Correction and the OCI neural net TSM algorithm by [Hieronymi et al. 2017](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/marine-science/articles/10.3389/fmars.2017.00140/full). The product has variable accuracy and schould be considert experimental.

More info [here.](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data/SentinelMissions/Sentinel3.html#sentinel-3-olci-level-2)
msgstr:
# Konċentrazzjoni totali tal-materja sospiża

Il-materja sospiża totali (TSM) derivata mis-satellita hija miżura tal-konċentrazzjoni ta’ materjal partikolat fl-ilma tal-wiċċ bħal tajn, silt u sedimenti fini oħra, inklużi frazzjonijiet organiċi u inorganiċi. Il-prodott TSM jiġi kkalkulat abbażi tal-Korrezzjoni Atmosferika Baseline MERIS 1999 u l-algoritmu TSM tan-network newrali OCI ta’ [Hieronymi et al. 2017](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/marine-science/articles/10.3389/fmars.2017.00140/full). Il-prodott għandu preċiżjoni varjabbli u għandu jitqies bħala sperimentali.

Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data/SentinelMissions/Sentinel3.html#sentinel-3-olci-level-2)

# Aerosol optical thickness\n\nAerosol o.msgid:
# Aerosol optical thickness

Aerosol optical thickness (AOT) is a measure of the extent to which aerosols in the atmosphere prevent the transmission of light through absorption and scattering. Optical thickness, also knwon as optical depth depends on the physical nature, the shape and the concentration of particles. AOT is often used in climatology and atmospheric research to assess the effects of aerosols on weather, climate, and air quality.

More info [here.](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data)
msgstr:
# Ħxuna ottika tal-aerosol

Il-ħxuna ottika tal-aerosol (AOT) hija miżura ta’ safejn l-aerosols fl-atmosfera jipprevjenu t-trażmissjoni tad-dawl permezz ta’ assorbiment u tixrid. Il-ħxuna ottika, magħrufa wkoll bħala fond ottiku, tiddependi min-natura fiżika, mill-forma u mill-konċentrazzjoni tal-partikoli. L-AOT spiss tintuża fil-klimatoloġija u fir-riċerka atmosferika biex jiġu vvalutati l-effetti tal-aerosols fuq it-temp, il-klima, u l-kwalità tal-arja.

Aktar info [hawnhekk.](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data)

# Photosynthetically active radiation\n\.msgid:
# Photosynthetically active radiation

The Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) visualization displays the instantaneous PAR at the water surface. It was adopted from FERIS and developed based on an algorithm by [Aiken and Moore (1997)](https://earth.esa.int/eogateway/documents/20142/37627/MERIS_ATBD_2.18_v4.0+-+1997+-+PAR.pdf/07a8cd54-94ba-4efe-fe9a-751d1ffc9381). The PAR is a measure of the energy flux from the sun in the wavelenght range of 400–700 nm. It is often used to convert measured chlorophyll concentration into an estimate of ocen productivity and from this an estimate of the carbon sequestration. As such, it plays an important role in modelling of the carbon-cycle.

More info [here](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data).
msgstr:
# Radjazzjoni attiva fotosintetikament

Il-viżwalizzazzjoni tar-Radjazzjoni Attiva Fotosintetikament (PAR) turi l-PAR istantanja fil-wiċċ tal-ilma. Ġiet adottata minn FERIS u żviluppata abbażi ta’ algoritmu ta’ [Aiken u Moore (1997)](https://earth.esa.int/eogateway/documents/20142/37627/MERIS_ATBD_2.18_v4.0+-+1997+-+PAR.pdf/07a8cd54-94ba-4efe-fe9a-751d1ffc9381). Il-PAR hija miżura tal-fluss tal-enerġija mix-xemx fil-firxa tat-tul tal-mewġ ta’ 400–700 nm. Spiss tintuża biex il-konċentrazzjoni tal-klorofilla mkejla tinbidel f’stima tal-produttività tal-oċean u minn dan stima tas-sekwestru tal-karbonju. Bħala tali, għandha rwol importanti fil-immudellar taċ-ċiklu tal-karbonju.

Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data).

# Diffuse attenuation coefficient\n\nThe.msgid:
# Diffuse attenuation coefficient

The diffuse attenuation coefficient at 490 nm is a measure of how the intensity of light decreases as it passes through a column of water. It quantifies the rate at which light is absorbed and scattered by water and its constituents, such as phytoplankton, dissolved organic matter and suspended particles. This coefficient is crucial for understanding underwater light environments and is widely used in marine biology, oceanography and environmental science. It's calculated as described in [Morel et al. (2007)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0034425707001307).

More info [here](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data).
msgstr:
# Koeffiċjent ta’ attenwazzjoni diffuża

Il-koeffiċjent ta’ attenwazzjoni diffuża f’490 nm huwa miżura ta’ kif l-intensità tad-dawl tonqos hekk kif tgħaddi minn kolonna tal-ilma. Jikkwantifika r-rata li biha d-dawl jiġi assorbit u mxerred mill-ilma u mill-kostitwenti tiegħu, bħall-fitoplankton, is-sustanza organika maħlula u l-partikoli sospiżi. Dan il-koeffiċjent huwa kruċjali biex jinftiehmu l-ambjenti tad-dawl taħt l-ilma u jintuża ħafna fil-bijoloġija tal-baħar, l-oċeanografija u x-xjenza ambjentali. Jiġi kkalkulat kif deskritt f’[Morel et al. (2007)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0034425707001307).

Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data).

# Integrated water vapour column\n\nThe.msgid:
# Integrated water vapour column

The integrated water vapour column displays the water vapour integrated over an atmosphere column. It is displayed in kg/m2 and calculated on the basis of band 18 (885 nm) and band 19 (900 nm). The product shows an overestimation in the transition zones between glint and off-glint and has a systematic overestimation of about 20%.

More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-IntegratedWaterVapourColumnoverLandS3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-IWV).
msgstr:
# Kolonna integrata tal-fwar tal-ilma

Il-kolonna integrata tal-fwar tal-ilma turi l-fwar tal-ilma integrat fuq kolonna atmosferika. Tintwera f’kg/m2 u tiġi kkalkulata abbażi tal-band 18 (885 nm) u tal-band 19 (900 nm). Il-prodott juri sovrastima fiż-żoni ta’ tranżizzjoni bejn glint u off-glint u għandu sovrastima sistematika ta’ madwar 20%.

Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-IntegratedWaterVapourColumnoverLandS3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-IWV).
