msgstr: In-numru ta’ valuri LAI istantanji validi disponibbli fit-tieqa tal-kompożizzjoni.

RMSE is computed between the final dekad.msgid: RMSE is computed between the final dekadal LAI value and the available valid instantaneous values in the compositing window. It is expressed in [m²/m²].
msgstr: L-RMSE jiġi kkalkulat bejn il-valur LAI dekadali finali u l-valuri istantanji validi disponibbli fit-tieqa tal-kompożizzjoni. Huwa espress f’[m²/m²].

FAPAR represents the fraction of photosy.msgid: FAPAR represents the fraction of photosynthetically active radiation [0.4-0.7 μm] that is absorbed by vegetation. FAPAR is defined as instantaneous at 10:00 local time.
msgstr: FAPAR jirrappreżenta l-frazzjoni tar-radjazzjoni attiva fotosintetikament [0.4-0.7 μm] li tiġi assorbita mill-veġetazzjoni. FAPAR huwa definit bħala istantanju fl-10:00 ħin lokali.

Number of available valid instantaneous.msgid: Number of available valid instantaneous FAPAR values in the compositing window.
msgstr: In-numru ta’ valuri FAPAR istantanji validi disponibbli fit-tieqa tal-kompożizzjoni.

RMSE is computed between the final dekad.msgid: RMSE is computed between the final dekadal FAPAR value and the available valid instantaneous values in the compositing window.
msgstr: L-RMSE jiġi kkalkulat bejn il-valur FAPAR dekadali finali u l-valuri istantanji validi disponibbli fit-tieqa tal-kompożizzjoni.

FCOVER is defined as the fraction of gro.msgid: FCOVER is defined as the fraction of ground surface covered by green vegetation as seen from the nadir direction.
msgstr: FCOVER huwa definit bħala l-frazzjoni tal-wiċċ tal-art miksija bil-veġetazzjoni ħadra kif tidher mid-direzzjoni nadir.

RMSE is computed between the final dekad.msgid: RMSE is computed between the final dekadal FCOVER value and the available valid instantaneous values in the compositing window.
msgstr: L-RMSE jiġi kkalkulat bejn il-valur FCOVER dekadali finali u l-valuri istantanji validi disponibbli fit-tieqa tal-kompożizzjoni.

Number of available valid instantaneous.msgid: Number of available valid instantaneous FCOVER values in the compositing window.
msgstr: In-numru ta’ valuri FCOVER istantanji validi disponibbli fit-tieqa tal-kompożizzjoni.
Kopertura tal-art u użu tal-art, kull 3 snin, 2018

Provides land cover and land use data in.msgid: Provides land cover and land use data in 764 Functional Urban Areas (FUA) with more than 50,000 inhabitants in EEA38 countries and the United Kingdom for the 2018 reference year. The dataset maps land cover and land use for 17 urban classes with the Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.25 ha and for 9 rural classes with the MMU of 1 ha and is available as vector data. The revised 2018 dataset is now aligned with the 2021 FUA boundaries, except for the 26 new FUAs that have no correspondence in 2018.
msgstr: Jipprovdi data dwar il-kopertura tal-art u l-użu tal-art f’764 Żona Urbana Funzjonali (FUA) b’aktar minn 50,000 abitant fil-pajjiżi tal-EEA38 u r-Renju Unit għas-sena ta’ referenza 2018. Is-sett tad-data jimmappja l-kopertura tal-art u l-użu tal-art għal 17-il klassi urbana bl-Unità Minima tal-Immappjar (MMU) ta’ 0.25 ha u għal 9 klassijiet rurali bl-MMU ta’ 1 ha u huwa disponibbli bħala data vettorjali. Is-sett tad-data rivedut tal-2018 issa huwa allinjat mal-fruntieri tal-FUA tal-2021, ħlief għas-26 FUA ġodda li m’għandhom ebda korrispondenza fl-2018.
Kopertura tal-art u użu tal-art, kull 3 snin, 2021

Provides land cover and land use data in.msgid: Provides land cover and land use data in 790 Functional Urban Areas (FUA) with more than 50,000 inhabitants in EEA38 countries and the United Kingdom for the 2021 reference year. The dataset maps land cover and land use for 19 urban classes with the Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.25 ha and for 9 rural classes with the MMU of 1 ha and is available as vector data.
msgstr: Jipprovdi data dwar il-kopertura tal-art u l-użu tal-art f’790 Żona Urbana Funzjonali (FUA) b’aktar minn 50,000 abitant fil-pajjiżi tal-EEA38 u r-Renju Unit għas-sena ta’ referenza 2021. Is-sett tad-data jimmappja l-kopertura tal-art u l-użu tal-art għal 19-il klassi urbana bl-Unità Minima tal-Immappjar (MMU) ta’ 0.25 ha u għal 9 klassijiet rurali bl-MMU ta’ 1 ha u huwa disponibbli bħala data vettorjali.

Land Cover and Land Use Change, 3-yearly.msgid: Land Cover and Land Use Change, 3-yearly, 2018-2021
msgstr: Bidla fil-Kopertura tal-Art u fl-Użu tal-Art, kull 3 snin, 2018-2021

Provides land cover and land use change.msgid: Provides land cover and land use change data between the 2018 and 2021 Urban Atlas layers. The Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) varies from 0.1 ha to 0.25 ha depending on the class. The Minimum Mapping Width (MMW) is 10 m, and the dataset is available as vector data.
msgstr: Jipprovdi data dwar il-bidla fil-kopertura tal-art u fl-użu tal-art bejn is-saffi tal-Urban Atlas tal-2018 u tal-2021. L-Unità Minima tal-Immappjar (MMU) tvarja minn 0.1 ha sa 0.25 ha skont il-klassi. Il-Wisa’ Minima tal-Immappjar (MMW) hija 10 m, u s-sett tad-data huwa disponibbli bħala data vettorjali.

Provides a separate layer of Urban Atlas.msgid: Provides a separate layer of Urban Atlas 2021 showing contiguous rows or patches of trees covering 500 m² or more and with a Minimum Mapping Width (MMW) of 10 m over "Artificial surfaces" (nomenclature class 1) inside each Functional Urban Area (FUA). The dataset is available as vector data.
msgstr: Jipprovdi saff separat tal-Urban Atlas 2021 li juri ringieli jew biċċiet kontigwi ta’ siġar li jkopru 500 m² jew aktar u b’Wisa’ Minima tal-Immappjar (MMW) ta’ 10 m fuq “Uċuh artifiċjali” (klassi 1 tan-nomenklatura) ġewwa kull Żona Urbana Funzjonali (FUA). Is-sett tad-data huwa disponibbli bħala data vettorjali.

Provides detailed land cover and land us.msgid: Provides detailed land cover and land use information for 59 thematic classes in selected Natura2000 and Emerald sites for the 2021 reference year. The dataset has a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.5 ha and a Minimum Mapping Width (MMW) of 10 m and is available as vector data.
msgstr: Jipprovdi informazzjoni dettaljata dwar il-kopertura tal-art u l-użu tal-art għal 59 klassi tematika f’siti magħżula tan-Natura2000 u tal-Emerald għas-sena ta’ referenza 2021. Is-sett tad-data għandu Unità Minima tal-Immappjar (MMU) ta’ 0.5 ha u Wisa’ Minima tal-Immappjar (MMW) ta’ 10 m u huwa disponibbli bħala data vettorjali.

Dry Matter Productivity is defined as th.msgid: Dry Matter Productivity is defined as the overall growth rate, or dry biomass increase, of the vegetation. It is expressed in kg of Dry Matter per hectare and per day (kg DM/ha/day).
msgstr: Il-Produttività tal-Materja Niexfa hija definita bħala r-rata ġenerali ta’ tkabbir, jew iż-żieda tal-bijomassa niexfa, tal-veġetazzjoni. Hija espressa f’kg ta’ Materja Niexfa għal kull ettaru u kuljum (kg DM/ha/jum).

GPP is defined as the total amount of ca.msgid: GPP is defined as the total amount of carbon compounds produced by photosynthesis of plants in an ecosystem in a given period of time, expressed in gC/m²/day.
msgstr: GPP hija definita bħala l-ammont totali ta’ komposti tal-karbonju prodotti mill-fotosintesi tal-pjanti f’ekosistema f’perjodu ta’ żmien partikolari, espressa f’gC/m²/jum.

NPP is defined as the net amount of biom.msgid: NPP is defined as the net amount of biomass, or carbon, produced by plants per unit area and time, expressed in gC/m²/day.
msgstr: NPP hija definita bħala l-ammont nett ta’ bijomassa, jew karbonju, prodott mill-pjanti għal kull unità ta’ żona u ħin, espressa f’gC/m²/jum.

GDMP represents the total amount of dry.msgid: GDMP represents the total amount of dry matter produced by land plants per unit time through photosynthesis. It is expressed in kg of Dry Matter per hectare and per day (kg DM/ha/day).
msgstr: GDMP tirrappreżenta l-ammont totali ta’ materja niexfa prodotta mill-pjanti tal-art għal kull unità ta’ żmien permezz tal-fotosintesi. Hija espressa f’kg ta’ Materja Niexfa għal kull ettaru u kuljum (kg DM/ha/jum).

Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 i.msgid: Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 is a 10 m high resolution raster layer containing height information generated for selected cities and urban areas as part of the Urban atlas suite of products.
msgstr: Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 huwa saff raster b’riżoluzzjoni għolja ta’ 10 m li fih informazzjoni dwar l-għoli iġġenerata għal bliet u żoni urbani magħżula bħala parti mis-suite ta’ prodotti Urban atlas.

Provides at pan-European level a classif.msgid: Provides at pan-European level a classification of the presence of fallow land over annual cropland area at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew klassifikazzjoni tal-preżenza ta’ art mistrieħa fuq żona ta’ art tar-raba’ annwali b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for fallow land presence.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għall-preżenza ta’ art mistrieħa.

Provides at pan-European level the durat.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the duration of the bare soil period after the harvest of the main annual crop at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew it-tul tal-perjodu tal-ħamrija mikxufa wara l-ħsad tal-għalla annwali ewlenija b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for bare soil after.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għall-ħamrija mikxufa wara.

Provides at pan-European level the durat.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the duration of the fallow land period over a five-year period at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew it-tul tal-perjodu tal-art mistrieħa matul perjodu ta’ ħames snin b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for fallow land duration.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għat-tul tal-art mistrieħa.

Provides at pan-European level the durat.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the duration of the bare soil period before the start of the main growing season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew it-tul tal-perjodu tal-ħamrija mikxufa qabel il-bidu tal-istaġun ewlieni tat-tkabbir b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for bare soil before.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għall-ħamrija mikxufa qabel.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 20 m information on the changes in five thematic classes (new broadleaved cover / new coniferous cover / loss of broadleaved cover / loss of coniferous cover / unchanged areas with tree cover).
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 20 m informazzjoni dwar il-bidliet f’ħames klassijiet tematiċi (kopertura ġdida ta’ weraq wiesa’ / kopertura ġdida ta’ koniferi / telf ta’ kopertura ta’ weraq wiesa’ / telf ta’ kopertura ta’ koniferi / żoni mhux mibdula b’kopertura tas-siġar).

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m information on the dominant leaf type (broadleaved or coniferous).
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m informazzjoni dwar it-tip dominanti ta’ weraq (weraq wiesa’ jew koniferi).

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for dominant leaf type.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għat-tip dominanti ta’ weraq.

Provides at pan-European level a classif.msgid: Provides at pan-European level a classification of cropland into one of the 19 crop type classes at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew klassifikazzjoni tal-art tar-raba’ f’waħda mid-19-il klassi ta’ tip ta’ għelejjel b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for crop types.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għat-tipi ta’ għelejjel.

Provides at pan-European level the durat.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the duration of the main growing season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew it-tul tal-istaġun ewlieni tat-tkabbir b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for main crop duration.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għat-tul tal-għalla ewlenija.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 20 m information on tree cover extend changes in three thematic classes (new tree cover / loss of tree cover / unchanged areas with tree cover).
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 20 m informazzjoni dwar il-bidliet fl-estensjoni tal-kopertura tas-siġar f’tliet klassijiet tematiċi (kopertura ġdida tas-siġar / telf ta’ kopertura tas-siġar / żoni mhux mibdula b’kopertura tas-siġar).

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for tree cover presence change.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għall-bidla fil-preżenza tal-kopertura tas-siġar.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 20 m information on changes in grassland vegetation cover.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 20 m informazzjoni dwar il-bidliet fil-kopertura tal-veġetazzjoni tal-mergħat.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for grassland change.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għall-bidla fil-mergħa.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a forest classification with 3 thematic classes (all non-forest areas / broadleaved forest / coniferous forest).
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m klassifikazzjoni tal-foresti b’3 klassijiet tematiċi (żoni mhux foresti kollha / foresta ta’ weraq wiesa’ / foresta ta’ koniferi).

Classification of grassland / non-grassl.msgid: Classification of grassland / non-grassland. Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a basic land cover classification with two thematic classes (grassland / non-grassland).
msgstr: Klassifikazzjoni ta’ mergħa / mhux mergħa. Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m klassifikazzjoni bażika tal-kopertura tal-art b’żewġ klassijiet tematiċi (mergħa / mhux mergħa).

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for grassland classification.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għall-klassifikazzjoni tal-mergħat.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m the level of tree cover density in a range from 0% to 100%.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m il-livell tad-densità tal-kopertura tas-siġar f’firxa minn 0% sa 100%.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for tree cover density.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għad-densità tal-kopertura tas-siġar.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m an indication on the number of years since a ploughing event for each pixel in the herbaceous cover. This dataset is auxiliary and is used in production of the Grassland status products to distinguish between temporary and permanent grasslands.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m indikazzjoni tan-numru ta’ snin minn avveniment ta’ ħrit għal kull pixel fil-kopertura erbaċeja. Dan is-sett tad-data huwa awżiljarju u jintuża fil-produzzjoni tal-prodotti tal-istatus tal-mergħat biex jiddistingwi bejn mergħat temporanji u permanenti.

Count of grassland mowing events. Provid.msgid: Count of grassland mowing events. Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a basic land cover classification containing respectively the number of grassland mowing events (GRAME) within the detected temporal and permanent grassland (Herbaceous cover Layer) at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Għadd ta’ avvenimenti ta’ qtugħ tal-mergħa. Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m klassifikazzjoni bażika tal-kopertura tal-art li fiha rispettivament in-numru ta’ avvenimenti ta’ qtugħ tal-mergħa (GRAME) fil-mergħa temporanja u permanenti identifikata (Saff tal-kopertura erbaċeja) b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for grassland mowing events.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għall-avvenimenti ta’ qtugħ tal-mergħa.

Provides at pan-European level the type.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the type (4 categories) of the secondary crop season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew it-tip (4 kategoriji) tal-istaġun sekondarju tal-għelejjel b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a basic land cover classification containing respectively the grassland mowing dates (GRAMD) within the detected temporal and permanent grassland (Herbaceous cover Layer) at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m klassifikazzjoni bażika tal-kopertura tal-art li fiha rispettivament id-dati tal-qtugħ tal-mergħa (GRAMD) fil-mergħa temporanja u permanenti identifikata (Saff tal-kopertura erbaċeja) b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Provides at pan-European level the annua.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the annual crop type diversity over a three-year period at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew id-diversità annwali tat-tipi ta’ għelejjel matul perjodu ta’ tliet snin b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a basic land cover classification with two thematic classes (herbaceous / non-herbaceous).
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m klassifikazzjoni bażika tal-kopertura tal-art b’żewġ klassijiet tematiċi (erbaċea / mhux erbaċea).

Provides at pan-European level the numbe.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the number (max 2) of growing seasons (main and secondary) within a calendar year at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew in-numru (massimu 2) ta’ staġuni tat-tkabbir (ewlieni u sekondarju) fi ħdan sena kalendarja b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Median of Land Surface Temperature obser.msgid: Median of Land Surface Temperature observed during the 10-days period, regardless the time of the day. Expressed in Kelvin.
msgstr: Medjan tat-Temperatura tal-Wiċċ tal-Art osservata matul il-perjodu ta’ 10 ijiem, irrispettivament mill-ħin tal-jum. Espress f’Kelvin.

Thermal Condition Index for the composit.msgid: Thermal Condition Index for the compositing period, estimated using LST observations around local solar noon.
msgstr: Indiċi tal-Kundizzjoni Termali għall-perjodu tal-kompożizzjoni, stmat bl-użu ta’ osservazzjonijiet LST madwar nofsinhar solari lokali.

Fraction of valid observations as used t.msgid: Fraction of valid observations as used to calculate the minimum, median and maximum temperature values, regardless the time of the day.
msgstr: Frazzjoni ta’ osservazzjonijiet validi kif użati biex jiġu kkalkulati l-valuri minimi, medjani u massimi tat-temperatura, irrispettivament mill-ħin tal-jum.

Minimum of Land Surface Temperature obse.msgid: Minimum of Land Surface Temperature observed during the 10-days period, per hour. Expressed in Kelvin.
msgstr: Minimu tat-Temperatura tal-Wiċċ tal-Art osservata matul il-perjodu ta’ 10 ijiem, kull siegħa. Espress f’Kelvin.

Median of Land Surface Temperature obser.msgid: Median of Land Surface Temperature observed during the 10-days period, per hour. Expressed in Kelvin.
msgstr: Medjan tat-Temperatura tal-Wiċċ tal-Art osservata matul il-perjodu ta’ 10 ijiem, kull siegħa. Espress f’Kelvin.

Maximum of Land Surface Temperature obse.msgid: Maximum of Land Surface Temperature observed during the 10-days period, per hour. Expressed in Kelvin.
msgstr: Massimu tat-Temperatura tal-Wiċċ tal-Art osservata matul il-perjodu ta’ 10 ijiem, kull siegħa. Espress f’Kelvin.

Fraction of valid observations as used t.msgid: Fraction of valid observations as used to calculate the minimum, median and maximum temperature values, per hour.
msgstr: Frazzjoni ta’ osservazzjonijiet validi kif użati biex jiġu kkalkulati l-valuri minimi, medjani u massimi tat-temperatura, kull siegħa.

Provides at pan-European level the emerg.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the emergence date of the secondary crop season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew id-data tat-tfaċċar tal-istaġun sekondarju tal-għelejjel b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Provides auxiliary information in the sp.msgid: Provides auxiliary information in the spatial resolution of 10 m on the trees in agricultural use and urban context, used for production of the Forest Type dataset for the 2021 reference year. Data is sourced from Corine Land Cover and High Resolution Layer Imperviousness.
msgstr: Jipprovdi informazzjoni awżiljarja b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m dwar is-siġar fl-użu agrikolu u fil-kuntest urban, użata għall-produzzjoni tas-sett tad-data Forest Type għas-sena ta’ referenza 2021. Id-data hija miksuba minn Corine Land Cover u High Resolution Layer Imperviousness.

Provides at pan-European level the durat.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the duration of the secondary crop season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew it-tul tal-istaġun sekondarju tal-għelejjel b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for secondary crops duration.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għat-tul tal-għelejjel sekondarji.

Classification of the Sentinel-2 image u.msgid: Classification of the Sentinel-2 image using the MAJA cloud screening and atmospheric correction software, developed by CNES and CESBIO with contributions from DLR. Cloud detection is performed at a spatial resolution of 120 m.
msgstr: Klassifikazzjoni tal-immaġni Sentinel-2 bl-użu tas-software MAJA għall-iskrinjar tas-sħab u l-korrezzjoni atmosferika, żviluppat mis-CNES u s-CESBIO b’kontribuzzjonijiet mid-DLR. Id-detezzjoni tas-sħab titwettaq b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 120 m.

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the cloud and cloud shadow classification layer.
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni bażika tas-saff tal-klassifikazzjoni tas-sħab u tad-dell tas-sħab.

Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags..msgid: Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags. The default visualisation highlights pixels where clouds have been detected using a single-scene, threshold-based approach. These correspond to pixels where bit 0 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Saff bitmask b’flags tal-kwalità tal-pikseli. Il-viżwalizzazzjoni awtomatika tenfasizza pikseli fejn ġie identifikat sħab bl-użu ta’ approċċ ibbażat fuq limitu b’xena waħda. Dawn jikkorrispondu għal pikseli fejn il-bit 0 huwa attivat. Informazzjoni addizzjonali tista’ tiġi viżwalizzata wkoll billi jintgħażlu bits oħra. Aktar dettalji huma disponibbli fl-għażla </> Personalizzat.

Fraction of the surface covered by snow.msgid: Fraction of the surface covered by snow (ranging from 0% to 100%). In the presence of tree cover, estimate of the fraction of snow under the canopy. The dataset has also the following classes: cloud or cloud shadow (205), inland water (210), and no data (255).
msgstr: Frazzjoni tal-wiċċ miksija bil-borra (li tvarja minn 0% sa 100%). Fil-preżenza ta’ kopertura tas-siġar, stima tal-frazzjoni tal-borra taħt il-kanupew. Is-sett tad-data għandu wkoll il-klassijiet li ġejjin: sħab jew dell tas-sħab (205), ilma intern (210), u l-ebda data (255).

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the on-ground snow fraction layer.
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni bażika tas-saff tal-frazzjoni tal-borra fuq l-art.

Fraction of the surface covered by snow.msgid: Fraction of the surface covered by snow as seen above the top of the canopy, i.e. visible from space (ranging from 0% to 100%). The dataset has also the following classes: cloud or cloud shadow (205), inland water (210), and no data (255).
msgstr: Frazzjoni tal-wiċċ miksija bil-borra kif tidher ’il fuq mill-quċċata tal-kanupew, jiġifieri viżibbli mill-ispazju (li tvarja minn 0% sa 100%). Is-sett tad-data għandu wkoll il-klassijiet li ġejjin: sħab jew dell tas-sħab (205), ilma intern (210), u l-ebda data (255).

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the Top-of-canopy snow fraction layer.
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni bażika tas-saff tal-frazzjoni tal-borra Top-of-canopy.

Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags..msgid: Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags. The default visualisation displays whether the pixel is located in the hillshade. These correspond to pixels where bit 0 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Saff bitmask b’flags tal-kwalità tal-pikseli. Il-viżwalizzazzjoni awtomatika turi jekk il-pixel jinsabx fid-dell tal-għolja (hillshade). Dawn jikkorrispondu għal pikseli fejn il-bit 0 huwa attivat. Informazzjoni addizzjonali tista’ tiġi viżwalizzata wkoll billi jintgħażlu bits oħra. Aktar dettalji huma disponibbli fl-għażla </> Personalizzat.

Bitmask layer defining cloud and cloud-s.msgid: Bitmask layer defining cloud and cloud-shadow masks derived from the input MAJA Sentinel-2 Level-2A product. The default visualisation displays all clouds except the thinnest ones, as well as all cloud shadows. These correspond to pixels where bit 0 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Saff bitmask li jiddefinixxi maskri tas-sħab u tad-dell tas-sħab derivati mill-prodott MAJA Sentinel-2 Level-2A tal-input. Il-viżwalizzazzjoni awtomatika turi s-sħab kollu ħlief l-irqaq, kif ukoll id-dellijiet kollha tas-sħab. Dawn jikkorrispondu għal pikseli fejn il-bit 0 huwa attivat. Informazzjoni addizzjonali tista’ tiġi viżwalizzata wkoll billi jintgħażlu bits oħra. Aktar dettalji huma disponibbli fl-għażla </> Personalizzat.

Values of the spectral index Normalized.msgid: Values of the spectral index Normalized Difference Snow Index for snow-covered-pixels (ranging from 0% to 100%). The index is derived from the input MAJA Sentinel-2 level 2A product. The dataset has also the following classes: cloud or cloud shadow (205), inland water (210), and no data (255).
msgstr: Valuri tal-indiċi spettrali Normalized Difference Snow Index għal pikseli mgħottija bil-borra (li jvarjaw minn 0% sa 100%). L-indiċi huwa derivat mill-prodott MAJA Sentinel-2 level 2A tal-input. Is-sett tad-data għandu wkoll il-klassijiet li ġejjin: sħab jew dell tas-sħab (205), ilma intern (210), u l-ebda data (255).

Wet Snow classification performed in hig.msgid: Wet Snow classification performed in high Mountains areas as described in the documentation. The possible values are wet snow (110), and Dry snow or snow-free or patchy snow (125). The dataset is also masked with the following classes: radar Shadow, layover, or foreshortening (200), water (210), forest (220), urban areas (230), non-mountain areas (240) and no data (255).
msgstr: Klassifikazzjoni tal-Borra Imxarrba mwettqa f’żoni ta’ muntanji għoljin kif deskritt fid-dokumentazzjoni. Il-valuri possibbli huma borra mxarrba (110), u Borra niexfa jew mingħajr borra jew borra mċappsa (125). Is-sett tad-data huwa wkoll mgħotti bil-maskra tal-klassijiet li ġejjin: dell tar-radar, layover, jew foreshortening (200), ilma (210), foresta (220), żoni urbani (230), żoni mhux muntanjużi (240) u l-ebda data (255).

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the wet snow classification layer.
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni bażika tas-saff tal-klassifikazzjoni tal-borra mxarrba.

Snow State Classification (SSC) within t.msgid: Snow State Classification (SSC) within the Sentinel-2 snow cover map derived from the CLMS FSC product - top-of canopy FSC layer (FSCTOC). It provides binary discrimination of wet (110) and dry (115) snow and identifies patchy snow or snow-free areas (120). The dataset has also the following classes: radar shadow, layover, foreshortening (200), shadow, and clouds and cloud shadow (205) from the aggregated FSCTOC layer, water (210), forest (220), urban areas (230), and no data (255).
msgstr: Klassifikazzjoni tal-Istat tal-Borra (SSC) fil-mappa tal-kopertura tal-borra tas-Sentinel-2 derivata mill-prodott CLMS FSC - saff FSC top-of canopy (FSCTOC). Tipprovdi diskriminazzjoni binarja tal-borra mxarrba (110) u niexfa (115) u tidentifika borra mċappsa jew żoni mingħajr borra (120). Is-sett tad-data għandu wkoll il-klassijiet li ġejjin: dell tar-radar, layover, foreshortening (200), dell, u sħab u dell tas-sħab (205) mis-saff FSCTOC aggregat, ilma (210), foresta (220), żoni urbani (230), u l-ebda data (255).

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the wet snow state classification.
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni bażika tal-klassifikazzjoni tal-istat tal-borra mxarrba.

Fraction of the surface covered by snow.msgid: Fraction of the surface covered by snow (ranging from 0% to 100%). The dataset has also the following classes: cloud or cloud shadow (205), inland water (210), and no data (255).
msgstr: Frazzjoni tal-wiċċ miksija bil-borra (li tvarja minn 0% sa 100%). Is-sett tad-data għandu wkoll il-klassijiet li ġejjin: sħab jew dell tas-sħab (205), ilma intern (210), u l-ebda data (255).

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the snow fraction GF layer. For pixels with a QAFLAGS bit 7 value of 0, the data quality refers to the Sentinel-2 optical snow data quality. For pixels with a QAFLAGS bit 7 value of 1, the data quality refers to the Sentinel-1 SAR wet snow data quality.
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni bażika tas-saff GF tal-frazzjoni tal-borra. Għal pikseli b’valur QAFLAGS bit 7 ta’ 0, il-kwalità tad-data tirreferi għall-kwalità tad-data ottika tal-borra tas-Sentinel-2. Għal pikseli b’valur QAFLAGS bit 7 ta’ 1, il-kwalità tad-data tirreferi għall-kwalità tad-data SAR tal-borra mxarrba tas-Sentinel-1.

Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags..msgid: Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags. The default visualisation displays the sensor type of the satellite data (optical=0 in blue, radar=1 in pink). These correspond to pixels where bit 7 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Saff bitmask b’flags tal-kwalità tal-pikseli. Il-viżwalizzazzjoni awtomatika turi t-tip ta’ sensor tad-data satellitari (ottiku=0 bil-blu, radar=1 bir-roża). Dawn jikkorrispondu għal pikseli fejn il-bit 7 huwa attivat. Informazzjoni addizzjonali tista’ tiġi viżwalizzata wkoll billi jintgħażlu bits oħra. Aktar dettalji huma disponibbli fl-għażla </> Personalizzat.

Number of days of snow cover over the hy.msgid: Number of days of snow cover over the hydrological year.
msgstr: In-numru ta’ jiem ta’ kopertura tal-borra matul is-sena idroloġika.

Snow cover onset date, expressed as the.msgid: Snow cover onset date, expressed as the number of days from the beginning of the hydrological year (1st September = day 0). Note that SCO is not given when the snow cover duration SCD is less than 60 days.
msgstr: Data tal-bidu tal-kopertura tal-borra, espressa bħala n-numru ta’ jiem mill-bidu tas-sena idroloġika (1 ta’ Settembru = jum 0). Innota li SCO ma tingħatax meta t-tul tal-kopertura tal-borra SCD huwa inqas minn 60 jum.

Snow cover melt out date, expressed as t.msgid: Snow cover melt out date, expressed as the number of days from the beginning of the hydrological year (1st September = day 0). Note that SCM is not given when the snow cover duration SCD is less than 60 days.
msgstr: Data tad-dewbien tal-kopertura tal-borra, espressa bħala n-numru ta’ jiem mill-bidu tas-sena idroloġika (1 ta’ Settembru = jum 0). Innota li SCM ma tingħatax meta t-tul tal-kopertura tal-borra SCD huwa inqas minn 60 jum.

Number of days with clear sky observatio.msgid: Number of days with clear sky observations used in the interpolation of the snow cover time series within the hydrological year.
msgstr: In-numru ta’ jiem b’osservazzjonijiet b’sema ċara użati fl-interpolazzjoni tas-serje taż-żmien tal-kopertura tal-borra fi ħdan is-sena idroloġika.

Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags..msgid: Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags. The default visualisation displays areas where the snow cover duration is less than 60 days. These correspond to pixels where bit 4 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Saff bitmask b’flags tal-kwalità tal-pikseli. Il-viżwalizzazzjoni awtomatika turi ż-żoni fejn it-tul tal-kopertura tal-borra huwa inqas minn 60 jum. Dawn jikkorrispondu għal pikseli fejn il-bit 4 huwa attivat. Informazzjoni addizzjonali tista’ tiġi viżwalizzata wkoll billi jintgħażlu bits oħra. Aktar dettalji huma disponibbli fl-għażla </> Personalizzat.

Quality layer providing a basic assessme.msgid: Quality layer providing a basic assessment of the snow cover duration layer.
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni bażika tas-saff tat-tul tal-kopertura tal-borra.

Number of days between the estimated sno.msgid: Number of days between the estimated snow onset date and the closest snow observation date.
msgstr: In-numru ta’ jiem bejn id-data stmata tal-bidu tal-borra u l-eqreb data ta’ osservazzjoni tal-borra.

Number of days between the estimated sno.msgid: Number of days between the estimated snow melt out date and the closest snow observation date.
msgstr: In-numru ta’ jiem bejn id-data stmata tad-dewbien tal-borra u l-eqreb data ta’ osservazzjoni tal-borra.

Number of days with Sentinel-1-based wet.msgid: Number of days with Sentinel-1-based wet snow observations used in the interpolation of the snow cover time series within the hydrological year (used where Sentinel-2-based observations have gaps).
msgstr: In-numru ta’ jiem b’osservazzjonijiet tal-borra mxarrba bbażati fuq is-Sentinel-1 użati fl-interpolazzjoni tas-serje taż-żmien tal-kopertura tal-borra fi ħdan is-sena idroloġika (użati fejn l-osservazzjonijiet ibbażati fuq is-Sentinel-2 għandhom lakuni).

Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags..msgid: Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags. The default visualisation displays the areas where wet snow detection is performed (high elevation, non-forested, non-urban, non-water areas). These correspond to pixels where bit 7 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Saff bitmask b’flags tal-kwalità tal-pikseli. Il-viżwalizzazzjoni awtomatika turi ż-żoni fejn titwettaq id-detezzjoni tal-borra mxarrba (elevazzjoni għolja, mhux foresti, mhux urbani, żoni mhux tal-ilma). Dawn jikkorrispondu għal pikseli fejn il-bit 7 huwa attivat. Informazzjoni addizzjonali tista’ tiġi viżwalizzata wkoll billi jintgħażlu bits oħra. Aktar dettalji huma disponibbli fl-għażla </> Personalizzat.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 100m information on the broadleaved cover density.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 100m informazzjoni dwar id-densità tal-kopertura tal-weraq wiesa’.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 100 m information on the coniferous cover density.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 100 m informazzjoni dwar id-densità tal-kopertura tal-koniferi.

Provides at a pan-European level the For.msgid: Provides at a pan-European level the Forest Type estimation at 100 meter spatial resolution.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew l-istima tat-Tip ta’ Foresta b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 100 metru.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 100 m the percentage of grassland coverage within each 100 m cell.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 100 m il-perċentwal tal-kopertura tal-mergħat fi ħdan kull ċellula ta’ 100 m.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 100 m the level of tree cover density in a range from 0% to 100%.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 100 m il-livell tad-densità tal-kopertura tas-siġar f’firxa minn 0% sa 100%.

Provides at pan-European level the harve.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the harvest date of the main growing season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew id-data tal-ħsad tal-istaġun ewlieni tat-tkabbir b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for main crop harvest.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għall-ħsad tal-għalla ewlenija.

Water presence frequency in a hydrologic.msgid: Water presence frequency in a hydrological year (in days).

Classified layer, differentiating the cl.msgid: Classified layer, differentiating the classes of permanent water (1), temporary water (2), and dry areas (0). The dataset can also have the following values: cloud or cloud shadow (205), sea water (253), or no data (255).
msgstr: Saff ikklassifikat, li jiddifferenzja bejn il-klassijiet ta’ ilma permanenti (1), ilma temporanju (2), u żoni niexfa (0). Is-sett tad-data jista’ jkollu wkoll il-valuri li ġejjin: sħab jew dell tas-sħab (205), ilma tal-baħar (253), jew l-ebda data (255).

Occurrence of water areas throughout the.msgid: Occurrence of water areas throughout the entire observation period (between 0 and 100).
msgstr: Okkorrenza ta’ żoni tal-ilma matul il-perjodu kollu tal-osservazzjoni (bejn 0 u 100).

Quality layer providing an assessment of.msgid: Quality layer providing an assessment of the water layer (WL) quality (between 0 and 100).
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni tal-kwalità tas-saff tal-ilma (WL) (bejn 0 u 100).

Number of days of ice cover on water dur.msgid: Number of days of ice cover on water during the hydrological year.
msgstr: In-numru ta’ jiem ta’ kopertura tas-silġ fuq l-ilma matul is-sena idroloġika.

Quality layer providing a basic assessme.msgid: Quality layer providing a basic assessment of the water cover duration layer.
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni bażika tas-saff tat-tul tal-kopertura tal-ilma.

Quality layer providing a basic assessme.msgid: Quality layer providing a basic assessment of the ice cover duration layer.
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni bażika tas-saff tat-tul tal-kopertura tas-silġ.

Number of days with Sentinel-1 based obs.msgid: Number of days with Sentinel-1 based observations used in the interpolation of the ice cover time series within the hydrological year.
msgstr: In-numru ta’ jiem b’osservazzjonijiet ibbażati fuq is-Sentinel-1 użati fl-interpolazzjoni tas-serje taż-żmien tal-kopertura tas-silġ fi ħdan is-sena idroloġika.

Number of days with Sentinel-2 based obs.msgid: Number of days with Sentinel-2 based observations used in the interpolation of the ice cover time series within the hydrological year.
msgstr: In-numru ta’ jiem b’osservazzjonijiet ibbażati fuq is-Sentinel-2 użati fl-interpolazzjoni tas-serje taż-żmien tal-kopertura tas-silġ fi ħdan is-sena idroloġika.

Water and ice cover classification from.msgid: Water and ice cover classification from Sentinel-1 imagery within water bodies defined by the input water mask. Classes include open water (1), snow-covered or snow-free ice (100), radar limitations such as shadow, layover, or foreshortening (200), and no data (255).
msgstr: Klassifikazzjoni tal-kopertura tal-ilma u tas-silġ minn immaġini Sentinel-1 fi ħdan korpi tal-ilma definiti mill-maskra tal-ilma tal-input. Il-klassijiet jinkludu ilma miftuħ (1), silġ mgħotti bil-borra jew mingħajr borra (100), limitazzjonijiet tar-radar bħal dell, layover, jew foreshortening (200), u l-ebda data (255).

Provides at pan-European level the emerg.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the emergence date of the main growing season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew id-data tat-tfaċċar tal-istaġun ewlieni tat-tkabbir b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m u MMU ta’ 0.25 ha.

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the Water/Ice Cover layer.
msgstr: Saff tal-kwalità li jipprovdi valutazzjoni bażika tas-saff tal-Kopertura tal-Ilma/Silġ.

The default visualisation highlights inl.msgid: The default visualisation highlights inland water surfaces over which the water/ice classification is performed; these correspond to pixels where bit 15 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Il-viżwalizzazzjoni awtomatika tenfasizza l-uċuh tal-ilma intern fuqhom titwettaq il-klassifikazzjoni tal-ilma/silġ; dawn jikkorrispondu għal pikseli fejn il-bit 15 huwa attivat. Informazzjoni addizzjonali tista’ tiġi viżwalizzata wkoll billi jintgħażlu bits oħra. Aktar dettalji huma disponibbli fl-għażla </> Personalizzat.

Extent of open-water and ice across the.msgid: Extent of open-water and ice across the continent derived from Sentinel-2 optical imagery. A water mask is applied to distinguish snow on ice-covered water bodies from snow on land. The primary classes are open water (1), snow-covered or snow-free ice (100), and other features (254), which include land, vegetation, salt seas, and other surface types. The dataset has also the following classes for areas where water/ice classification cannot be determined from Sentinel-2 optical imagery: cloud or cloud shadow (205), and no data (255).
msgstr: Estensjoni tal-ilma miftuħ u tas-silġ madwar il-kontinent derivata minn immaġini ottika tas-Sentinel-2. Tiġi applikata maskra tal-ilma biex tiddistingwi l-borra fuq korpi tal-ilma mgħottija bis-silġ mill-borra fuq l-art. Il-klassijiet primarji huma ilma miftuħ (1), silġ mgħotti bil-borra jew mingħajr borra (100), u karatteristiċi oħra (254), li jinkludu l-art, il-veġetazzjoni, il-ibħra mielħa, u tipi oħra ta’ uċuh. Is-sett tad-data għandu wkoll il-klassijiet li ġejjin għal żoni fejn il-klassifikazzjoni tal-ilma/silġ ma tistax tiġi ddeterminata minn immaġini ottika tas-Sentinel-2: sħab jew dell tas-sħab (205), u l-ebda data (255).

The default visualisation indicates whet.msgid: The default visualisation indicates whether a pixel is located in the hillshade; these correspond to pixels where bit 0 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Il-viżwalizzazzjoni awtomatika tindika jekk pixel jinsabx fid-dell tal-għolja (hillshade); dawn jikkorrispondu għal pikseli fejn il-bit 0 huwa attivat. Informazzjoni addizzjonali tista’ tiġi viżwalizzata wkoll billi jintgħażlu bits oħra. Aktar dettalji huma disponibbli fl-għażla </> Personalizzat.

Confidence level of the Random Forest cl.msgid: Confidence level of the Random Forest classifier for the class assigned in the WIC layer (0-100%).
msgstr: Livell ta’ kunfidenza tal-klassifikatur Random Forest għall-klassi assenjata fis-saff WIC (0-100%).

Water and ice cover classification from.msgid: Water and ice cover classification from Sentinel-2 (optical) or Sentinel-1 (radar) imagery within water bodies defined by the input water mask. The primary classes are open water (1), snow-covered or snow-free ice (100), and other features (254), which include land, vegetation, salt seas, and other surface types. When classification is not possible, specific values indicate radar-related limitations (shadow, layover, foreshortening - 200), cloud or cloud shadow in optical images (205), or no data (255).
msgstr: Klassifikazzjoni tal-kopertura tal-ilma u tas-silġ minn immaġini Sentinel-2 (ottiċi) jew Sentinel-1 (radar) fi ħdan korpi tal-ilma definiti mill-maskra tal-ilma tal-input. Il-klassijiet primarji huma ilma miftuħ (1), silġ mgħotti bil-borra jew mingħajr borra (100), u karatteristiċi oħra (254), li jinkludu l-art, il-veġetazzjoni, il-ibħra mielħa, u tipi oħra ta’ uċuh. Meta l-klassifikazzjoni mhix possibbli, valuri speċifiċi jindikaw limitazzjonijiet relatati mar-radar (dell, layover, foreshortening - 200), sħab jew dell tas-sħab f’immaġini ottiċi (205), jew l-ebda data (255).

Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags..msgid: Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags. The default visualisation displays the satellite sensor type used for the classification (optical=0 in blue, radar=1 in pink). These correspond to pixels where bit 9 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Saff bitmask b’flags tal-kwalità tal-pikseli. Il-viżwalizzazzjoni awtomatika turi t-tip ta’ sensor satellitari użat għall-klassifikazzjoni (ottiku=0 bil-blu, radar=1 bir-roża). Dawn jikkorrispondu għal pikseli fejn il-bit 9 huwa attivat. Informazzjoni addizzjonali tista’ tiġi viżwalizzata wkoll billi jintgħażlu bits oħra. Aktar dettalji huma disponibbli fl-għażla </> Personalizzat.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for main crop emergence.
msgstr: Saff ta’ kunfidenza - indikatur tal-kwalità għat-tfaċċar tal-għalla ewlenija.

Provides an annually updated, pan-Europe.msgid: Provides an annually updated, pan-European spatially consistent and seamless geospatial proxy for the 6 main land use categories (and some sub-categories) as reported for the LULUCF regulation (Land Use, Land Use Change and Forestry) by the countries. Each pixel is corresponding to the 6 main LULUCF land use categories but including sub-categories the product has 27 classes. The dataset is available as a 100 m raster.
msgstr: Jipprovdi proxy ġeospazjali pan-Ewropew, aġġornat kull sena, konsistenti spazjalment u bla ħjata għas-6 kategoriji ewlenin tal-użu tal-art (u xi sottokategoriji) kif irrappurtati għar-regolament LULUCF (Użu tal-Art, Bidla fl-Użu tal-Art u Forestrija) mill-pajjiżi. Kull pixel jikkorrispondi għas-6 kategoriji ewlenin tal-użu tal-art LULUCF iżda b’inklużjoni tas-sottokategoriji l-prodott għandu 27 klassi. Is-sett tad-data huwa disponibbli bħala raster ta’ 100 m.

# True Color\n\nThis True color script u.msgid:
# True Color

This True color script uses the visible light bands red, green and blue in the corresponding red, green and blue color channels, resulting in a natural colored product, that is a good representation of the Earth as humans would see it naturally. For Sentinel-2 L2A Quarterly Cloudless Mosaic, contrast enhancement with highlight compression and saturation enhancement were applied for better visualisation.

# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)

The normalized difference vegetation index is a simple, but effective index for quantifying green vegetation. It is a measure of the state of vegetation health based on how plants reflect light at certain wavelengths. The value range of the NDVI is -1 to 1. Negative values of NDVI (values approaching -1) correspond to water. Values close to zero (-0.1 to 0.1) generally correspond to barren areas of rock, sand, or snow. Low, positive values represent shrub and grassland (approximately 0.2 to 0.4), while high values indicate temperate and tropical rainforests (values approaching 1). For Sentinel-2, the NDVI is calculated using NIR band B08 and red band B04: NDVI = (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04).



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/ndvi/).
msgstr:
# Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Veġetazzjoni (NDVI)

L-indiċi tad-differenza normalizzata tal-veġetazzjoni huwa indiċi sempliċi, iżda effettiv, għall-kwantifikazzjoni tal-veġetazzjoni ħadra. Huwa miżura tal-istat tas-saħħa tal-veġetazzjoni bbażata fuq kif il-pjanti jirriflettu d-dawl f’ċerti tuli tal-mewġ. Il-firxa tal-valuri tal-NDVI hija minn -1 sa 1. Valuri negattivi tal-NDVI (valuri qrib -1) jikkorrispondu għall-ilma. Valuri qrib iż-żero (-0.1 sa 0.1) ġeneralment jikkorrispondu għal żoni sterili ta’ blat, ramel, jew borra. Valuri baxxi, pożittivi jirrappreżentaw arbuxelli u mergħat (madwar 0.2 sa 0.4), filwaqt li valuri għoljin jindikaw foresti tropikali u temperati (valuri qrib 1). Għas-Sentinel-2, l-NDVI jiġi kkalkulat bl-użu tal-band NIR B08 u tal-band l-aħmar B04: NDVI = (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04).



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/ndvi/).

# Normalized Difference Water Index (NDW.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI)

The normalized difference water index is most appropriate for water body mapping. It uses green and near infrared bands to highlight water bodies, as water strongly absorbs light in the visible to infrared spectrum. Values of water bodies are larger than 0.5. Vegetation has smaller values. Built-up features have positive values between zero and 0.2. The index is sensitive to built-up land and can result in over-estimation of water bodies. For Sentinel-2, the NDWI is calculated using green band B03 and NIR band B08: NDWI = (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08).



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/ndwi/).
msgstr:
# Indiċi tad-Differenza Normalizzata tal-Ilma (NDWI)

L-indiċi tad-differenza normalizzata tal-ilma huwa l-aktar xieraq għall-immappjar ta’ korpi tal-ilma. Juża l-bandi aħdar u infra-ħomor qrib biex jenfasizza l-korpi tal-ilma, peress li l-ilma jassorbi bil-qawwa d-dawl fl-ispettru viżibbli sal-infra-aħmar. Il-valuri tal-korpi tal-ilma huma akbar minn 0.5. Il-veġetazzjoni għandha valuri iżgħar. Karatteristiċi mibnija għandhom valuri pożittivi bejn żero u 0.2. L-indiċi huwa sensittiv għall-art mibnija u jista’ jirriżulta f’sovrastima tal-korpi tal-ilma. Għas-Sentinel-2, l-NDWI jiġi kkalkulat bl-użu tal-band aħdar B03 u tal-band NIR B08: NDWI = (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08).



Aktar info [hawnhekk](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/ndwi/).

# S6 (2.25 µm SWIR)

The Sentinel-3 SYNERGY SY_2_SYN product combines data from the OLCI and SLSTR instruments to provide atmospherically corrected surface reflectances over land at 300 m resolution. The S6 band is the SLSTR shortwave infrared channel centered at 2250 nm and is available in both nadir and oblique views. It contributes to aerosol retrieval and surface directional reflectance, and is useful for distinguishing vegetation, bare soil, snow, ice, and minerals.

Il-band S6 hija l-kanal infra-aħmar tal-mewġ qasir tal-SLSTR iċċentrat f’2250 nm u hija disponibbli kemm f’veduti nadir kif ukoll f’veduti oblikwi. The product availability indicates wheth.msgid:
The product availability indicates whether a product can be downloaded immediately (*Immediate*) or must first be processed in the user's workspace (*To order*). The workspace offers processing options for:
- Sentinel-1 Level-1 SLC and
- Sentinel-2 L2A.

The *To order* filter should therefore only be used when searching for one of these two product types.
msgstr:
Id-disponibbiltà tal-prodott tindika jekk prodott jistax jiġi ttniżżel immedjatament (*Immedjat*) jew jekk irid l-ewwel jiġi pproċessat fl-ispazju tax-xogħol tal-utent (*Biex jiġi ordnat*). L-ispazju tax-xogħol joffri għażliet ta’ pproċessar għal:
- Sentinel-1 Level-1 SLC u
- Sentinel-2 L2A.

Il-filtru *Biex jiġi ordnat* għalhekk għandu jintuża biss meta tfittex wieħed minn dawn iż-żewġ tipi ta’ prodotti.

The available Sentinel-1 data includes p.msgid: The available Sentinel-1 data includes products from the Sentinel-1 satellite constellation, including Sentinel-1A (operational since 2014), Sentinel-1B (operational from 2016 to 2022), Sentinel-1C (operational since 2025), Sentinel-1D (operational since 2026).
msgstr: Id-data disponibbli tas-Sentinel-1 tinkludi prodotti mill-kostellazzjoni tas-satelliti Sentinel-1, inklużi Sentinel-1A (operazzjonali mill-2014), Sentinel-1B (operazzjonali mill-2016 sal-2022), Sentinel-1C (operazzjonali mill-2025), Sentinel-1D (operazzjonali mill-2026).

Determines whether the data was recorded.msgid: Determines whether the data was recorded during a descending orbit (flight direction: north - south) or an ascending orbit (flight direction: south - north).
msgstr: Jiddetermina jekk id-data ġietx irreġistrata matul orbita dixxendenti (direzzjoni tat-titjira: tramuntana - nofsinhar) jew orbita axxendenti (direzzjoni tat-titjira: nofsinhar - tramuntana).

The Relative Orbit Number is the number.msgid: The Relative Orbit Number is the number of full orbits (between successive ascending node crossings through the Equator) since the relative orbit 1 to the end of a cycle. The relative orbit 1 is the orbit whose ascending node crossing is closest to the Greenwich Meridian. Sentinel-1 is in a near-polar, sun-synchronous orbit with a repeat cycle of 12 days and 175 orbits per cycle for a single satellite.
msgstr: In-Numru tal-Orbita Relattiva huwa n-numru ta’ orbiti sħaħ (bejn qsim suċċessiv tan-nodu axxendenti permezz tal-Ekwatur) mill-orbita relattiva 1 sa tmiem ċiklu. L-orbita relattiva 1 hija l-orbita li l-qsim tan-nodu axxendenti tagħha huwa l-eqreb tal-Meridjan ta’ Greenwich. Is-Sentinel-1 qiegħed f’orbita kważi polari u sinkronizzata max-xemx b’ċiklu ta’ ripetizzjoni ta’ 12-il jum u 175 orbita għal kull ċiklu għal satellita waħda.

Sentinel-1 operates in 4 exclusive instr.msgid:
Sentinel-1 operates in 4 exclusive instrument acquisition modes. Depending on the instrument mode, the data products may be available in different polarisation, resolution and swath withs (between 20 km and 410 km). The four different modes are:
- Stripmap (SM) 
- Interferometric Wide swath (IW)
- Extra-Wide swath (EW)
- Wave (WV)
msgstr:
Is-Sentinel-1 joperaw f’4 modalitajiet esklussivi ta’ akkwiżizzjoni tal-istrument. Skont il-modalità tal-istrument, il-prodotti tad-data jistgħu jkunu disponibbli f’polarizzazzjoni, riżoluzzjoni u wisgħat tal-faxxa differenti (bejn 20 km u 410 km). L-erba’ modalitajiet differenti huma:
- Stripmap (SM) 
- Interferometric Wide swath (IW)
- Extra-Wide swath (EW)
- Wave (WV)

Depending on the acquistion mode, the fo.msgid:
Depending on the acquistion mode, the following swaths and identifiers are possible:
- S1-S6 for SM mode (currently the only supported option)
- IW1-IW3 for IW mode
- EW1-EW5 for EW mode
- WV1-WV2 for WV mode
msgstr:
Skont il-modalità ta’ akkwiżizzjoni, huma possibbli l-faxex u l-identifikaturi li ġejjin:
- S1-S6 għall-modalità SM (bħalissa l-unika għażla appoġġjata)
- IW1-IW3 għall-modalità IW
- EW1-EW5 għall-modalità EW
- WV1-WV2 għall-modalità WV

Determines with which polarisation the d.msgid:
Determines with which polarisation the data was acquired. The first letter indicates the polarisation when sending the signal, the second letter when receiving the signal, e.g., HV = horizontal polarisation when sending the signal and vertical polarisation when receiving.

Data can be acquired in single polarisation HH (SH) or VV (SV) or in dual polarisation HH&HV (DH) or VV&VH (DV), depending on the instrument mode.

SM, IW and EW can be acquired in single or dual polarisation. WV can only be acquired in single polarisation.
msgstr:
Jiddetermina b’liema polarizzazzjoni nkisbet id-data. L-ewwel ittra tindika l-polarizzazzjoni meta tintbagħat is-sinjal, it-tieni ittra meta jiġi rċevut is-sinjal, eż., HV = polarizzazzjoni orizzontali meta tintbagħat is-sinjal u polarizzazzjoni vertikali meta jiġi rċevut.

Id-data tista’ tinkiseb f’polarizzazzjoni waħda HH (SH) jew VV (SV) jew f’polarizzazzjoni doppja HH&HV (DH) jew VV&VH (DV), skont il-modalità tal-istrument.

SM, IW u EW jistgħu jinkisbu f’polarizzazzjoni waħda jew doppja. WV jista’ jinkiseb biss f’polarizzazzjoni waħda.

Only applies for Level-1 GRD products an.msgid:
Only applies for Level-1 GRD products and varies depending on the acquisition mode:
- 3.5 m pixel spacing (full resolution: only SM mode) 
- 10 m pixel spacing (high resolution: SW, IW mode)
- 25 m pixel spacing (high resolution: EW mode; medium resolution: WV mode)
- 40 m pixel spacing (medium resolution: SM, IW, EW mode)
msgstr:
Japplika biss għal prodotti Level-1 GRD u jvarja skont il-modalità ta’ akkwiżizzjoni:
- spazjar tal-pikseli ta’ 3.5 m (riżoluzzjoni sħiħa: modalità SM biss) 
- spazjar tal-pikseli ta’ 10 m (riżoluzzjoni għolja: modalità SW, IW)
- spazjar tal-pikseli ta’ 25 m (riżoluzzjoni għolja: modalità EW; riżoluzzjoni medja: modalità WV)
- spazjar tal-pikseli ta’ 40 m (riżoluzzjoni medja: modalità SM, IW, EW)

Depending on the processing level differ.msgid:
Depending on the processing level different product classes are available:
- Standard (S): all processing levels
- Calibration (C): Level-0 products 
- Noise (N): Level-0 products
- Annotation (A): Level-1 and Level-2 products
msgstr:
Skont il-livell tal-ipproċessar huma disponibbli klassijiet differenti ta’ prodotti:
- Standard (S): il-livelli kollha tal-ipproċessar
- Kalibrazzjoni (C): prodotti Level-0 
- Ħoss (N): prodotti Level-0
- Annotazzjoni (A): prodotti Level-1 u Level-2

The available Sentinel-2 data includes p.msgid: The available Sentinel-2 data includes products from the Sentinel-2 satellite constellation, including Sentinel-2A (operational since 2015) and Sentinel-2B (operational since  2017).
msgstr: Id-data disponibbli tas-Sentinel-2 tinkludi prodotti mill-kostellazzjoni tas-satelliti Sentinel-2, inklużi Sentinel-2A (operazzjonali mill-2015) u Sentinel-2B (operazzjonali mill-2017).

The Relative Orbit Number is the number.msgid: The Relative Orbit Number is the number of full orbits (between sucessive ascending node crossings through the Equator) since the relative orbit 1 until the end of a cycle. The relative orbit 1 is the orbit whose ascending node crossing is closest to the Greenwich Meridian. Sentinel-2 is in a sun-synchronous orbit with a 10-day repeat cycle (5-days with both satellites) and 143 orbits per cycle.
msgstr: In-Numru tal-Orbita Relattiva huwa n-numru ta’ orbiti sħaħ (bejn qsim suċċessiv tan-nodu axxendenti permezz tal-Ekwatur) mill-orbita relattiva 1 sa tmiem ċiklu. Sentinel-3 data is available in the fol.msgid:
Sentinel-3 data is  available in the following timeliness:
- Near Real Time (NRT):  typically available within 3 hours after data acquisition
- Short Time Critical (STC): typically available within 48 hours after data acquisition
- Non Time Critical (NTC): typically available within 1 months after data acquisition
msgstr:
Id-data tas-Sentinel-3 hija disponibbli fil-ħinijiet ta’ disponibbiltà li ġejjin:
- Ħin Qrib it-Tfaċċar (NRT): tipikament disponibbli fi żmien 3 sigħat wara l-akkwiżizzjoni tad-data
- Ħin Kritiku Qasir (STC): tipikament disponibbli fi żmien 48 siegħa wara l-akkwiżizzjoni tad-data

The Relative Orbit Number is the number.msgid: The Relative Orbit Number is the number of full orbits (between successive ascending node crossings through the Equator) since the relative orbit 1 until the end of a cycle. msgstr: In-Numru tal-Orbita Relattiva huwa n-numru ta’ orbiti sħaħ (bejn qsim suċċessiv tan-nodu axxendenti mill-Ekwatur) mill-orbita relattiva 1 sa tmiem ċiklu. Is-Sentinel-3 jinsab f’orbita kważi polari u sinkronizzata mix-xemx b’ċiklu ta’ ripetizzjoni ta’ 27 jum.

The timeliness provides information abou.msgid:

msgstr:
Il-ħin ta’ disponibbiltà jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar il-ħin tal-kunsinna tal-prodott tad-data. Għas-Sentinel-5P hemm 3 ħinijiet ta’ disponibbiltà differenti:

- Offline: skont il-prodott, fi żmien 12-il siegħa għall-prodotti tal-Livell 1B

A complete archive of Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, Sentinel-5P, Sentinel-6,

# Merħba fil-Copernicus Browser!
