[Dwar il-paġna tal-Copernicus Browser](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Applications/Browser.html)  
[Kollezzjonijiet tad-data disponibbli](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/explore-data/data-collections)

#### Quick overview of Copernicus Browse.msgid: #### Quick overview of Copernicus Browser features Copernicus Browser serves as a central hub for accessing, exploring and utilising the wealth of Earth observation and environmental data provided by the Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, Sentinel-5P, Sentinel-6, Copernicus Contributing Missions (Optical, SAR and DEM), and Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 Global Mosaics (see details [here](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data.html)). You simply go to your area of interest, select data sources, time range and cloud coverage, and inspect the resulting data. You can continue the tutorial by clicking on the "Next" button or you can close it. By clicking the info icon in the top right corner you can always resume the tutorial in case you closed it by mistake or because you wanted to try something out.
msgstr: #### Ħarsa ġenerali ta’ malajr lejn il-karatteristiċi tal-Copernicus Browser Il-Copernicus Browser jservi bħala ċentru ċentrali għall-aċċess, l-esplorazzjoni u l-użu tal-ġid ta’ data dwar l-osservazzjoni tad-Dinja u l-ambjent ipprovdut mis-Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, Sentinel-5P, Sentinel-6, mill-Missjonijiet Kontributuri tal-Copernicus (Ottiku, SAR u DEM), u mill-Mużajki Globali tas-Sentinel-1 u s-Sentinel-2 (ara d-dettalji [hawn](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data.html)). Sempliċement tmur fiż-żona ta’ interess tiegħek, tagħżel is-sorsi tad-data, il-firxa taż-żmien u l-kopertura tas-sħab, u tispezzjona d-data li tirriżulta. Tista’ tkompli bit-tutorja billi tikklikkja fuq il-buttuna "Li jmiss" jew tista’ tagħlaqha. Billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tal-informazzjoni fir-rokna ta’ fuq tal-lemin tista’ dejjem tkompli t-tutorja f’każ li agħlaqtha bi żball jew għax xtaqt tipprova xi ħaġa.

Anonymous use of the Browser gives you a.msgid:
Anonymous use of the Browser gives you access with limited functionality. To be able to use all functions, you need a free account. 
**Logged-in users** can use their custom themes, save and load pins, measure distances, create a timelapse and use the extended image download.
msgstr:
L-użu anonimu tal-Browser jagħtik aċċess b’funzjonalità limitata. Biex tkun tista’ tuża l-funzjonijiet kollha, għandek bżonn kont b’xejn. 
L-**utenti li jkunu dħalu** jistgħu jużaw it-temi personalizzati tagħhom, isalvaw u jtellgħu pins, ikejlu distanzi, joħolqu time-lapse u jużaw it-tniżżil estiż tal-immaġni.

In the **Visualise tab** you can:\n- Sea.msgid:
In the **Visualise tab** you can:
- Search for a **Date**.
- Select a **Theme**.
- Choose a **Collection**.
- Select a **Visualisation Layer**.

You can change the **Date** (type in or select it from the calendar) and set the cloud coverage. You can choose between 
single date, mosaic and time range: ![Single](icon) ![Mosaic](icon) ![Time Range](icon).

The **Configurations** dropdown offers you different preconfigured themes and your own custom configured instances if
you are logged in. To create an instance, go to your [personal dashboard](https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/).

You can select a desired data source in the **Data Collections**. You can read explanations of the satellites by clicking 
on the information icon next to the name of the data collection. Here you can also switch between different panels: 
![Layers](icon) Layers, ![Highlights](icon) Highlights, ![Compare mode](icon) Compare mode and ![Pins](icon) Pins.
msgstr:
Fit-**tab Viżwalizza** tista’:
- Tfittex **Data**.
- Tagħżel **Tema**.
- Tagħżel **Kollezzjoni**.
- Tagħżel **Saff ta’ Viżwalizzazzjoni**.

Tista’ tibdel id-**Data** (billi tiktibha jew tagħżilha mill-kalendarju) u tissettja l-kopertura tas-sħab. Tista’ tagħżel bejn 
data waħda, mużajk u firxa taż-żmien: ![Single](icon) ![Mosaic](icon) ![Time Range](icon).

Il-lista li tinfetaħ tal-**Konfigurazzjonijiet** toffrilek temi differenti ppreconfigurati u l-istanzi personalizzati tiegħek stess jekk
kont dħalt. Biex toħloq istanza, mur fid-[dashboard personali tiegħek](https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/).

Tista’ tagħżel is-sors tad-data mixtieq fil-**Kollezzjonijiet tad-Data**. Tista’ taqra spjegazzjonijiet dwar is-satelliti billi tikklikkja 
fuq l-ikona tal-informazzjoni ħdejn l-isem tal-kollezzjoni tad-data. Hawnhekk tista’ wkoll taqleb bejn paneli differenti: 
![Layers](icon) Saffi, ![Highlights](icon) Highlights, ![Compare mode](icon) Modalità ta’ paragun u ![Pins](icon) Pins.

You can select different pre-installed o.msgid: You can select different pre-installed or custom spectral band combinations to visualise data for the selected result. Some of the common options: - **True Color** - Visual interpretation of land cover - **False Color** - Visual interpretation of vegetation - **NDVI** - Vegetation index - **Moisture index** - Moisture index - **SWIR** - Shortwave-infrared index - **NDWI** - Normalized Difference Water Index - **NDSI** - Normalized Difference Snow Index Most visualisations are given a description and a legend, which you can view by clicking on the expand sign ![expand](icon). Each of the layers offers an option to add it to Compare or Pins by clicking Add to. Based on your action, the Compare and Pins panels will include added layers ![compare-with-badge](icon) ![pins-with-badge](icon) which you can further organise and analyse under each tab. Click on the **Custom visualisation** option to select custom band combinations, index combinations or write your own classification script for the visualisation of data. You can also use custom scripts, which are stored elsewhere, either on Google Drive, GitHub or in our [Custom script repository](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/). Paste the URL of the script into the text box in the advanced script editing panel and click Refresh. The custom script of preconfigured layers can be edited by choosing the code icon ![code-icon](icon). You can select **Show effects and advanced options** like the sampling method, advanced RGB effects or apply contrast (gain) and luminance (gamma). To return to preconfigured layers, click **Show visualisations**. **Share** your visualisation on social media by clicking on the share icon .
msgstr: Tista’ tagħżel kombinazzjonijiet differenti ta’ bandi spettrali li huma diġà installati jew personalizzati biex tviżwalizza d-data għar-riżultat magħżul. Xi għażliet komuni: - **True Color** - Interpretazzjoni viżwali tal-kopertura tal-art - **False Color** - Interpretazzjoni viżwali tal-veġetazzjoni - **NDVI** - Indiċi tal-veġetazzjoni - **Moisture index** - Indiċi tal-umdità - **SWIR** - Indiċi tal-infra-aħmar tal-mewġ qasir - **NDWI** - Normalized Difference Water Index - **NDSI** - Normalized Difference Snow Index Il-biċċa l-kbira tal-viżwalizzazzjonijiet jingħataw deskrizzjoni u leġenda, li tista’ tarahom billi tikklikkja fuq is-sinjal tat-twessigħ ![expand](icon). Kull wieħed mis-saffi joffri għażla biex jiżdied mal-Paragun jew mal-Pins billi tikklikkja Żid ma’. Skont l-azzjoni tiegħek, il-paneli tal-Paragun u tal-Pins se jinkludu s-saffi miżjuda ![compare-with-badge](icon) ![pins-with-badge](icon) li tista’ tkompli torganizza u tanalizza taħt kull tab. Ikklikkja fuq l-għażla **Viżwalizzazzjoni personalizzata** biex tagħżel kombinazzjonijiet personalizzati ta’ bandi, kombinazzjonijiet ta’ indiċi jew tikteb l-iskript tiegħek ta’ klassifikazzjoni għall- viżwalizzazzjoni tad-data. Tista’ wkoll tuża skripts personalizzati, li jinħażnu x’imkien ieħor, jew fuq Google Drive, GitHub jew fir- [repożitorju tagħna tal-iskripts personalizzati](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/). Waħħal l-URL tal-iskript fil-kaxxa tat-test fil-pannell avvanzat tal-editjar tal-iskripts u kklikkja Refresh. L-iskript personalizzat tas-saffi ppreconfigurati jista’ jiġi editjat billi tagħżel l-ikona tal-kodiċi ![code-icon](icon). Tista’ tagħżel **Uri l-effetti u l-għażliet avvanzati** bħall-metodu tal-kampjunar, effetti avvanzati tal-RGB jew tapplika kuntrast (gain) u luminanza (gamma). Biex terġa’ lura għas-saffi ppreconfigurati, ikklikkja **Uri l-viżwalizzazzjonijiet**. **Aqsam** il-viżwalizzazzjoni tiegħek fuq il-midja soċjali billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tal-qsim .

If you choose one of the preconfigured t.msgid:
If you choose one of the preconfigured themes under **Configurations**, you will be able to select from a highlights list under the Highlights panel.

Each highlight has a description accessible under the dropdown icon ![expand-description](icon).
msgstr:
Jekk tagħżel wieħed mit-temi ppreconfigurati taħt **Konfigurazzjonijiet**, tkun tista’ tagħżel minn lista ta’ highlights taħt il-pannell Highlights.

Kull highlight għandu deskrizzjoni aċċessibbli taħt l-ikona tal-lista ![expand-description](icon).

Here you will find all visualisations th.msgid: Here you will find all visualisations that you added by clicking Add to on the layers under the Layers panel. There are two modes of comparing: - **Opacity** (drag opacity slider left or right to fade between compared images) - **Split** (drag split slider left or right to set the boundary between compared images)
msgstr: Hawnhekk issib il-viżwalizzazzjonijiet kollha li żidt billi tikklikkja Żid ma’ fuq is-saffi taħt il-pannell Saffi. Hemm żewġ modalitajiet ta’ paragun: - **Opaċità** (ċaqlaq is-slider tal-opaċità lejn ix-xellug jew lejn il-lemin biex tgħaddi gradwalment bejn l-immaġini mqabbla) - **Maqsum** (ċaqlaq is-slider tat-tqassim lejn ix-xellug jew lejn il-lemin biex tissettja l-fruntiera bejn l-immaġini mqabbla)

The **Pins** panel contains your pinned.msgid: The **Pins** panel contains your pinned (favourite/saved) items. Pinned items contain information about location, data source and its specific layer, zoom level and time. To reorder the pins, choose among the options in the **Order by** dropdown. You have several ways to interact with each pin: - Change **order** - by clicking on the move icon in the top left corner of the pin and dragging the pin up or down the list. - **Rename** - by clicking on the pencil icon ![rename](icon) next to the pin's name. - Add to the **Compare** panel - by clicking on the compare icon ![compare](icon). - Enter a **description** - by clicking on the expand icon ![expand](icon). - **Remove** - by clicking the remove icon . - **Zoom** to the pin's location - by clicking on the Lat/Lon. In the line above your pins, you have different options that apply to all pins: - Create your own story from pins - by clicking on **Story**. - Share your pins with others via a link - by clicking on **Share**. - Export pins as a JSON file - by clicking on **Export**. - Import pins from a JSON file - by clicking on **Import**. - Delete all pins - by clicking on **Clear**.
msgstr: Il-pannell **Pins** fih l-oġġetti ppinjati tiegħek (favoriti/salvati). L-oġġetti ppinjati fihom informazzjoni dwar il-post, is-sors tad-data u s-saff speċifiku tiegħu, il-livell taz-zoom u l-ħin. Biex terġa’ tordna l-pins, agħżel fost l-għażliet fil-lista **Ordna skont**. Għandek diversi modi kif tinteraġixxi ma’ kull pin: - Biddel l-**ordni** - billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tat-tqegħid fir-rokna ta’ fuq tax-xellug tal-pin u tkaxkar il-pin 'il fuq jew 'l isfel fil-lista. - **Semmi mill-ġdid** - billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tal-lapes ![rename](icon) ħdejn l-isem tal-pin. - Żid mal-pannell **Paragun** - billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tal-paragun ![compare](icon). - Daħħal **deskrizzjoni** - billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tat-twessigħ ![expand](icon). - **Neħħi** - billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tat-tneħħija . - **Zoom** fuq il-post tal-pin - billi tikklikkja fuq il-Lat/Lon. Fil-linja ’l fuq mill-pins tiegħek, għandek għażliet differenti li japplikaw għall-pins kollha: - Oħloq l-istorja tiegħek stess mill-pins - billi tikklikkja fuq **Story**. - Aqsam il-pins tiegħek ma’ oħrajn permezz ta’ link - billi tikklikkja fuq **Share**. - Esporta l-pins bħala fajl JSON - billi tikklikkja fuq **Export**. - Importa pins minn fajl JSON - billi tikklikkja fuq **Import**. - Ħassar il-pins kollha - billi tikklikkja fuq **Clear**.

The **WMS/WMTS panel** lets you add thir.msgid: The **WMS/WMTS panel** lets you add third-party map layers to Copernicus Browser via a service **GetCapabilities URL**. To **add a service** - paste its GetCapabilities URL into the input field and click the add button (or press Enter). The service and its layers appear alongside the standard collections. Once a service is loaded, you can: - View **service details** (description, access constraints and fees) - by clicking on the info icon next to the service name. - **Select** a service - by clicking on its name; the active service is marked with a checkmark and its layers are listed below. - **Remove** a service - by clicking on the remove icon . In the layer list you can **search** layers by name, page through them with the and controls, and pick how many layers to show per page. Click a layer to display it on the map. On the active layer, use **Add to** to add it to the **Compare** or **Pins** panels.
msgstr: Il-**pannell WMS/WMTS** jippermettilek iżżid saffi tal-mapep ta’ partijiet terzi mal-Copernicus Browser permezz ta’ **URL GetCapabilities** ta’ servizz. Biex **iżżid servizz** - waħħal l-URL GetCapabilities tiegħu fil-kamp tad-dħul u kklikkja l-buttuna taż-żieda (jew agħfas Enter). Is-servizz u s-saffi tiegħu jidhru flimkien mal-kollezzjonijiet standard. Meta servizz jiġi mtella’, tista’: - Tarah id-**dettalji tas-servizz** (deskrizzjoni, restrizzjonijiet ta’ aċċess u miżati) - billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tal-informazzjoni ħdejn l-isem tas-servizz. - **Tagħżel** servizz - billi tikklikkja fuq l-isem tiegħu; is-servizz attiv huwa mmarkat b’sinjal ta’ ċekk u s-saffi tiegħu huma elenkati hawn taħt. - **Tneħħi** servizz - billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tat-tneħħija . Fil-lista tas-saffi tista’ **tfittex** saffi skont l-isem, tgħaddi bejn il-paġni bil-kontrolli u , u tagħżel kemm saffi juru f’paġna. Ikklikkja fuq saff biex turih fuq il-mappa. Fuq is-saff attiv, uża **Żid ma’** biex iżżidu mal-paneli **Paragun** jew **Pins**.

Under **Search** you can set:\n- **Searc.msgid: Under **Search** you can set: - **Search criteria** by a product name. - Choose from which **data sources** you want to receive the data by selecting checkboxes. Where applicable, you can also set **filters** such as satellite platform, orbit direction, relative orbit, number, acquisition mode, product availability, timeliness, etc. - Select the **time range** by either typing the date or selecting it from the calendar. If you want to omit some of the months, enable the **Filter by months** option and uncheck the non-relevant months. Once you hit Search you get a list of results. Each result is presented with a preview image and relevant data specific to the data source. For **product info** and **zooming to product**, click on the and icons. If you are logged in, you can click on ![workspace-add](icon) to **add a product to your Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem Workspace** to easily collect and process your satellite data. You can also **download the product** by clicking on the download icon . Clicking on the Visualise button will open the **Visualise** tab for the selected result.
msgstr: Taħt **Fittex** tista’ tissettja: - **Kriterji tat-tfittxija** skont isem ta’ prodott. - Agħżel minn liema **sorsi tad-data** tixtieq tirċievi d-data billi tagħżel il-kaxxi tal-għażla. Fejn applikabbli, tista’ wkoll tissettja **filtri** bħall-pjattaforma tas-satellita, id-direzzjoni tal-orbita, l-orbita relattiva, in-numru, il-modalità ta’ akkwiżizzjoni, id-disponibbiltà tal-prodott, il-ħin ta’ disponibbiltà, eċċ. - Agħżel il-**firxa taż-żmien** billi tikteb id-data jew tagħżilha mill-kalendarju. Jekk trid tħalli barra xi xhur, ixgħel l-għażla **Iffiltra skont ix-xhur** u neħħi l-immarkar tax-xhur mhux rilevanti. Meta tagħfas Fittex tikseb lista ta’ riżultati. Kull riżultat jitwassal b’immaġni ta’ ħarsa minn qabel u data rilevanti speċifika għas-sors tad-data. Għall-**informazzjoni dwar il-prodott** u biex **tagħmel zoom fuq il-prodott**, ikklikkja fuq l-ikoni u . Jekk dħalt, tista’ tikklikkja fuq ![workspace-add](icon) biex **iżżid prodott mal-Ispazju tax-xogħol tiegħek tal-Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem** biex tiġbor u tipproċessa d-data tas-satelliti tiegħek faċilment. Tista’ wkoll **tniżżel il-prodott** billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tat-tniżżil . Il-klikk fuq il-buttuna Viżwalizza se jiftaħ it-tab **Viżwalizza** għar-riżultat magħżul.

Search for a location either by scrollin.msgid: Search for a location either by scrolling the map with a mouse or by entering the location in the **Go to Place** field.
msgstr: Fittex post billi ċċaqlaq il-mappa bil-maws jew billi ddaħħal il-post fil-kamp **Mur fil-Post**.

Here you can select which base layer and.msgid: Here you can select which base layer and overlays (borders, labels) are shown on the map.
msgstr: Hawnhekk tista’ tagħżel liema saff bażiku u overlays (fruntieri, tikketti) jintwerew fuq il-mappa.

You can view the tutorial anytime by cli.msgid: You can view the tutorial anytime by clicking on this info icon .
msgstr: Tista’ tara t-tutorja f’kull ħin billi tikklikkja fuq din l-ikona tal-informazzjoni .

This tool allows you to draw a polygon o.msgid: This tool allows you to draw a polygon on the map and display the polygon's size. All layers that return a single value (such as NDVI, Moisture Index, NDWI, ...) support viewing the index for the selected area over time. Clicking the chart icon will display the statistical information charts (you need to be logged in to use this option). You can remove the polygon by clicking the remove icon . You can also upload a KML/KMZ, GPX, WKT (in EPSG:4326) or GEOJSON/JSON file with a polygon geometry using the upload icon . The two sheets icon lets you copy the polygon coordinates as a GEOJSON and the crosshair centers the map on the drawn polygon.
msgstr: Din l-għodda tippermettilek tfassal poligonu fuq il-mappa u turi d-daqs tal-poligonu. S-saffi kollha li jirritornaw valur wieħed (bħal NDVI, Moisture Index, NDWI, ...) jappoġġaw il-wiri tal-indiċi għaż-żona magħżula matul iż-żmien. Il-klikk fuq l-ikona tal-grafiku se turi l-grafiks tal-informazzjoni statistika (trid tkun dħalt biex tuża din l-għażla). Tista’ tneħħi l-poligonu billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tat-tneħħija . Tista’ wkoll tittella’ fajl KML/KMZ, GPX, WKT (f’EPSG:4326) jew GEOJSON/JSON b’ġeometrija ta’ poligonu bl-użu tal- ikona tat-tlugħ . L-ikona taż-żewġ folji tippermettilek tikkopja l-koordinati tal-poligonu bħala GEOJSON u l-crosshair iċċentra l-mappa fuq il-poligonu mfassal.

This tool allows you to draw a line on t.msgid: This tool allows you to draw a line on the map and display the line length. It also includes the **Elevation Profile**, a tool that allows you to create the altitude profile by defining a line from point A to point B. You can also upload a KML/KMZ, GPX, WKT (in EPSG:4326) or GEOJSON/JSON file using the upload icon . The two sheets icon lets you copy the line coordinates as a GEOJSON and the crosshair centers the map on the drawn line.
msgstr: Din l-għodda tippermettilek tfassal linja fuq il-mappa u turi t-tul tal-linja. Tinkludi wkoll il-**Profil tal-Elevazzjoni**, għodda li tippermettilek toħloq il-profil tal-altitudni billi tiddefinixxi linja mill-punt A sal-punt B. Tista’ wkoll tittella’ fajl KML/KMZ, GPX, WKT (f’EPSG:4326) jew GEOJSON/JSON bl-użu tal-ikona tat-tlugħ . L-ikona taż-żewġ folji tippermettilek tikkopja l-koordinati tal-linja bħala GEOJSON u l-crosshair iċċentra l-mappa fuq il-linja mfassla.

With this tool, you can mark a point on.msgid: With this tool, you can mark a point on the map. You can also view statistical data for some layers by clicking on the chart icon . You can remove the mark by clicking the remove icon .
msgstr: B’din l-għodda, tista’ timmarka punt fuq il-mappa. Tista’ wkoll tara data statistika għal xi saffi billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tal-grafiku . Tista’ tneħħi l-marka billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tat-tneħħija .

With this tool, you can measure distance.msgid: With this tool, you can measure distances and areas on the map. Every mouse click creates a new point on the path. To stop adding points, press the Esc key or double-click on the map. You can remove the measurement by clicking the remove icon .
msgstr: B’din l-għodda, tista’ tkejjel distanzi u erjas fuq il-mappa. Kull klikk tal-maws joħloq punt ġdid fuq il-mogħdija. Biex twaqqaf iż-żieda ta’ punti, agħfas iċ-ċavetta Esc jew ikklikkja darbtejn fuq il-mappa. Tista’ tneħħi l-kejl billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tat-tneħħija .

With this tool, you can download an imag.msgid: With this tool, you can download an image of visualised data for the displayed location. You can choose to show captions and you can add your own description. By enabling Analytical mode, you can choose between various image formats, image resolutions and coordinate systems. You can also select multiple layers and download them as a .zip file. Click the download button Download and your image(s) will begin to download. The process can take a few seconds, depending on the selected resolution and the number of selected layers. Before downloading, you can define an area of interest (AOI) by clicking on the Area selection tool icon ![selection](icon). Your data will be clipped to match this area.
msgstr: B’din l-għodda, tista’ tniżżel immaġni tad-data viżwalizzata għall-post muri. Tista’ tagħżel li turi didaskaliji u tista’ żżid id-deskrizzjoni tiegħek stess. Billi tattiva l-modalità Analitika, tista’ tagħżel bejn diversi formats ta’ immaġni, riżoluzzjonijiet ta’ immaġni u sistemi ta’ koordinati. Tista’ wkoll tagħżel diversi saffi u tniżżilhom bħala fajl .zip. Ikklikkja l-buttuna tat-tniżżil Niżżel u l-immaġni/jiet tiegħek se jibdew jitniżżlu. Il-proċess jista’ jieħu ftit sekondi, skont ir-riżoluzzjoni magħżula u n-numru ta’ saffi magħżula. Qabel it-tniżżil, tista’ tiddefinixxi żona ta’ interess (AOI) billi tikklikkja fuq l-ikona tal-għodda tal-għażla taż-żona ![selection](icon). Id-data tiegħek se tinqata’ biex taqbel ma’ din iż-żona.

With this tool (available to logged-in u.msgid: With this tool (available to logged-in users), you can create a timelapse animation of the visualised layer and displayed location. First, choose a time range. You can refine your search results further via the **Filter by months** checkbox and/or by selecting one image per defined period (orbit, day, week, month, year). Then press Search and select your images. You can select all by checking the checkbox or filter the images by cloud coverage by moving the slider. Or you can pick images one by one by scrolling through the list and selecting them. Via the **Borders** checkbox, you can enable/disable the borders on your image. You can preview the timelapse by pressing the play button , set the speed (frames per second) and transition mode, all available at the bottom of the screen. See additional settings by clicking the settings icon . When you are satisfied with the result, click the download button and the timelapse will be downloaded as a .gif or .mp4 file.
msgstr: B’din l-għodda (disponibbli għall-utenti li jkunu dħalu), tista’ toħloq animazzjoni time-lapse tas-saff viżwalizzat u tal-post muri. L-ewwel, agħżel firxa taż-żmien. **Sentinel-5P** is a satellite that prov.msgid:
**Sentinel-5P** is a satellite that provides atmospheric measurements to be used for air quality, ozone monitoring, UV radiation,
and climate monitoring and forecasting.

**Spatial resolution:** 7 x 3.5km (that is, only details bigger than 7 x 3.5km can be seen).

**Revisit time:** Maximum 1 day to revisit the same area.

**Data availability:** Since April 2018 onwards.

**Common usage:** Monitoring the concentration of carbon monoxide (CO), nitrogen dioxide (NO2) and ozone (O3) in the air. Monitoring the UV aerosol index (AER_AI) and various geophysical parameters of clouds (Cloud).
msgstr:
**Sentinel-5P** huwa satellita li jipprovdi kejl atmosferiku li jintuża għall-kwalità tal-arja, il-monitoraġġ tal-ożonu, ir-radjazzjoni UV,
u l-monitoraġġ u t-tbassir tal-klima.

**Riżoluzzjoni spazjali:** 7 x 3.5km (jiġifieri, jistgħu jidhru biss dettalji akbar minn 7 x 3.5km).

**Ħin ta’ rivżita:** Massimu ta’ jum 1 biex terġa’ tiġi mżurija l-istess żona.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** Minn April 2018 'l quddiem.

**Użu komuni:** Monitoraġġ tal-konċentrazzjoni tal-monossidu tal-karbonju (CO), id-diossidu tan-nitroġenu (NO2) u l-ożonu (O3) fl-arja. Monitoraġġ tal-indiċi tal-aerosol UV (AER_AI) u diversi parametri ġeofiżiċi tas-sħab (Cloud).

### Ozone (O3)\n\n\n\nOzone is of crucia.msgid:
### Ozone (O3)



Ozone is of crucial importance for the equilibrium of the Earth atmosphere. In the stratosphere, the ozone layer shields the biosphere from dangerous solar ultraviolet radiation. In the troposphere, it acts as an efficient cleansing agent, but at high concentration it also becomes harmful to the health of humans, animals, and vegetation. Ozone is also an important greenhouse-gas contributor to ongoing climate change. Since the discovery of the Antarctic ozone hole in the 1980s and the subsequent Montreal Protocol regulating the production of chlorine-containing ozone-depleting substances, ozone has been routinely monitored from the ground and from space. Measurements are in mol per square meter (mol/ m^2)



More info [here.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-ozone-profile)
msgstr:
### Ożonu (O3)



L-ożonu huwa ta’ importanza kruċjali għall-ekwilibriju tal-atmosfera tad-Dinja. Fl-istratosfera, is-saff tal-ożonu jipproteġi l-bijosfera mir-radjazzjoni ultravjola perikoluża tax-xemx. Fit-troposfera, jaġixxi bħala aġent tat-tindif effiċjenti, iżda f’konċentrazzjoni għolja jsir ukoll ta’ ħsara għas-saħħa tal-bnedmin, l-annimali u l-veġetazzjoni. L-ożonu huwa wkoll kontributur importanti ta’ gass b’effett ta’ serra għat-tibdil fil-klima li għaddej bħalissa. Mindu nstab it-toqba tal-ożonu tal-Antartiku fis-snin tmenin u l-Protokoll ta’ Montreal sussegwenti li jirregola l-produzzjoni ta’ sustanzi li jnaqqsu l-ożonu li fihom il-kloru, l-ożonu ilu jiġi mmonitorjat b’mod regolari mill-art u mill-ispazju. Il-kejl huwa f’mol għal kull metru kwadru (mol/ m^2)



Iktar tagħrif [hawn.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-ozone-profile)

### Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2)\n\n\n\nNitrog.msgid:
### Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2)



Nitrogen dioxide (NO2) and nitrogen oxide (NO) together are usually referred to as nitrogen oxides. They are important trace gases in the Earth’s atmosphere, present in both the troposphere and the stratosphere. They enter the atmosphere as a result of anthropogenic activities (particularly fossil fuel combustion and biomass burning) and natural processes (such as microbiological processes in soils, wildfires and lightning). Measurements are in mol per square meter (mol/ m^2).



More info [here.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-nitrogen-dioxide)
msgstr:
### Diossidu tan-Nitroġenu (NO2)



Id-diossidu tan-nitroġenu (NO2) u l-ossidu tan-nitroġenu (NO) flimkien normalment jissejjaħ ossidi tan-nitroġenu. Huma gassijiet ta’ traċċa importanti fl-atmosfera tad-Dinja, preżenti kemm fit-troposfera kif ukoll fl-istratosfera. Jidħlu fl-atmosfera bħala riżultat ta’ attivitajiet antropoġeniċi (b’mod partikolari l-ħruq tal-fjuwils fossili u tal-bijomassa) u proċessi naturali (bħall-proċessi mikrobijoloġiċi fil-ħamrija, in-nirien tal-foresti u l-beraq). Il-kejl huwa f’mol għal kull metru kwadru (mol/ m^2).



Iktar tagħrif [hawn.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-nitrogen-dioxide)

### Sulfur Dioxide (SO2)\n\n\n\nSulphur.msgid:
### Sulfur Dioxide (SO2)



Sulphur dioxide enters the Earth’s atmosphere through both natural and anthropogenic (human made) processes. It plays a role in chemistry on a local and global scale and its impact ranges from short term pollution to effects on climate. Only about 30% of the emitted SO2 comes from natural sources; the majority is of anthropogenic origin. Sentinel-5P/TROPOMI instrument samples the Earth’s surface with a revisit time of one day with a spatial resolution of 3.5 x 7 km which allows the resolution of fine details including the detection of smaller SO2 plumes. Measurements are in mol per square meter (mol/ m^2).



More info [here.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-sulphur-dioxide)
msgstr:
### Diossidu tal-Kubrit (SO2)



Id-diossidu tal-kubrit jidħol fl-atmosfera tad-Dinja kemm permezz ta’ proċessi naturali kif ukoll antropoġeniċi (magħmula mill-bniedem). Għandu rwol fil-kimika fuq skala lokali u globali u l-impatt tiegħu jvarja minn tniġġis fuq żmien qasir sa effetti fuq il-klima. Madwar 30% biss tal-SO2 emess ġej minn sorsi naturali; il-maġġoranza hija ta’ oriġini antropoġenika. L-istrument Sentinel-5P/TROPOMI jikkampjuna l-wiċċ tad-Dinja b’ħin ta’ rivżita ta’ jum wieħed b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 3.5 x 7 km li tippermetti r-riżoluzzjoni ta’ dettalji fini inkluża d-detezzjoni ta’ pennakki iżgħar tal-SO2. Il-kejl huwa f’mol għal kull metru kwadru (mol/ m^2).



Iktar tagħrif [hawn.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-sulphur-dioxide)

### Carbon Monoxide (CO)\n\n\n\nCarbon m.msgid:
### Carbon Monoxide (CO)



Carbon monoxide (CO) is an important atmospheric trace gas. In certain urban areas, it is a major atmospheric pollutant. Main sources of CO are combustion of fossil fuels, biomass burning, and atmospheric oxidation of methane and other hydrocarbons. The carbon monoxide total column is measured in mol per square meter (mol/ m^2).



More info [here.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-carbon-monoxide)
msgstr:
### Monossidu tal-Karbonju (CO)



Il-monossidu tal-karbonju (CO) huwa gass ta’ traċċa atmosferiku importanti. F’ċerti żoni urbani, huwa importanti ta’ tniġġis atmosferiku. Is-sorsi ewlenin tas-CO huma l-ħruq tal-fjuwils fossili, il-ħruq tal-bijomassa, u l-ossidazzjoni atmosferika tal-metan u ta’ idrokarburi oħra. Il-kolonna totali tal-monossidu tal-karbonju titkejjel f’mol għal kull metru kwadru (mol/ m^2).



Iktar tagħrif [hawn.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-carbon-monoxide)

### Formaldehyde (HCHO)\n\n\n\nLong term.msgid:
### Formaldehyde (HCHO)



Long term satellite observations of tropospheric formaldehyde (HCHO) are essential to support air quality and chemistry-climate related studies from the regional to the global scale. The seasonal and inter-annual variations of the formaldehyde distribution are principally related to temperature changes and fire events, but also to changes in anthropogenic (human-made) activities. Its lifetime being of the order of a few hours, HCHO concentrations in the boundary layer can be directly related to the release of short-lived hydrocarbons, which mostly cannot be observed directly from space. Measurements are in mol per square meter (mol/ m^2).



More info [here.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-formaldehyde)
msgstr:
### Formaldeid (HCHO)



L-osservazzjonijiet satellitari fit-tul tal-formaldeid troposferiku (HCHO) huma essenzjali biex jappoġġjaw studji relatati mal-kwalità tal-arja u l-kimika-klima mil-livell reġjonali sal-livell globali. Il-varjazzjonijiet staġjonali u bejn is-snin fid-distribuzzjoni tal-formaldeid huma relatati prinċipalment ma’ bidliet fit-temperatura u avvenimenti ta’ nar, iżda wkoll ma’ bidliet f’attivitajiet antropoġeniċi (magħmula mill-bniedem). Peress li t-tul ta’ ħajjitu huwa fl-ordni ta’ ftit sigħat, il-konċentrazzjonijiet tal-HCHO fis-saff tal-konfini jistgħu jkunu relatati direttament mar-rilaxx ta’ idrokarburi ta’ ħajja qasira, li l-aktar ma jistgħux jiġu osservati direttament mill-ispazju. Il-kejl huwa f’mol għal kull metru kwadru (mol/ m^2).



Iktar tagħrif [hawn.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-formaldehyde)

### Methane (CH4)\n\n\n\nMethane is, aft.msgid:
### Methane (CH4)



Methane is, after carbon dioxide, the most important contributor to the anthropogenically (caused by human activity) enhanced greenhouse effect. Measurements are provided in parts per billion (ppb) with a spatial resolution of 7 km x 3.5 km.



More info [here.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/tropomi-level-2-methane)
msgstr:
### Metan (CH4)



L-metan huwa, wara d-diossidu tal-karbonju, l-aktar kontributur importanti għall-effett ta’ serra mtejjeb b’mod antropoġeniku (ikkawżat mill-attività tal-bniedem). Il-kejl jingħata f’partijiet għal kull biljun (ppb) b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 7 km x 3.5 km.



Iktar tagħrif [hawn.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/tropomi-level-2-methane)

### Aerosol Index\n\nThe Aerosol Index (.msgid:
### Aerosol Index

The Aerosol Index (AI) is a qualitative index indicating the presence of elevated layers of aerosols in the atmosphere. It can be used to detect the presence of UV absorbing aerosols such as desert dust and volcanic ash plumes. Positive values (from light blue to red) indicate the presence of UV-absorbing aerosol. This index is calculated for two pairs of wavelengths: 340/380 nm and 354/388 nm.

More info [here.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-ultraviolet-aerosol-index)
msgstr:
### Indiċi tal-Aerosol

L-Indiċi tal-Aerosol (AI) huwa indiċi kwalitattiv li jindika l-preżenza ta’ saffi għolja ta’ aerosols fl-atmosfera. Jista’ jintuża biex jinstab il-preżenza ta’ aerosols li jassorbu l-UV bħat-trab tad-deżert u l-pennakki tar-rimed vulkaniku. Il-valuri pożittivi (minn blu ċar sa aħmar) jindikaw il-preżenza ta’ aerosol li jassorbi l-UV. Dan l-indiċi jiġi kkalkulat għal żewġ pari ta’ tulijiet tal-mewġ: 340/380 nm u 354/388 nm.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn.](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-ultraviolet-aerosol-index)

### Cloud\n\nThe TROPOMI instrument, sin.msgid:
### Cloud

The TROPOMI instrument, single payload onboard Sentinel-5 Precursor, retrieves operationally the most important quantities for cloud correction of satellite trace gas retrievals: cloud fraction, cloud optical thickness (albedo), and cloud-top pressure (height). Cloud parameters from TROPOMI are not only used for enhancing the accuracy of trace gas retrievals, but also to extend the satellite data record of cloud information.

More info [here](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-cloud).
msgstr:
### Sħab (Cloud)

L-istrument TROPOMI, il-ħlas utli uniku abbord is-Sentinel-5 Precursor, jirkupra b’mod operazzjonali l-kwantitajiet l-aktar importanti għall-korrezzjoni tas-sħab tal-irkupri tal-gassijiet ta’ traċċa tas-satelliti: frazzjoni tas-sħab, ħxuna ottika tas-sħab (albedo), u pressjoni ta’ fuq is-sħab (għoli). Il-parametri tas-sħab mit-TROPOMI mhumiex użati biss biex itejbu l-preċiżjoni tal-irkupri tal-gassijiet ta’ traċċa, iżda wkoll biex jestendu r-rekord tad-data satellitari tal-informazzjoni dwar is-sħab.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/data-products/-/asset_publisher/fp37fc19FN8F/content/sentinel-5-precursor-level-2-cloud).

**Sentinel-3** mission's main objective.msgid:
**Sentinel-3** mission's main objective is to measure the sea surface topography, the sea and land surface temperature, and the colour of the ocean and land surface. To achieve this goal, Sentinel-3 has a combination of different instruments on board. The most important instruments are the Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (OLCI), the SAR Radar Altimeter (SRAL) and the Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer (SLSTR).

**Data availability:** Since May 2016 onwards.
msgstr:
L-għan ewlieni tal-missjoni **Sentinel-3** huwa li tkejjel it-topografija tal-wiċċ tal-baħar, it-temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-baħar u tal-art, u l-kulur tal-wiċċ tal-oċean u tal-art. Biex jintlaħaq dan l-għan, is-Sentinel-3 għandu taħlita ta’ strumenti differenti abbord. L-aktar strumenti importanti huma l-Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (OLCI), is-SAR Radar Altimeter (SRAL) u s-Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer (SLSTR).

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** Minn Mejju 2016 'l quddiem.

The **Sea and Land Surface Temperature (.msgid:
The **Sea and Land Surface Temperature (SLSTR)** instrument on board Sentinel-3 measures the global and regional sea and land surface 
temperature. The SLSTR covers the visible, shortwave infrared, and thermal infrared wavelengths of the electromagnetic spectrum. 

**Spatial resolution:** 500m for visible, near- and shortwave infrared wavelengths and 1km for thermal infrared (that is, only details 
bigger than 500m and 1km can be seen, respectively).

**Revisit time:** Maximum 1 day to revisit the same area, using both satellites.

**Data availability:** Since May 2016 onwards.

**Common usage:** Climate change monitoring, vegetation monitoring, active fire detection, land and sea surface temperature monitoring.
msgstr:
L-istrument **Sea and Land Surface Temperature (SLSTR)** abbord is-Sentinel-3 ikejjel it-temperatura globali u reġjonali tal-wiċċ tal-baħar u tal-art. L-SLSTR ikopri t-tulijiet tal-mewġ viżibbli, tal-infra-aħmar tal-mewġ qasir, u tal-infra-aħmar termali tal-ispettru elettromanjetiku. 

**Riżoluzzjoni spazjali:** 500m għat-tulijiet tal-mewġ viżibbli, tal-infra-aħmar qrib u tal-mewġ qasir u 1km għall-infra-aħmar termali (jiġifieri, jistgħu jidhru biss dettalji 
akbar minn 500m u 1km, rispettivament).

**Ħin ta’ rivżita:** Massimu ta’ jum 1 biex terġa’ tiġi mżurija l-istess żona, bl-użu taż-żewġ satelliti.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** Minn Mejju 2016 'l quddiem.

**Użu komuni:** Monitoraġġ tat-tibdil fil-klima, monitoraġġ tal-veġetazzjoni, detezzjoni tan-nar attiv, monitoraġġ tat-temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-art u tal-baħar.

The **Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (.msgid:
The **Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (OLCI)** on board Sentinel-3 is a spectrometer that 
measures the solar radiation reflected by Earth, and it monitors the ocean, the environment, 
and climate. It provides more frequent visible imagery than Sentinel-2 but at a lower resolution
and with more wavelengths covered. The Sentinel-3 OLCI instrument continues the measurements previously performed by the MERIS instrument on board Envisat, whose mission concluded.

**Spatial resolution:** 300m (that is, only details bigger than 300m can be seen).

**Revisit time:** Maximum 2 days to revisit the same area, using both satellites.

**Data availability:** Since May 2016 onwards.

**Common usage:** Surface topography, ocean and land surface colour observations and monitoring.
msgstr:
L-**Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (OLCI)** abbord is-Sentinel-3 huwa spettrometru li 
jkejjel ir-radjazzjoni solari rriflessa mid-Dinja, u jissorvelja l-oċean, l-ambjent, 
u l-klima. Jipprovdi immaġini viżibbli aktar frekwenti mis-Sentinel-2 iżda b’riżoluzzjoni aktar baxxa
u b’aktar tulijiet tal-mewġ koperti. L-istrument OLCI tas-Sentinel-3 ikompli l-kejl li qabel kien jitwettaq mill-istrument MERIS abbord l-Envisat, li l-missjoni tiegħu ntemmet.

**Riżoluzzjoni spazjali:** 300m (jiġifieri, jistgħu jidhru biss dettalji akbar minn 300m).

**Ħin ta’ rivżita:** Massimu ta’ jumejn biex terġa’ tiġi mżurija l-istess żona, bl-użu taż-żewġ satelliti.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** Minn Mejju 2016 'l quddiem.

**Użu komuni:** Topografija tal-wiċċ, osservazzjonijiet u monitoraġġ tal-kulur tal-wiċċ tal-oċean u tal-art.

**The Sentinel-3 SYNERGY** is a combinat.msgid:
**The Sentinel-3 SYNERGY** is a combination of the OLCI and SLSTR acquisitions with original objective to provide surface vegetation products. [The Level-2 SYN](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/synergy-products) product provides surface reflectances for all SYN channels and aerosol parameters over land.

**Spatial resolution**: 300 m  

**Temporal resolution**: < 2 days  

**Data availability**: Global since October 2018  

**Common usage**: Land Monitoring and Security, Climate Change Monitoring
msgstr:
**Is-Sentinel-3 SYNERGY** huwa taħlita ta’ akkwiżizzjonijiet tal-OLCI u tal-SLSTR bl-għan oriġinali li jipprovdi prodotti tal-veġetazzjoni tal-wiċċ. [Il-prodott Level-2 SYN](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/synergy-products) jipprovdi riflettanzi tal-wiċċ għall-kanali SYN kollha u parametri tal-aerosol fuq l-art.

**Riżoluzzjoni spazjali**: 300 m  

**Riżoluzzjoni temporali**: < jumejn  

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: Globali minn Ottubru 2018  

**Użu komuni**: Monitoraġġ u Sigurtà tal-Art, Monitoraġġ tat-Tibdil fil-Klima

**The Sentinel-3 SYNERGY** is a combinat.msgid:
**The Sentinel-3 SYNERGY** is a combination of the OLCI and SLSTR acquisitions with original objective to provide surface vegetation products. [The Level-2 VG1](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/synergy-products#SYNERGYProducts-L2VG1andV10ProductsS3-Synergy-Products-L2-VG1-and-V10-Products) product contains 1 km VEGETATION-like product, 1 day synthesis surface reflectances and NDVI.

**Spatial resolution**: 1 km

**Temporal resolution**: Daily

**Data availability**: Global since October 2018

**Common usage**: Land Monitoring and Security, Climate Change Monitoring
msgstr:
**Is-Sentinel-3 SYNERGY** huwa taħlita ta’ akkwiżizzjonijiet tal-OLCI u tal-SLSTR bl-għan oriġinali li jipprovdi prodotti tal-veġetazzjoni tal-wiċċ. [Il-prodott Level-2 VG1](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/synergy-products#SYNERGYProducts-L2VG1andV10ProductsS3-Synergy-Products-L2-VG1-and-V10-Products) fih prodott simili għal VEGETATION ta’ 1 km, riflettanzi tal-wiċċ ta’ sintesi ta’ jum 1 u NDVI.

**Riżoluzzjoni spazjali**: 1 km

**Riżoluzzjoni temporali**: Kuljum

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: Globali minn Ottubru 2018

**Użu komuni**: Monitoraġġ u Sigurtà tal-Art, Monitoraġġ tat-Tibdil fil-Klima

**The Sentinel-3 SYNERGY** is a combinat.msgid:
**The Sentinel-3 SYNERGY** is a combination of the OLCI and SLSTR acquisitions with original objective to provide surface vegetation products. [The Level-2 V10](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/synergy-products#SYNERGYProducts-L2VG1andV10ProductsS3-Synergy-Products-L2-VG1-and-V10-Products) product contains 1 km VEGETATION-like product, 10 day synthesis surface reflectances and NDVI.

**Spatial resolution**: 1 km

**Temporal resolution**: 10-days composite

**Data availability**: Global since October 2018

**Common usage**: Land Monitoring and Security, Climate Change Monitoring
msgstr:
**Is-Sentinel-3 SYNERGY** huwa taħlita ta’ akkwiżizzjonijiet tal-OLCI u tal-SLSTR bl-għan oriġinali li jipprovdi prodotti tal-veġetazzjoni tal-wiċċ. [Il-prodott Level-2 V10](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/synergy-products#SYNERGYProducts-L2VG1andV10ProductsS3-Synergy-Products-L2-VG1-and-V10-Products) fih prodott simili għal VEGETATION ta’ 1 km, riflettanzi tal-wiċċ ta’ sintesi ta’ 10 ijiem u NDVI.

**Riżoluzzjoni spazjali**: 1 km

**Riżoluzzjoni temporali**: Kompożitu ta’ 10 ijiem

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: Globali minn Ottubru 2018

**Użu komuni**: Monitoraġġ u Sigurtà tal-Art, Monitoraġġ tat-Tibdil fil-Klima

The **Sea and Land Surface Temperature (.msgid:
The **Sea and Land Surface Temperature (SLSTR)** instrument on board Sentinel-3 measures the global and regional sea and land surface temperature. The SLSTR L2 Land Surface Temperature (LST) product provides land surface temperature retrieved from the thermal infrared channels.

**Spatial resolution:** 1km (that is, only details bigger than 1km can be seen).

**Revisit time:** Maximum 1 day to revisit the same area, using both satellites.

**Data availability:** Since May 2018 onwards.

**Common usage:** Climate change monitoring, land surface temperature monitoring, drought monitoring, urban heat island studies.
msgstr:
L-istrument **Sea and Land Surface Temperature (SLSTR)** abbord is-Sentinel-3 ikejjel it-temperatura globali u reġjonali tal-wiċċ tal-baħar u tal-art. Il-prodott SLSTR L2 Land Surface Temperature (LST) jipprovdi t-temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-art miksuba mill-kanali infra-ħomor termali.

**Riżoluzzjoni spazjali:** 1km (jiġifieri, jistgħu jidhru biss dettalji akbar minn 1km).

**Ħin ta’ rivżita:** Massimu ta’ jum 1 biex terġa’ tiġi mżurija l-istess żona, bl-użu taż-żewġ satelliti.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** Minn Mejju 2018 'l quddiem.

**Użu komuni:** Monitoraġġ tat-tibdil fil-klima, monitoraġġ tat-temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-art, monitoraġġ tan-nixfa, studji tal-gżira tas-sħana urbana.

**Sentinel-2** provides high-resolution.msgid:
**Sentinel-2** provides high-resolution images in the visible and infrared wavelengths, to monitor vegetation, soil and water cover, inland waterways and coastal areas.

**Spatial resolution:** 10m, 20m, and 60m, depending on the wavelength (that is, only details bigger than 10m, 20m, and 60m can be seen). More info [here](https://sentinel.esa.int/web/sentinel/user-guides/sentinel-2-msi/resolutions/spatial). 

**Revisit time:** maximum 5 days to revisit the same area, using both satellites.

**Data availability:** Since June 2015. Full global coverage since March 2017.

**Common usage:** Land-cover maps, land-change detection maps, vegetation monitoring, monitoring of burnt areas.
msgstr:
**Sentinel-2** jipprovdi immaġini ta’ riżoluzzjoni għolja fit-tulijiet tal-mewġ viżibbli u tal-infra-aħmar, biex jissorvelja l-kopertura tal-veġetazzjoni, tal-ħamrija u tal-ilma, il-passaġġi tal-ilma interni u ż-żoni kostali.

**Riżoluzzjoni spazjali:** 10m, 20m, u 60m, skont it-tul tal-mewġ (jiġifieri, jistgħu jidhru biss dettalji akbar minn 10m, 20m, u 60m). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://sentinel.esa.int/web/sentinel/user-guides/sentinel-2-msi/resolutions/spatial). 

**Ħin ta’ rivżita:** massimu ta’ 5 ijiem biex terġa’ tiġi mżurija l-istess żona, bl-użu taż-żewġ satelliti.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** Minn Ġunju 2015. Kopertura globali sħiħa minn Marzu 2017.

**Użu komuni:** Mapep tal-kopertura tal-art, mapep tad-detezzjoni tal-bidliet fl-art, monitoraġġ tal-veġetazzjoni, monitoraġġ taż-żoni maħruqa.

Level 2A data are high quality data wher.msgid:
Level 2A data are high quality data where the effects of the atmosphere on the light being reflected off of the surface of the Earth and reaching the sensor are excluded. Data are available globally since March 2017.

More info about atmospheric correction [here](https://www.sentinel-hub.com/develop/api/ogc/custom-parameters/atmospheric-correction/).
msgstr:
Id-data tal-Livell 2A hija data ta’ kwalità għolja fejn l-effetti tal-atmosfera fuq id-dawl li jiġi rriflessa mill-wiċċ tad-Dinja u jilħaq is-sensur huma esklużi. Id-data hija disponibbli globalment minn Marzu 2017.

Iktar tagħrif dwar il-korrezzjoni atmosferika [hawn](https://www.sentinel-hub.com/develop/api/ogc/custom-parameters/atmospheric-correction/).

Level 1C data are data of sufficient qua.msgid: Level 1C data are data of sufficient quality for most investigations, where all image corrections were done except for the atmospheric correction. Data are available globally since June 2015 onwards.
msgstr: Id-data tal-Livell 1C hija data ta’ kwalità suffiċjenti għall-biċċa l-kbira tal-investigazzjonijiet, fejn saru l-korrezzjonijiet kollha tal-immaġni ħlief il-korrezzjoni atmosferika. Id-data hija disponibbli globalment minn Ġunju 2015 'l quddiem.

**Sentinel-1** provides all-weather, day.msgid:
**Sentinel-1** provides all-weather, day and night radar imagery for land and ocean services. EO
Browser provides data acquired in Interferometric Wide Swath (IW) and Extra Wide Swath (EW) modes
processed to Level-1 Ground Range Detected (GRD).

**Pixel spacing:** 10m (IW), 40m (EW).

**Revisit time:** <= 5 days using both satellites.

**Revisit time** (for asc/desc and overlap using both satellites): <= 3 days, see [observation scenario](https://sentinel.esa.int/web/sentinel/missions/sentinel-1/observation-scenario)

**Data availability:** Since October 2014.

**Common usage:** Maritime and land monitoring, emergency response, climate change.
msgstr:
**Sentinel-1** jipprovdi immaġini tar-radar fi kwalunkwe temp, bi nhar u bil-lejl, għas-servizzi tal-art u tal-oċean. L-EO
Browser jipprovdi data akkwistata fil-modalitajiet Interferometric Wide Swath (IW) u Extra Wide Swath (EW)
ipproċessata għal Level-1 Ground Range Detected (GRD).

**Spazjar tal-pikseli:** 10m (IW), 40m (EW).

**Ħin ta’ rivżita:** <= 5 ijiem bl-użu taż-żewġ satelliti.

**Ħin ta’ rivżita** (għal asc/desc u sovrapożizzjoni bl-użu taż-żewġ satelliti): <= 3 ijiem, ara [xenarju ta’ osservazzjoni](https://sentinel.esa.int/web/sentinel/missions/sentinel-1/observation-scenario)

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** Minn Ottubru 2014.

**Użu komuni:** Monitoraġġ marittimu u tal-art, rispons ta’ emerġenza, tibdil fil-klima.

The **Sentinel-1 DH Monthly Mosaics** is.msgid:
The **Sentinel-1 DH Monthly Mosaics** is a monthly composite obtained by computing the local resolution weighted average of radiometrically and geometrically terrain corrected input scenes. Due to the use of all available data in a month, it contains less speckle (temporal average) and the best possible local resolution (combination of ascending and descending orbits).

The input for the Sentinel-1 DH Monthly Mosaics are scenes with DH polarization and can come from all acquisition modes.

**Coverage:** Primarily polar and near-polar areas, as well as ocean-relevant areas

**Data availability:** ${ displayRange }

The data for each month is available in the catalog on the 1st day of the corresponding month (e.g. 1.1. or 1.2.).

**Spatial Resolution:** ~40 meters.
msgstr:
Il-**Mużajki Xahriċi Sentinel-1 DH** huma kompożitu xahri miksub billi jiġi kkalkulat il-medja lokali peżata skont ir-riżoluzzjoni tax-xeni ta’ input ikkorreġuti radjometrikament u ġeometrikament għat-terren. Minħabba l-użu tad-data kollha disponibbli f’xahar, fih inqas speckle (medja temporali) u l-aħjar riżoluzzjoni lokali possibbli (taħlita ta’ orbiti axxendenti u dixxendenti).

L-input għall-Mużajki Xahriċi Sentinel-1 DH huma xeni b’polarizzazzjoni DH u jistgħu jiġu minn kull modalità ta’ akkwiżizzjoni.

**Kopertura:** Primarjament żoni polari u kważi polari, kif ukoll żoni rilevanti għall-oċean

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** ${ displayRange }

Id-data għal kull xahar hija disponibbli fil-katalogu fl-1 jum tax-xahar korrispondenti (eż. 1.1. jew 1.2.).

**Riżoluzzjoni Spazjali:** ~40 metru.

The **Sentinel-1 IW Monthly Mosaics** is.msgid:
The **Sentinel-1 IW Monthly Mosaics** is a monthly composite obtained by computing the local resolution weighted average of radiometrically and geometrically terrain corrected input scenes. Due to the use of all available data in a month, it contains less speckle (temporal average) and the best possible local resolution (combination of ascending and descending orbits).

The input for the Sentinel-1 IW Monthly Mosaics are scenes taken in the IW acquisition mode with DV polarization.

**Coverage:** Over land and coastal areas (mainly between 80°N and 56°S)

**Data availability:** ${ displayRange }

The data for each month is available in the catalog on the 1st day of the corresponding month (e.g. 1.1. or 1.2.).

**Spatial Resolution:** ~20 meters.
msgstr:
Il-**Mużajki Xahriċi Sentinel-1 IW** huma kompożitu xahri miksub billi jiġi kkalkulat il-medja lokali peżata skont ir-riżoluzzjoni tax-xeni ta’ input ikkorreġuti radjometrikament u ġeometrikament għat-terren. Minħabba l-użu tad-data kollha disponibbli f’xahar, fih inqas speckle (medja temporali) u l-aħjar riżoluzzjoni lokali possibbli (taħlita ta’ orbiti axxendenti u dixxendenti).

L-input għall-Mużajki Xahriċi Sentinel-1 IW huma xeni meħuda fil-modalità ta’ akkwiżizzjoni IW b’polarizzazzjoni DV.

**Kopertura:** Fuq l-art u ż-żoni kostali (prinċipalment bejn 80°N u 56°S)

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** ${ displayRange }

Id-data għal kull xahar hija disponibbli fil-katalogu fl-1 jum tax-xahar korrispondenti (eż. 1.1. jew 1.2.).

**Riżoluzzjoni Spazjali:** ~20 metru.

The **WorldCover Annual Cloudless Mosaic.msgid:
The **WorldCover Annual Cloudless Mosaics** product offers an almost cloud-free image over the entire globe, created by stitching together the cloudless Sentinel-2 images acquired over a one-year period at a spatial resolution of 10 meters.

More information can be found [here](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data/SentinelMissions/Sentinel2.html#sentinel-2-level-2a-worldcover-annual-cloudless-mosaic-rgbnir).

**Coverage:** Global Coverage.

**Data availability:** ${ displayRange }

Data for each year is available in the catalog on the 1.1. of the corresponding year.

**Spatial Resolution:** 10 meters.

**Common usage:** Creating Basemaps, Land cover classification, Infrastructure/Land use planning, Environmental monitoring, Water resource management and more.
msgstr:
Il-prodott **WorldCover Annual Cloudless Mosaics** joffri immaġni kważi mingħajr sħab fuq id-dinja kollha, maħluqa billi jitwaħħlu flimkien l-immaġini Sentinel-2 mingħajr sħab miksuba matul perjodu ta’ sena b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 metri.

Tagħrif ieħor jinsab [hawn](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data/SentinelMissions/Sentinel2.html#sentinel-2-level-2a-worldcover-annual-cloudless-mosaic-rgbnir).

**Kopertura:** Kopertura Globali.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** ${ displayRange }

Id-data għal kull sena hija disponibbli fil-katalogu fl-1.1. tas-sena korrispondenti.

**Riżoluzzjoni Spazjali:** 10 metri.

**Użu komuni:** Ħolqien ta’ Mapep bażiċi, klassifikazzjoni tal-kopertura tal-art, ippjanar tal-infrastruttura/użu tal-art, monitoraġġ ambjentali, ġestjoni tar-riżorsi tal-ilma u aktar.

The **Sentinel-2 Quarterly Mosaics** pro.msgid:
The **Sentinel-2 Quarterly Mosaics** product offers an almost cloud-free image over the entire globe, created by stitching together the cloudless Sentinel-2 images acquired over a quarterly period (every 3 months) at a spatial resolution of 10 meters.

**Coverage:** Global Coverage.

**Data availability:** ${ displayRange }

Data for each quarter is available in the catalog on the 1st day of the corresponding quarter (e.g. 1.1. or 1.4.).

**Spatial Resolution:** 10 meters.

**Common usage:** Creating Basemaps, Land cover classification, Infrastructure/Land use planning, Environmental monitoring, Water resource management and more.
msgstr:
Il-prodott **Mużajki Kwartali Sentinel-2** joffri immaġni kważi mingħajr sħab fuq id-dinja kollha, maħluqa billi jitwaħħlu flimkien l-immaġini Sentinel-2 mingħajr sħab miksuba matul perjodu ta’ kwart (kull 3 xhur) b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 metri.

**Kopertura:** Kopertura Globali.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** ${ displayRange }

Id-data għal kull kwart hija disponibbli fil-katalogu fl-1 jum tal-kwart korrispondenti (eż. 1.1. jew 1.4.).

**Riżoluzzjoni Spazjali:** 10 metri.

**Użu komuni:** Ħolqien ta’ Mapep bażiċi, klassifikazzjoni tal-kopertura tal-art, ippjanar tal-infrastruttura/użu tal-art, monitoraġġ ambjentali, ġestjoni tar-riżorsi tal-ilma u aktar.

The **Landsat 8-9** collection contains.msgid:
The **Landsat 8-9** collection contains imagery from the two most recently launched Landsat satellites (Landsat 8 and Landsat 9, provided by NASA/USGS). Both carry the Operational Land Imager (OLI) and the Thermal Infrared Sensor (TIRS), with 9 optical and 2 thermal bands. These two sensors provide seasonal coverage of the global landmass.

**Spatial resolution:** 15 m for the panchromatic band and 30 m for the rest (the thermal bands are re-sampled from 100 m).

**Revisit time:** 16 days

**Data availability:** Since January 2021

**Common usage:** Vegetation monitoring, land use, land cover maps, change monitoring, etc.

**Level-1** data (from **Landsat Collection 2**) provides global top of the atmosphere reflectance and top of the atmosphere brightness temperature products. 
  
The data underwent several processing steps including geometric and radiometric improvements. 
  
More info about Level-1 data [here](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/APIs/SentinelHub/Data/Landsat8-9.html).
msgstr:
Il-kollezzjoni **Landsat 8-9** fiha immaġini miż-żewġ satelliti Landsat li tnedew l-aktar reċentement (Landsat 8 u Landsat 9, provduti min-NASA/USGS). It-tnejn iġorru l-Operational Land Imager (OLI) u t-Thermal Infrared Sensor (TIRS), b’9 bandi ottiċi u 2 bandi termali. Dawn iż-żewġ sensuri jipprovdu kopertura staġjonali tal-massa tal-art globali.

**Riżoluzzjoni spazjali:** 15 m għall-band pankromatika u 30 m għall-bqija (il-bandi termali jiġu ri-kampjunati minn 100 m).

**Ħin ta’ rivżita:** 16-il jum

**Disponibbiltà tad-data:** Minn Jannar 2021

**Użu komuni:** Monitoraġġ tal-veġetazzjoni, użu tal-art, mapep tal-kopertura tal-art, monitoraġġ tal-bidliet, eċċ.

Id-data tal-**Livell 1** (mill-**Landsat Collection 2**) tipprovdi prodotti globali ta’ riflettanza fil-quċċata tal-atmosfera u ta’ temperatura tal-luminożità fil-quċċata tal-atmosfera. 
  
Id-data għaddiet minn diversi passi tal-ipproċessar inklużi titjib ġeometriku u radjometriku. 
  
Iktar tagħrif dwar id-data tal-Livell 1 [hawn](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/APIs/SentinelHub/Data/Landsat8-9.html).

Global, cloud-free, and reconstructed hi.msgid: Global, cloud-free, and reconstructed historical Landsat spectral bands are provided at a spatial resolution of 30 meters and temporal resolution of bimonthly intervals from 1997 onwards. The dataset was generated using the GLAD Landsat ARD version 2 as the primary input for temporal aggregation and the imputation of missing values.
msgstr: Bandi spettrali storiċi tal-Landsat globali, mingħajr sħab u rikostruwiti huma provduti b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 30 metru u riżoluzzjoni temporali ta’ intervalli kull xahrejn mill-1997 'il quddiem. Is-sett tad-data ġie ġġenerat bl-użu tal-GLAD Landsat ARD verżjoni 2 bħala l-input primarju għall-aggregazzjoni temporali u l-imputazzjoni tal-valuri nieqsa.

A **DEM** (Digital Elevation Model) is a.msgid:
A **DEM** (Digital Elevation Model) is a digital representation of a terrain (usually Earth's surface). It is obtained by dividing the whole globe into grid cells, each holding a corresponding altitude value in meters. Depending on the gride cell size, a DEM can be more detailed (high resolution) or less detailed (low resolution). Sentinel Hub DEM data collections are static (independent of date) and globally available.

**Common usage:** Modelling water flows, orthorectification of Sentinel-1 imagery and engineering.
msgstr:
**DEM** (Digital Elevation Model - Mudell Diġitali tal-Elevazzjoni) huwa rappreżentazzjoni diġitali ta’ terren (ġeneralment il-wiċċ tad-Dinja). Jinkiseb billi d-dinja kollha tinqasam f’ċelloli tal-grilja, kull waħda li żżomm valur korrispondenti ta’ altitudni f’metri. Skont id-daqs taċ-ċellola tal-grilja, DEM jista’ jkun aktar dettaljat (riżoluzzjoni għolja) jew inqas dettaljat (riżoluzzjoni baxxa). Il-kollezzjonijiet tad-data DEM ta’ Sentinel Hub huma statiċi (indipendenti mid-data) u disponibbli globalment.

**Użu komuni:** Immudellar tal-flussi tal-ilma, ortorettifikazzjoni tal-immaġini Sentinel-1 u inġinerija.

The **Copernicus DEM** represents the su.msgid:
The **Copernicus DEM** represents the surface of the Earth including buildings, infrastructure and vegetation. Similar to the Mapzen DEM, it is based on a combination of different DEMs (basis [WorldDEMTM](https://www.geospatialworld.net/article/worlddemtm-new-standard-of-global-elevation-models/)). It is a static collection (independent of date) with global coverage.

**Spatial resolution:** 30 m infilled with 90 m (where 30 m tiles are not released).

Credits: [ESA](${ COPERNICUS_CREDITS_URL })
msgstr:
Il-**Copernicus DEM** jirrappreżenta l-wiċċ tad-Dinja inklużi bini, infrastruttura u veġetazzjoni. Simili għad-DEM Mapzen, huwa bbażat fuq taħlita ta’ DEMs differenti (bażi [WorldDEMTM](https://www.geospatialworld.net/article/worlddemtm-new-standard-of-global-elevation-models/)). Hija kollezzjoni statika (indipendenti mid-data) b’kopertura globali.

**Riżoluzzjoni spazjali:** 30 m mimlija b’90 m (fejn it-tiles ta’ 30 m ma ġewx rilaxxati).

Krediti: [ESA](${ COPERNICUS_CREDITS_URL })

Geographical information on land cover a.msgid: Geographical information on land cover and its changes, land use, ground motion, vegetation state, water cycle and earth surface energy variables for both Europe and the entire globe. Visit the [CLMS website](https://land.copernicus.eu/en) for more information.
msgstr: Informazzjoni ġeografika dwar il-kopertura tal-art u l-bidliet fiha, l-użu tal-art, il-moviment tal-art, l-istat tal-veġetazzjoni, iċ-ċiklu tal-ilma u l-varjabbli tal-enerġija tal-wiċċ tad-Dinja kemm għall-Ewropa kif ukoll għad-dinja kollha. Żur is-[sit web tas-CLMS](https://land.copernicus.eu/en) għal aktar tagħrif.

Provides at global level spatial informa.msgid: Provides at global level spatial information on different types (classes) of physical coverage of the Earth's surface, e.g. forests, grasslands, croplands, lakes, wetlands for the 2019 base year. The data are updated annually and are available for the 2015-2019 years. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/global-dynamic-land-cover).
msgstr: Jipprovdi fil-livell globali informazzjoni spazjali dwar tipi differenti (klassijiet) ta’ kopertura fiżika tal-wiċċ tad-Dinja, eż. foresti, mergħat, artijiet tal-għelejjel, lagi, artijiet mistagħdra għas-sena bażi 2019. Id-data tiġi aġġornata kull sena u hija disponibbli għas-snin 2015-2019. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/global-dynamic-land-cover).

Provides a statistical overview of the l.msgid: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature over each 10-day compositing period regardless of any specific hour and every geostationary sensor image pixel. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and covers the period from January 2017 to January 2021. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-thermal-condition-index-global-v1-0-5km).
msgstr: Jipprovdi ħarsa ġenerali statistika tat-temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-art fuq kull perjodu ta’ kompożizzjoni ta’ 10 ijiem irrispettivament minn kwalunkwe siegħa speċifika u kull pixel tal-immaġni tas-sensur ġeostazzjonarju. Id-data hija disponibbli fuq skala globali b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ madwar 5 km u tkopri l-perjodu minn Jannar 2017 sa Jannar 2021. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-thermal-condition-index-global-v1-0-5km).

Provides a statistical overview of the l.msgid: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature daily cycle for each 10-day compositing period and every geostationary sensor image pixel. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and covers the period from January 2017 to January 2021. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-daily-cycle-global-v1-0-5km).
msgstr: Jipprovdi ħarsa ġenerali statistika taċ-ċiklu ta’ kuljum tat-temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-art għal kull perjodu ta’ kompożizzjoni ta’ 10 ijiem u kull pixel tal-immaġni tas-sensur ġeostazzjonarju. Id-data hija disponibbli fuq skala globali b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ madwar 5 km u tkopri l-perjodu minn Jannar 2017 sa Jannar 2021. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-daily-cycle-global-v1-0-5km).

Provides hourly land surface temperature.msgid:
Provides hourly land surface temperature from geostationary sensors observations. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and covers the period from July 2010 to January 2021. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/hourly-land-surface-temperature-global-v1-0-5km). 

*Please note that under default settings, the dataset displayed for each day is the latest image available, which typically reflects the data captured up to midnight. To access data from a specific hour, use the "Date: time range" mode.
msgstr:
Jipprovdi t-temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-art kull siegħa minn osservazzjonijiet ta’ sensuri ġeostazzjonarji. Id-data hija disponibbli fuq skala globali b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ madwar 5 km u tkopri l-perjodu minn Lulju 2010 sa Jannar 2021. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/hourly-land-surface-temperature-global-v1-0-5km). 

*Jekk jogħġbok innota li fis-settings awtomatiċi, is-sett tad-data muri għal kull jum huwa l-aħħar immaġni disponibbli, li tipikament tirrifletti d-data miksuba sa nofsillejl. Biex taċċessa data minn siegħa speċifika, uża l-modalità "Data: firxa taż-żmien".

Quantifies the fraction of the solar rad.msgid: Quantifies the fraction of the solar radiation absorbed by live plants for photosynthesis. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km covering the period from 1999 to June 2020 from SPOT/VEGETATION and PROBA-V data. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v2-0-1km).
msgstr: Tikkwantifika l-frazzjoni tar-radjazzjoni solari assorbita minn pjanti ħajjin għall-fotosintesi. Stimi kull 10 ijiem huma disponibbli fuq skala globali b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ madwar 1 km li jkopru l-perjodu mill-1999 sa Ġunju 2020 minn data SPOT/VEGETATION u PROBA-V. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v2-0-1km).

Quantifies the fraction of the solar rad.msgid: Quantifies the fraction of the solar radiation absorbed by live plants for photosynthesis. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to June 2020 based upon PROBA-V data with version 1.0 and from July 2020 onwards based upon Sentinel-3/OLCI data with version 1.1. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v1-0-300m).
msgstr: Tikkwantifika l-frazzjoni tar-radjazzjoni solari assorbita minn pjanti ħajjin għall-fotosintesi. Stimi kull 10 ijiem huma disponibbli fi ħin qrib dak reali fuq skala globali b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ madwar 300 m minn Jannar 2014 sa Ġunju 2020 abbażi ta’ data PROBA-V bil-verżjoni 1.0 u minn Lulju 2020 'il quddiem abbażi ta’ data Sentinel-3/OLCI bil-verżjoni 1.1. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v1-0-300m).

Defined as half the total area of green.msgid: Defined as half the total area of green elements of the canopy per unit horizontal ground area. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km covering the period from 1999 to June 2020 from SPOT/VEGETATION and PROBA-V data. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/leaf-area-index-v2-0-1km).
msgstr: Definit bħala nofs iż-żona totali tal-elementi ħodor tal-kanupew għal kull unità ta’ żona orizzontali tal-art. Stimi kull 10 ijiem huma disponibbli fuq skala globali b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ madwar 1 km li jkopru l-perjodu mill-1999 sa Ġunju 2020 minn data SPOT/VEGETATION u PROBA-V. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/leaf-area-index-v2-0-1km).

Represents the overall growth rate or dr.msgid: Represents the overall growth rate or dry biomass increase of the vegetation and is directly related to ecosystem Net Primary Production (NPP), however with units customized for agro-statistical purposes (kg/ha/day). Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1km and with the temporal extent from 1999 to June 2020. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-1km).
msgstr: Jirrappreżenta r-rata ġenerali ta’ tkabbir jew iż-żieda fil-bijomassa niexfa tal-veġetazzjoni u huwa relatat direttament mal-Produzzjoni Primarja Netta (NPP) tal-ekosistema, iżda b’unitajiet personalizzati għal skopijiet agro-statistiċi (kg/ha/jum).
