Provides detailed land cover and land us.msgid: Provides detailed land cover and land use information for 59 thematic classes in selected Natura2000 and Emerald sites for the 2021 reference year. The dataset has a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.5 ha and a Minimum Mapping Width (MMW) of 10 m and is available as vector data. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/n2k).
msgstr: Jipprovdi informazzjoni dettaljata dwar il-kopertura tal-art u l-użu tal-art għal 59 klassi tematika f’siti magħżula tan-Natura2000 u tal-Emerald għas-sena ta’ referenza 2021. Is-sett tad-data għandu Unità Minima ta’ Mappjar (MMU) ta’ 0.5 ha u Wisa’ Minima ta’ Mappjar (MMW) ta’ 10 m u huwa disponibbli bħala data vettorjali. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/n2k).

Provides information about the overall g.msgid: Provides information about the overall growth rate, or net dry biomass increase, of the vegetation. It is equivalent to Net Primary Production (NPP) but expressed in kg of dry matter per hectare and per day. Every 10-days, estimates are available at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~300 m, from January 2014 to the present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-300m).
msgstr: Jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar ir-rata ġenerali ta’ tkabbir, jew iż-żieda netta fil-bijomassa niexfa, tal-veġetazzjoni. Huwa ekwivalenti għall-Produzzjoni Primarja Netta (NPP) iżda espress f’kg ta’ materja niexfa għal kull ettaru u kuljum. Kull 10 ijiem, stimi huma disponibbli fuq skala globali, b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ ~300 m, minn Jannar 2014 sal-preżent. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-300m).

Provides information about the total amo.msgid: Provides information about the total amount of carbon compounds produced by photosynthesis of plants in an ecosystem in a given period of time, expressed in gC/m²/day. Every 10-days, estimates are available at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~ 300 m, from January 2014 to the present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-primary-production-v2-0-300m).
msgstr: Jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar l-ammont totali ta’ komposti tal-karbonju prodotti mill-fotosintesi tal-pjanti f’ekosistema f’perjodu ta’ żmien partikolari, espress f’gC/m²/jum. Kull 10 ijiem, stimi huma disponibbli fuq skala globali, b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ ~ 300 m, minn Jannar 2014 sal-preżent. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-primary-production-v2-0-300m).

Provides information about the net amoun.msgid: Provides information about the net amount of biomass, or carbon, produced by plants per unit area and time, expressed in gC/m²/day. It is equal to the difference between the Gross Primary Production (GPP), i.e. the total amount of carbon produced through photosynthesis, and the amount of energy used for plant respiration. Every 10-days, estimates are available at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~ 300 m, from January 2014 to the present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/net-primary-production-v2-0-300m).
msgstr: Jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar l-ammont nett ta’ bijomassa, jew karbonju, prodott mill-pjanti għal kull unità ta’ żona u ħin, espress f’gC/m²/jum. Huwa ugwali għad-differenza bejn il-Produzzjoni Primarja Gross (GPP), jiġifieri l-ammont totali ta’ karbonju prodott permezz tal-fotosintesi, u l-ammont ta’ enerġija użata għan-nifs tal-pjanti. Kull 10 ijiem, stimi huma disponibbli fuq skala globali, b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ ~ 300 m, minn Jannar 2014 sal-preżent. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/net-primary-production-v2-0-300m).

Provides information about the total amo.msgid: Provides information about the total amount of dry matter produced by land plants per unit time through photosynthesis. It is equivalent to Gross Primary Production (GPP) but expressed in kg of dry matter per hectare and per day. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~ 300 m, from January 2014 to the present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-300m).
msgstr: Jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar l-ammont totali ta’ materja niexfa prodotta mill-pjanti tal-art għal kull unità ta’ ħin permezz tal-fotosintesi. Huwa ekwivalenti għall-Produzzjoni Primarja Gross (GPP) iżda espress f’kg ta’ materja niexfa għal kull ettaru u kuljum. Stimi kull 10 ijiem huma disponibbli fuq skala globali, b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ ~ 300 m, minn Jannar 2014 sal-preżent. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-300m).

The High Resolution Dominant Leaf Type (.msgid:
The High Resolution Dominant Leaf Type (DLT) raster product provides a basic land cover classification with 3 thematic classes (all non-tree covered areas, broadleaved and coniferous).

This dataset is provided annually starting with 2018 in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs)
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Dominant Leaf Type (DLT) jipprovdi klassifikazzjoni bażika tal-kopertura tal-art b’3 klassijiet tematiċi (iż-żoni kollha mhux miksija bis-siġar, weraq wiesa’ u koniferi).

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2018 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs)

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Fallow Land Presence (CPFLP) raster product provides the yearly fallow land classification indicating if arable land has been left fallow in the respective calendar year. This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries. High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Fallow Land Presence (CPFLP) jipprovdi l-klassifikazzjoni annwali tal-art mistrieħa li tindika jekk art tinħarat ħalliet mistrieħa fis-sena kalendarja rispettiva. Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38. Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Bare Soil After (CPBSA) raster product provides bare soil period (in days) after the harvest of the main annual crop. Note that the bare soil period cannot transcend the calendar year for which the product is generated.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Bare Soil After (CPBSA) jipprovdi l-perjodu ta’ ħamrija mikxufa (f’jiem) wara l-ħsad tal-għelejjel annwali ewlenin. Innota li l-perjodu ta’ ħamrija mikxufa ma jistax jaqbeż is-sena kalendarja li għaliha jiġi ġġenerat il-prodott.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Fallow Land Duration (CPFLD) raster product provides information on the duration of fallow land periods, expressed in days, over a five-year period.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

Note: each product covers a five-year window and is referenced by the end year of that window (e.g. the 2021 product covers the period 2017–2021).

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Fallow Land Duration (CPFLD) jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar it-tul tal-perjodi ta’ art mistrieħa, espress f’jiem, fuq perjodu ta’ ħames snin.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Nota: kull prodott ikopri tieqa ta’ ħames snin u huwa referut bis-sena tat-tmiem ta’ dik it-tieqa (eż. il-prodott tal-2021 ikopri l-perjodu 2017–2021).

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Bare Soil Before (CPBSB) raster product provides the bare soil period (in days) before the emergence of the main annual crop. Note that the bare soil period cannot transcend the calendar year for which the product is generated.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.


This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Bare Soil Before (CPBSB) jipprovdi l-perjodu ta’ ħamrija mikxufa (f’jiem) qabel it-tfaċċar tal-għelejjel annwali ewlenin. Innota li l-perjodu ta’ ħamrija mikxufa ma jistax jaqbeż is-sena kalendarja li għaliha jiġi ġġenerat il-prodott.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.


Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Dominant Leaf.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Dominant Leaf Type Change (DLTC) raster provides information on the change between two reference years, and consists of 5 thematic classes (new broadleaved cover / new coniferous cover / loss of broadleaved cover / loss of coniferous cover / unchanged areas with tree cover). This dataset covers two comparison periods, 2018-2021 and 2021-2024, with each product dated by the end year of its comparison period.

This dataset is provided in 20 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

The production of the high resolution forest layers was coordinated by the European Environment Agency (EEA) in the frame of the EU Copernicus programme.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Ir-raster High Resolution Layer Dominant Leaf Type Change (DLTC) jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar il-bidla bejn żewġ snin ta’ referenza, u jikkonsisti minn 5 klassijiet tematiċi (kopertura ġdida ta’ weraq wiesa’ / kopertura ġdida ta’ koniferi / telf ta’ kopertura ta’ weraq wiesa’ / telf ta’ kopertura ta’ koniferi / żoni mhux mibdula b’kopertura tas-siġar). Dan is-sett tad-data ikopri żewġ perjodi ta’ paragun, 2018-2021 u 2021-2024, b’kull prodott datat bis-sena tat-tmiem tal-perjodu ta’ paragun tiegħu.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata f’rasters ta’ 20 metru (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-produzzjoni tas-saffi tal-foresti ta’ riżoluzzjoni għolja ġiet ikkoordinata mill-Aġenzija Ewropea għall-Ambjent (EEA) fil-qafas tal-programm Copernicus tal-UE.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

The High Resolution Layer Crop Types (CT.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Crop Types (CTY) raster product provides high resolution crop type classification for 17 classes of both arable and permanent crops across the EEA38 extent. Using both Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2, the model is finetuned to first map the crop field boundaries, and then determine the main crop for each field.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Crop Types (CTY) jipprovdi klassifikazzjoni ta’ riżoluzzjoni għolja tat-tipi ta’ għelejjel għal 17-il klassi ta’ għelejjel li jinħartu u permanenti madwar l-estensjoni tal-EEA38. Bl-użu kemm tas-Sentinel-1 kif ukoll tas-Sentinel-2, il-mudell huwa rfinut biex l-ewwel jimmappja l-fruntieri tal-għelieqi, u mbagħad jiddetermina l-għalla ewlenija għal kull għalqa.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Duration (CPMCD) raster product provides the duration (in days) of the growing season for the main (annual) crop.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries. High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Duration (CPMCD) jipprovdi t-tul (f’jiem) tal-istaġun tat-tkabbir għall-għalla ewlenija (annwali).

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38. Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The Copernicus High Resolution Layer Tre.msgid:
The Copernicus High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Presence Change (TCPC) raster product provides information on the change between two reference years, and consists of 3 thematic classes (new tree cover / loss of tree cover / unchanged areas with tree cover). The class 255 = outside area is predefined by the 100m boundary layer and remains unchanged. This layer for previous reference year comparisons is called Tree Cover Change Mask (TCCM). This dataset covers two comparison periods, 2018-2021 and 2021-2024, with each product dated by the end year of its comparison period.

This dataset is provided in 20 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

The production of the high resolution forest layers was coordinated by the European Environment Agency (EEA) in the frame of the EU Copernicus programme. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster Copernicus High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Presence Change (TCPC) jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar il-bidla bejn żewġ snin ta’ referenza, u jikkonsisti minn 3 klassijiet tematiċi (kopertura ġdida tas-siġar / telf ta’ kopertura tas-siġar / żoni mhux mibdula b’kopertura tas-siġar). Il-klassi 255 = barra ż-żona hija ddefinita minn qabel mis-saff tal-fruntiera ta’ 100m u tibqa’ mhux mibdula. Dan is-saff għall-paraguni ta’ snin ta’ referenza preċedenti jissejjaħ Tree Cover Change Mask (TCCM). Dan is-sett tad-data ikopri żewġ perjodi ta’ paragun, 2018-2021 u 2021-2024, b’kull prodott datat bis-sena tat-tmiem tal-perjodu ta’ paragun tiegħu.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata f’rasters ta’ 20 metru (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-produzzjoni tas-saffi tal-foresti ta’ riżoluzzjoni għolja ġiet ikkoordinata mill-Aġenzija Ewropea għall-Ambjent (EEA) fil-qafas tal-programm Copernicus tal-UE. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

The High Resolution Layer Grassland Chan.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Grassland Change (GRAC) raster product at 20m resolution provides information on changes in grassland vegetation cover. The thematic classes indicate all non-grassland areas, grassland gain and grassland loss, unchanged grassland in both years and unverified grassland gain and loss areas. This dataset covers two comparison periods, 2018-2021 and 2021-2024, with each product dated by the end year of its comparison period.

This dataset is provided in 20 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Grassland Change (GRAC) b’riżoluzzjoni ta’ 20m jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar bidliet fil-kopertura tal-veġetazzjoni tal-mergħat. Il-klassijiet tematiċi jindikaw iż-żoni kollha li mhumiex mergħat, il-qligħ u t-telf ta’ mergħat, mergħat mhux mibdula fiż-żewġ snin u żoni ta’ qligħ u telf ta’ mergħat mhux verifikati. Dan is-sett tad-data ikopri żewġ perjodi ta’ paragun, 2018-2021 u 2021-2024, b’kull prodott datat bis-sena tat-tmiem tal-perjodu ta’ paragun tiegħu.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata f’rasters ta’ 20 metru (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Grasslands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

The High Resolution Layer Forest Type (F.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Forest Type (FTY) provides a forest classification with 3 thematic classes (all non-forest areas / broadleaved forest / coniferous forest) at 10m spatial resolution and with a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.5 ha. This raster layer is largely following the FAO (Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations) forest definition with tree covered areas in agricultural and urban context excluded using the respective Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL).

This dataset is provided on a 3-yearly frequency in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs)
msgstr:
L-High Resolution Layer Forest Type (FTY) jipprovdi klassifikazzjoni tal-foresti b’3 klassijiet tematiċi (iż-żoni kollha mhux foresti / foresta ta’ weraq wiesa’ / foresta ta’ koniferi) b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10m u b’Unità Minima ta’ Mappjar (MMU) ta’ 0.5 ha. Dan is-saff raster jimxi fil-biċċa l-kbira mad-definizzjoni tal-foresta tal-FAO (Organizzazzjoni tal-Ikel u l-Agrikoltura tan-Nazzjonijiet Uniti) b’żoni miksija bis-siġar f’kuntest agrikolu u urban esklużi bl-użu tas-Saff ta’ Appoġġ Addizzjonali tal-Foresti (FADSL) rispettiv.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata b’frekwenza ta’ kull 3 snin f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs)

The High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA) raster product provides a binary status layer of grassland/non-grassland mask. This grassy and non-woody vegetation baseline product includes all kinds of grasslands: managed grassland, semi-natural grassland and natural grassy vegetation. It does not include temporary grasslands, which are masked out using the corresponding Ploughing indicator (PLOUGH), indicating on the number of years since a pixel was last ploughed.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA) jipprovdi saff binarju ta’ status ta’ maskra ta’ mergħat/mhux mergħat. Dan il-prodott bażi tal-veġetazzjoni ħaxixa u mhux injuża jinkludi kull tip ta’ mergħat: mergħat ġestiti, mergħat semi-naturali u veġetazzjoni naturali ħaxixa. Ma jinkludix mergħat temporanji, li jiġu mmaskrati bl-użu tal-indikatur korrispondenti tal-Ħrit (PLOUGH), li jindika n-numru ta’ snin minn meta pixel inħarat l-aħħar darba.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Grasslands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

The High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Den.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Density (TCD) dataset provides information on the proportional crown coverage per pixel at 10 meter spatial resolution and ranges from 0% (all non-tree covered areas) to 100%, whereby Tree Cover Density is defined as the "vertical projection of tree crowns to a horizontal earth’s surface".

This dataset is provided annually starting with 2018 in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs).
msgstr:
Is-sett tad-data High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Density (TCD) jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar il-kopertura proporzjonali tal-kuruni għal kull pixel b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 metri u jvarja minn 0% (iż-żoni kollha mhux miksija bis-siġar) sa 100%, fejn id-Densità tal-Kopertura tas-Siġar hija ddefinita bħala l-"projezzjoni vertikali tal-kuruni tas-siġar fuq wiċċ orizzontali tad-dinja".

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2018 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs).

The High Resolution Layer Ploughing indi.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Ploughing indicator (PLOUGH) raster product continues the 2015 and 2018 PLOUGH Layer following a rolling archive principle by adding current information and removing historic years. It indicates the number of years since the last indication of ploughing within the permanent grassland area. PLOUGH is derived by taking into account the series of binary HER layers, the BVL classifications and HR VPP PPI (Plant Phenology Index) quantiles. BVL classes 4 (crop) and 7 (overlaying layer between herbaceous and crop) indicate a ploughing event. Low HR VPP PPI quantiles indicate low vegetation at a certain time of the year. For years with missing information (2016 and earlier) the ploughing information from the historic PLOUGH product is considered which causes some issues.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Ploughing indicator (PLOUGH) ikompli s-Saff PLOUGH tal-2015 u tal-2018 wara prinċipju ta’ arkivju li jduru billi jżid informazzjoni kurrenti u jneħħi snin storiċi. Jindika n-numru ta’ snin mill-aħħar indikazzjoni ta’ ħrit fiż-żona tal-mergħat permanenti. Il-PLOUGH huwa derivat billi jitqiesu s-serje ta’ saffi binarji HER, il-klassifikazzjonijiet BVL u l-kwantili HR VPP PPI (Plant Phenology Index). Il-klassijiet BVL 4 (għalla) u 7 (saff li jgħatti bejn ħaxix u għalla) jindikaw avveniment ta’ ħrit. Kwantili baxxi tal-HR VPP PPI jindikaw veġetazzjoni baxxa f’ħin partikolari tas-sena. Għal snin b’informazzjoni nieqsa (2016 u qabel) titqies l-informazzjoni dwar il-ħrit mill-prodott PLOUGH storiku, li jikkawża xi problemi.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Grasslands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 i.msgid: Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 is a 10 m high resolution raster layer containing height information generated for selected cities and urban areas as part of the Urban atlas suite of products. Height information is based on satellite information and derived datasets like the digital surface model, the digital terrain model and the normalized digital surface model (DSM). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/urban-atlas).
msgstr: Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 huwa saff raster ta’ riżoluzzjoni għolja ta’ 10 m li fih informazzjoni dwar l-għoli iġġenerata għal bliet u żoni urbani magħżula bħala parti mis-serje ta’ prodotti Urban atlas. L-informazzjoni dwar l-għoli hija bbażata fuq informazzjoni satellitari u settijiet tad-data derivati bħall-mudell diġitali tal-wiċċ, il-mudell diġitali tat-terren u l-mudell diġitali tal-wiċċ normalizzat (DSM). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/urban-atlas).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Secondary Crop Type (CPSCT) raster product indicates if a cover crop was present within the respective calendar year and further segregates the types of cover crop into: short summer, long summer, short winter and long winter cover crop.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Secondary Crop Type (CPSCT) jindika jekk kinitx preżenti għalla ta’ kopertura fis-sena kalendarja rispettiva u jissegregaha aktar skont it-tipi ta’ għalla ta’ kopertura: għalla ta’ kopertura qasira tas-sajf, twila tas-sajf, qasira tax-xitwa u twila tax-xitwa.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowi.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowing Dates (GRAMD) raster product provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a basic land cover classification, flagging and mapping the start date (DOY) (GRAMD) within the detected Herbaceous cover layer (temporal and permanent grassland)) with a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.25 ha. The GRAMD product will flag and map the dates (Day of Year) of each mowing event on temporary or permanent grassland per year, resulting in a product split in four different rasters per year.

This dataset is provided annually starting with 2017 in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowing Dates (GRAMD) jipprovdi fil-livell pan-Ewropew b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m klassifikazzjoni bażika tal-kopertura tal-art, li timmarka u timmappja d-data tal-bidu (DOY) (GRAMD) fis-saff ta’ kopertura Ħaxixa misjub (mergħat temporanji u permanenti)) b’Unità Minima ta’ Mappjar (MMU) ta’ 0.25 ha. Il-prodott GRAMD se jimmarka u jimmappja d-dati (Jum tas-Sena) ta’ kull avveniment ta’ ħsad tal-ħaxix fuq mergħat temporanji jew permanenti kull sena, li jirriżulta f’prodott maqsum f’erba’ rasters differenti kull sena.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Grasslands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Cropping Seasons Types (CPCSY) raster product provides the number of different crop types grown in a 3-year period [0-3] (excluding cover crops).

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Cropping Seasons Types (CPCSY) jipprovdi n-numru ta’ tipi differenti ta’ għelejjel imkabbra fi perjodu ta’ 3 snin [0-3] (esklużi l-għelejjel ta’ kopertura).

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

The High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowi.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowing Events (GRAME) raster product provides a basic land cover classification containing respectively the number of grassland mowing events within the detected Herbaceous cover layer (temporal and permanent grassland) with a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.25 ha. The GRAME product will flag and map the number of mowing events (1, 2, 3, or 4+) on temporary or permanent grassland detected per year.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowing Events (GRAME) jipprovdi klassifikazzjoni bażika tal-kopertura tal-art li fiha rispettivament in-numru ta’ avvenimenti ta’ ħsad tal-ħaxix fis-saff ta’ kopertura Ħaxixa misjub (mergħat temporanji u permanenti) b’Unità Minima ta’ Mappjar (MMU) ta’ 0.25 ha. Il-prodott GRAME se jimmarka u jimmappja n-numru ta’ avvenimenti ta’ ħsad tal-ħaxix (1, 2, 3, jew 4+) fuq mergħat temporanji jew permanenti misjuba kull sena.

The High Resolution Layer Herbaceous cov.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Herbaceous cover (HER) raster product provides a basic land cover classification with 2 thematic classes (temporal and permanent herbaceous / non-herbaceous). The production of the herbaceous layer is primarily based on the probability estimates obtained from the Base Vegetation Layer (BVL) which also serves to harmonize the different vegetated HRL products (Grasslands, Tree Cover and Forests, Croplands). HER is further used as input for the Grassland status layer (GRA) extracting the permanent herbaceous in combination with the Ploughing indicator (PLOUGH).

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Herbaceous cover (HER) jipprovdi klassifikazzjoni bażika tal-kopertura tal-art b’2 klassijiet tematiċi (ħaxix temporanju u permanenti / mhux ħaxix). Il-produzzjoni tas-saff ħaxix hija bbażata primarjament fuq l-istimi ta’ probabbiltà miksuba mill-Base Vegetation Layer (BVL) li jservi wkoll biex jarmonizza l-prodotti HRL differenti tal-veġetazzjoni (Grasslands, Tree Cover and Forests, Croplands). L-HER jintuża aktar bħala input għas-saff tal-istatus tal-mergħat (GRA) li jiġbed il-ħaxix permanenti flimkien mal-indikatur tal-Ħrit (PLOUGH).

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Secondary Crop Emergence (CPSCE) raster product provides the date of emergence of the cover crop in days of the year (DOY). YYDOY where YY = last 2 digits of the year (e.g. 19 for 2019) and DOY is the day of the year (1-365)

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Secondary Crop Emergence (CPSCE) jipprovdi d-data tat-tfaċċar tal-għalla ta’ kopertura f’jiem tas-sena (DOY). YYDOY fejn YY = l-aħħar 2 ċifri tas-sena (eż. 19 għall-2019) u DOY huwa l-jum tas-sena (1-365)

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Forest Additio.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL) provides information on trees under agricultural use or in urban context to be excluded from the Forest Type (FTY) product and at 10m spatial resolution. The derivation of Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL) is based on the spatial intersection of the 10m DLT and TCD layers with CORINE Land Cover (CLC) 2018 and HRL Imperviousness Degree 2018 with 10 m spatial resolution; TCD range of 10-100%; with a MMW of 10m and no MMU (pixel base).
This dataset is provided on a 3-yearly frequency in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.
High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.
This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Is-High Resolution Layer Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL) jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar siġar taħt użu agrikolu jew f’kuntest urban li għandhom jiġu esklużi mill-prodott Forest Type (FTY) u b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10m. Id-derivazzjoni tas-Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL) hija bbażata fuq l-intersezzjoni spazjali tas-saffi DLT u TCD ta’ 10m ma’ CORINE Land Cover (CLC) 2018 u HRL Imperviousness Degree 2018 b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 10 m; firxa TCD ta’ 10-100%; b’MMW ta’ 10m u mingħajr MMU (bażi tal-pixel).
Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata b’frekwenza ta’ kull 3 snin f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.
Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea.
Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Secondary Crop Duration (CPSCD) raster product provides the duration (in days) of the cover crop season (can exceed the calendar year).

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Secondary Crop Duration (CPSCD) jipprovdi t-tul (f’jiem) tal-istaġun tal-għalla ta’ kopertura (jista’ jaqbeż is-sena kalendarja).

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The Cloud Classification (CC) product pr.msgid:
The Cloud Classification (CC) product provides information on the extent of clouds and cloud shadows derived from optical satellite data acquired by the **Sentinel-2** constellation. Cloud detection is performed at a **120m** spatial resolution using the [MAJA software](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

It is generated in near real-time at European scale, with a pixel spacing of 20 m x 20 m. It used to produce the CLMS High-Resolution Water, Snow and Ice datasets (HR-WSI), which rely on Sentinel-2 imagery.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. No product is generated for a Sentinel-2 tile when cloud cover exceeds 90%.

More information in the products documentation [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/fractional-snow-cover).
msgstr:
Il-prodott Cloud Classification (CC) jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar l-estensjoni tas-sħab u tad-dellijiet tas-sħab derivata minn data satellitari ottika miksuba mill-kostellazzjoni **Sentinel-2**. Id-detezzjoni tas-sħab titwettaq b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **120m** bl-użu tas-[software MAJA](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

Jiġi ġġenerat fi ħin qrib dak reali fuq skala Ewropea, b’ispazjar tal-pikseli ta’ 20 m x 20 m. Intuża biex jiġu prodotti s-settijiet tad-data CLMS High-Resolution Water, Snow and Ice (HR-WSI), li jiddependu fuq immaġini Sentinel-2.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent. L-ebda prodott ma jiġi ġġenerat għal tile Sentinel-2 meta l-kopertura tas-sħab taqbeż id-90%.

Iktar tagħrif fid-dokumentazzjoni tal-prodotti [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/fractional-snow-cover).

The **Fractional Snow Cover (FSC)** prod.msgid:
The **Fractional Snow Cover (FSC)** product provides the fraction of the surface covered by snow at the top of canopy (FSC-TOC) and on ground (FSC-OG) per pixel as a percentage (0% – 100%). Cloud detection in the Sentinel-2 imagery is performed using the [MAJA software](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

It is generated in near real-time at European scale based on optical satellite data from the **Sentinel-2** constellation, with a spatial resolution of **20 m x 20 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. No product is generated for a Sentinel-2 tile when cloud cover exceeds 90%.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/fractional-snow-cover).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **Fractional Snow Cover (FSC)** jipprovdi l-frazzjoni tal-wiċċ miksi bil-borra fil-quċċata tal-kanupew (FSC-TOC) u fuq l-art (FSC-OG) għal kull pixel bħala perċentwal (0% – 100%). Id-detezzjoni tas-sħab fl-immaġini Sentinel-2 titwettaq bl-użu tas-[software MAJA](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

Jiġi ġġenerat fi ħin qrib dak reali fuq skala Ewropea abbażi ta’ data satellitari ottika mill-kostellazzjoni **Sentinel-2**, b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **20 m x 20 m**.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent. L-ebda prodott ma jiġi ġġenerat għal tile Sentinel-2 meta l-kopertura tas-sħab taqbeż id-90%.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/fractional-snow-cover).

The **SAR Wet Snow (SWS)** product provi.msgid:
The **SAR Wet Snow (SWS)** product provides the wet snow extent for high mountain areas, based on C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar satellite data from the **Sentinel-1** constellation.

It is generated in near real-time for selected high mountain areas at European scale with a spatial resolution of **60 m x 60 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-sar-wet-snow).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **SAR Wet Snow (SWS)** jipprovdi l-estensjoni tal-borra mxarrba għal żoni ta’ muntanji għoljin, abbażi ta’ data satellitari Synthetic Aperture Radar tal-banda C mill-kostellazzjoni **Sentinel-1**.

Jiġi ġġenerat fi ħin qrib dak reali għal żoni magħżula ta’ muntanji għoljin fuq skala Ewropea b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **60 m x 60 m**.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-sar-wet-snow).

The **Wet / Dry Snow (WDS)** product pro.msgid:
The **Wet / Dry Snow (WDS)** product provides information on the snow state (wet or dry) by combining **Sentinel-1** radar-based wet snow maps within the snow cover extent derived from **Sentinel-2** optical data. Cloud detection in the Sentinel-2 imagery is performed using the [MAJA software](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

It is generated in near real-time at European scale, with a spatial resolution of **60 m x 60 m** in areas where Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observation tracks overlap.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. No product is generated for a Sentinel-2 tile when cloud cover exceeds 90%.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-wet-dry-snow).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **Wet / Dry Snow (WDS)** jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar l-istat tal-borra (imxarrba jew xotta) billi jgħaqqad mapep tal-borra mxarrba bbażati fuq ir-radar tas-**Sentinel-1** fi ħdan l-estensjoni tal-kopertura tal-borra derivata minn data ottika tas-**Sentinel-2**. Id-detezzjoni tas-sħab fl-immaġini Sentinel-2 titwettaq bl-użu tas-[software MAJA](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

Jiġi ġġenerat fi ħin qrib dak reali fuq skala Ewropea, b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **60 m x 60 m** f’żoni fejn it-traċċi ta’ osservazzjoni tas-Sentinel-1 u tas-Sentinel-2 jikkoinċidu.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent. L-ebda prodott ma jiġi ġġenerat għal tile Sentinel-2 meta l-kopertura tas-sħab taqbeż id-90%.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-wet-dry-snow).

The daily cumulative **Gap-filled Fracti.msgid:
The daily cumulative **Gap-filled Fractional Snow Cover (GFSC)** product provides pixel-wise snow cover extent as a percentage (0% – 100%). It is based on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data from the **Sentinel-1** constellation and optical imagery from the **Sentinel-2** constellation. The product is generated by merging all available Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations acquired over the previous **seven days** to produce a spatially complete composite of snow conditions, thereby reducing data gaps caused by cloud cover and sensor coverage limitations. Snow information derived from Sentinel-1 is focused on the detection of wet snow in high-mountain areas.

It is generated on a daily basis at European scale, with a spatial resolution of **60 m x 60 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-gap-filled-fractional-snow-cover).
msgstr:
Il-prodott kumulattiv ta’ kuljum **Gap-filled Fractional Snow Cover (GFSC)** jipprovdi l-estensjoni tal-kopertura tal-borra pixel b’pixel bħala perċentwal (0% – 100%). Huwa bbażat fuq data tas-synthetic aperture radar (SAR) mill-kostellazzjoni **Sentinel-1** u immaġini ottiċi mill-kostellazzjoni **Sentinel-2**. Il-prodott jiġi ġġenerat billi jingħaqdu l-osservazzjonijiet kollha disponibbli tas-Sentinel-1 u tas-Sentinel-2 miksuba matul **is-seba’ jiem** preċedenti biex jipproduċi kompożitu spazjalment sħiħ tal-kundizzjonijiet tal-borra, u b’hekk inaqqas il-lakuni fid-data kkawżati mill-kopertura tas-sħab u mil-limitazzjonijiet tal-kopertura tas-sensuri. L-informazzjoni dwar il-borra derivata mis-Sentinel-1 hija ffukata fuq id-detezzjoni tal-borra mxarrba f’żoni ta’ muntanji għoljin.

Jiġi ġġenerat kuljum fuq skala Ewropea, b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **60 m x 60 m**.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-gap-filled-fractional-snow-cover).

The Sentinel-2 **Snow Phenology (SP S2)*.msgid:
The Sentinel-2 **Snow Phenology (SP S2)** product characterizes the timing and duration of the snow season. For each pixel and for a given hydrological year, it provides the number of days with snow cover, as well as the first and last day of the longest continuous snow period. The hydrological year starts on 1 September.

The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **20 m x 20 m**, consistent with the input snow cover maps derived from optical satellite data acquired by the Sentinel-2 constellation (Fractional Snow Cover - FSC).

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. The data can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-snow-phenology).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **Snow Phenology (SP S2)** tas-Sentinel-2 jikkaratterizza ż-żmien u t-tul tal-istaġun tal-borra. Għal kull pixel u għal sena idroloġika partikolari, jipprovdi n-numru ta’ jiem b’kopertura tal-borra, kif ukoll l-ewwel u l-aħħar jum tal-itwal perjodu kontinwu tal-borra. Is-sena idroloġika tibda fl-1 ta’ Settembru.

Il-prodott jiġi ġġenerat fuq skala Ewropea b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **20 m x 20 m**, konsistenti mal-mapep tal-input tal-kopertura tal-borra derivati minn data satellitari ottika miksuba mill-kostellazzjoni Sentinel-2 (Fractional Snow Cover - FSC).

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent. Id-data tista’ titniżżel f’diversi projezzjonijiet u spazjar tal-pikseli.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-snow-phenology).

The Sentinel-1 & Sentinel-2 **Snow Pheno.msgid:
The Sentinel-1 & Sentinel-2 **Snow Phenology (SP S1+S2)** product characterizes the timing and duration of the snow season. For each pixel and for a given hydrological year, it provides the number of days with snow cover, as well as the first and last day of the longest continuous snow period. The hydrological year starts on 1 September.

The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **60 m x 60 m**, consistent with the input snow cover maps derived from optical satellite data acquired by the Sentinel-2 constellation and from C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar satellite data acquired by the Sentinel-1 constellation (Gap-filled Fractional Snow Cover - GFSC).

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. The data can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-snow-phenology).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **Snow Phenology (SP S1+S2)** tas-Sentinel-1 u tas-Sentinel-2 jikkaratterizza ż-żmien u t-tul tal-istaġun tal-borra. Għal kull pixel u għal sena idroloġika partikolari, jipprovdi n-numru ta’ jiem b’kopertura tal-borra, kif ukoll l-ewwel u l-aħħar jum tal-itwal perjodu kontinwu tal-borra. Is-sena idroloġika tibda fl-1 ta’ Settembru.

Il-prodott jiġi ġġenerat fuq skala Ewropea b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **60 m x 60 m**, konsistenti mal-mapep tal-input tal-kopertura tal-borra derivati minn data satellitari ottika miksuba mill-kostellazzjoni Sentinel-2 u minn data satellitari Synthetic Aperture Radar tal-banda C miksuba mill-kostellazzjoni Sentinel-1 (Gap-filled Fractional Snow Cover - GFSC).

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent. Id-data tista’ titniżżel f’diversi projezzjonijiet u spazjar tal-pikseli.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-snow-phenology).

The **Water Cover Duration (WCD)** produ.msgid:
The **Water Cover Duration (WCD)** product estimates the number of days land is covered by water. For each pixel and for a given hydrological year, it indicates how frequently water is present. The hydrological year starts on 1 September. It is based on water masks derived from **Sentinel-1** radar and **Sentinel-2** optical data, combined with Water/Ice Cover data from Sentinel-2 (WIC S2).

The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **10 m x 10 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. The data can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-water-cover-duration).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **Water Cover Duration (WCD)** jistma n-numru ta’ jiem li fihom l-art tkun miksija bl-ilma. Għal kull pixel u għal sena idroloġika partikolari, jindika kemm-il darba jkun preżenti l-ilma. Is-sena idroloġika tibda fl-1 ta’ Settembru. Huwa bbażat fuq maskri tal-ilma derivati mir-radar tas-**Sentinel-1** u minn data ottika tas-**Sentinel-2**, magħquda ma’ data Water/Ice Cover mis-Sentinel-2 (WIC S2).

Il-prodott jiġi ġġenerat fuq skala Ewropea b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **10 m x 10 m**.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent. Id-data tista’ titniżżel f’diversi projezzjonijiet u spazjar tal-pikseli.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-water-cover-duration).

The **Ice Cover Duration (ICD)** product.msgid:
The **Ice Cover Duration (ICD)** product describes how long inland waters are covered by ice. For each pixel and for a given hydrological year, it provides the number of days with ice cover. The hydrological year starts on 1 September. It is based on ice cover maps derived from **Sentinel-2** optical data (Water/Ice Cover WIC S2) and **Sentinel-1** C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar data (Water/Ice Cover WIC S1).

The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **20 m x 20 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. The data can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-ice-cover-duration).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **Ice Cover Duration (ICD)** jiddeskrivi kemm idum l-ilma intern miksi bis-silġ. Għal kull pixel u għal sena idroloġika partikolari, jipprovdi n-numru ta’ jiem b’kopertura tas-silġ. Is-sena idroloġika tibda fl-1 ta’ Settembru. Huwa bbażat fuq mapep tal-kopertura tas-silġ derivati minn data ottika tas-**Sentinel-2** (Water/Ice Cover WIC S2) u data Synthetic Aperture Radar tal-banda C tas-**Sentinel-1** (Water/Ice Cover WIC S1).

Il-prodott jiġi ġġenerat fuq skala Ewropea b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **20 m x 20 m**.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent. Id-data tista’ titniżżel f’diversi projezzjonijiet u spazjar tal-pikseli.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-ice-cover-duration).

The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1.msgid:
The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1 (WICS1)** product provides information about river and lake areas covered by snow-covered or snow-free ice. It is based on synthetic aperture radar data from the **Sentinel-1** constellation.

It is generated in near real-time at European scale, with a spatial resolution of **60 m x 60 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1 (WICS1)** jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar żoni ta’ xmajjar u lagi miksija bi silġ miksi bil-borra jew mingħajr borra. Huwa bbażat fuq data tas-synthetic aperture radar mill-kostellazzjoni **Sentinel-1**.

Jiġi ġġenerat fi ħin qrib dak reali fuq skala Ewropea, b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **60 m x 60 m**.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).

The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-2.msgid:
The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-2 (WICS2)** product provides the water and ice extent over land. A water mask is used to differentiate between snow on ice-covered water areas and snow on land. Cloud detection in the Sentinel-2 imagery is performed using the [MAJA software](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

It is generated in near real-time at European scale based on optical satellite data from the Sentinel-2 constellation, with a spatial resolution of **20 m x 20 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. No product is generated for a Sentinel-2 tile when cloud cover exceeds 90%.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-2 (WICS2)** jipprovdi l-estensjoni tal-ilma u tas-silġ fuq l-art. Tintuża maskra tal-ilma biex issir distinzjoni bejn il-borra fuq żoni tal-ilma miksija bis-silġ u l-borra fuq l-art. Id-detezzjoni tas-sħab fl-immaġini Sentinel-2 titwettaq bl-użu tas-[software MAJA](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

Jiġi ġġenerat fi ħin qrib dak reali fuq skala Ewropea abbażi ta’ data satellitari ottika mill-kostellazzjoni Sentinel-2, b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **20 m x 20 m**.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent. L-ebda prodott ma jiġi ġġenerat għal tile Sentinel-2 meta l-kopertura tas-sħab taqbeż id-90%.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).

The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1.msgid:
The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 (WIC S1+S2)** product shows which river and lake areas are covered by ice, with or without snow. It combines data from two types of instruments acquired on the same day to increase coverage and reduce missing information. It uses water/ice cover information derived from **Sentinel-2** optical images (WIC S2), and from **Sentinel-1** radar data (WIC S1).

The product is generated in near real-time at European scale, with a spatial resolution of **20 m x 20 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 (WIC S1+S2)** juri liema żoni ta’ xmajjar u lagi huma miksija bis-silġ, bil-borra jew mingħajrha. Jgħaqqad data minn żewġ tipi ta’ strumenti miksuba fl-istess jum biex iżid il-kopertura u jnaqqas l-informazzjoni nieqsa. Juża informazzjoni dwar il-kopertura tal-ilma/tas-silġ derivata minn immaġini ottiċi tas-**Sentinel-2** (WIC S2), u minn data tar-radar tas-**Sentinel-1** (WIC S1).

Il-prodott jiġi ġġenerat fi ħin qrib dak reali fuq skala Ewropea, b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **20 m x 20 m**.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: mill-2016 sal-preżent.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).

The High Resolution Layer Broadleaved De.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Broadleaved Density (BCD) dataset provides information on the percentage of broadleaved pixels at 100m spatial resolution, and is derived through aggregation of the 10m DLT for the respective reference year. Within each cell the number of broadleaved pixels are counted and the percentages stored into in the 100m pixel of the BCD. The class 255 = outside area is predefined by the 100m boundary layer and remains unchanged.

This dataset is provided annually starting with 2018 in 100 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Is-sett tad-data High Resolution Layer Broadleaved Density (BCD) jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar il-perċentwal ta’ pikseli ta’ weraq wiesa’ b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 100m, u huwa derivat permezz tal-aggregazzjoni tad-DLT ta’ 10m għas-sena ta’ referenza rispettiva. Fi ħdan kull ċellola jinqatgħu n-numru ta’ pikseli ta’ weraq wiesa’ u l-perċentwali jinħażnu fil-pixel ta’ 100m tal-BCD. Il-klassi 255 = barra ż-żona hija ddefinita minn qabel mis-saff tal-fruntiera ta’ 100m u tibqa’ mhux mibdula.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2018 f’rasters ta’ 100 metru (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

The High Resolution Layer Forest Type (F.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Forest Type (FTY) dataset provides the Forest Type estimation at 100 meter spatial resolution. The number of broadleaved and coniferous pixels are counted and the percentages stored in the 100m cell. The class 255 = outside area is predefined by the 100m boundary layer and remains unchanged.

This dataset is provided on a 3-yearly frequency in 100 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Is-sett tad-data High Resolution Layer Forest Type (FTY) jipprovdi l-istima tat-Tip ta’ Foresta b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 100 metru. In-numru ta’ pikseli ta’ weraq wiesa’ u ta’ koniferi jinqatgħu u l-perċentwali jinħażnu fiċ-ċellola ta’ 100m. Il-klassi 255 = barra ż-żona hija ddefinita minn qabel mis-saff tal-fruntiera ta’ 100m u tibqa’ mhux mibdula.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata b’frekwenza ta’ kull 3 snin f’rasters ta’ 100 metru (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

The High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA) raster product provides a binary status layer of grassland/non-grassland mask. This grassy and non-woody vegetation baseline product includes all kinds of grasslands: managed grassland, semi-natural grassland and natural grassy vegetation. It does not include temporary grasslands, which are masked out using the corresponding Ploughing indicator (PLOUGH), indicating on the number of years since a pixel was last ploughed. In the 100 meter raster product, the number of Grassland pixels are counted and the percentages stored in each 100 meter cell. The class 255 = outside area is predefined by the 100m boundary layer and remains unchanged.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 100 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA) jipprovdi saff binarju ta’ status ta’ maskra ta’ mergħat/mhux mergħat. Dan il-prodott bażi tal-veġetazzjoni ħaxixa u mhux injuża jinkludi kull tip ta’ mergħat: mergħat ġestiti, mergħat semi-naturali u veġetazzjoni naturali ħaxixa. Ma jinkludix mergħat temporanji, li jiġu mmaskrati bl-użu tal-indikatur korrispondenti tal-Ħrit (PLOUGH), li jindika n-numru ta’ snin minn meta pixel inħarat l-aħħar darba. Fil-prodott raster ta’ 100 metru, jinqatgħu n-numru ta’ pikseli ta’ Mergħat u l-perċentwali jinħażnu f’kull ċellola ta’ 100 metru. Il-klassi 255 = barra ż-żona hija ddefinita minn qabel mis-saff tal-fruntiera ta’ 100m u tibqa’ mhux mibdula.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 100 metru (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Grasslands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

The High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Den.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Density (TCD) dataset provides information on the proportional crown coverage per pixel at 100 meter spatial resolution and ranges from 0% (all non-tree covered areas) to 100%, whereby Tree Cover Density is defined as the "vertical projection of tree crowns to a horizontal earth's surface". This product is an aggregation of its corresponding high resolution dataset.

This dataset is provided annually starting with 2018 in 100 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Is-sett tad-data High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Density (TCD) jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar il-kopertura proporzjonali tal-kuruni għal kull pixel b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 100 metru u jvarja minn 0% (iż-żoni kollha mhux miksija bis-siġar) sa 100%, fejn id-Densità tal-Kopertura tas-Siġar hija ddefinita bħala l-"projezzjoni vertikali tal-kuruni tas-siġar fuq wiċċ orizzontali tad-dinja". Dan il-prodott huwa aggregazzjoni tas-sett tad-data korrispondenti ta’ riżoluzzjoni għolja tiegħu.

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2018 f’rasters ta’ 100 metru (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Emergence (CPMCE) raster product provides the emergence date of the main (annual) crop expressed in DOY (day of year). YYDOY where YY = last 2 digits of the year (e.g. 19 for 2019) and DOY is the day of the year (1-365).

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Emergence (CPMCE) jipprovdi d-data tat-tfaċċar tal-għalla ewlenija (annwali) espressa f’DOY (jum tas-sena). YYDOY fejn YY = l-aħħar 2 ċifri tas-sena (eż. 19 għall-2019) u DOY huwa l-jum tas-sena (1-365).

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Harvest (CPMCH) raster product provides the harvest date of the main (annual) crop expressed in days of the year (DOY). The harvest is considered as the time of removal of most of the biomass. YYDOY where YY = last 2 digits of the year (e.g. 19 for 2019) and DOY is the day of the year (1-365).

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Il-prodott raster High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Harvest (CPMCH) jipprovdi d-data tal-ħsad tal-għalla ewlenija (annwali) espressa f’jiem tas-sena (DOY). Il-ħsad jitqies bħala l-mument tat-tneħħija ta’ bijomassa kbira. YYDOY fejn YY = l-aħħar 2 ċifri tas-sena (eż. 19 għall-2019) u DOY huwa l-jum tas-sena (1-365).

Dan is-sett tad-data jingħata kull sena mill-2017 f’rasters ta’ 10 metri (konformi bis-sħiħ mal-grilja ta’ referenza tal-EEA) f’tiles ta’ 100 x 100 km li jkopru l-pajjiżi tal-EEA38.

Il-prodott High Resolution Layer Croplands huwa parti mill-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service tal-Unjoni Ewropea. Saff ta’ kunfidenza disponibbli għas-sett tad-data.

Dan is-sett tad-data jinkludi data mit-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej (DOMs). Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

This metadata refers to the CORINE Land.msgid: This metadata refers to the CORINE Land Cover Plus Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry Instance (CLCplus LULUCF Instance), an annually updated, pan-European, spatially consistent and seamless geospatial proxy for land use reporting under the LULUCF regulation. The product is delivered as a single raster layer with a spatial resolution of 100 m, derived from multiple pan-European Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) high resolution input datasets. The LULUCF Instance is available for the reference years 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, with production moving to an annual update cycle starting from the 2021 product. Each raster cell represents a dominant LULUCF land-use class, assigned according to thematic and spatial rulesets implemented during the extraction process. While each pixel corresponds primarily to one of the six main LULUCF land use categories - forest land, grassland, cropland, settlements, wetlands, and other lands - the dataset further differentiates these categories into sub classes, resulting in a total of 27 classes. This classification structure supports greenhouse gas reporting and other applications within the LULUCF sector by providing a harmonised and policy relevant representation of land use across Europe. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/clcplus-lulucf-instance).
msgstr: Dan il-metadata jirreferi għall-CORINE Land Cover Plus Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry Instance (CLCplus LULUCF Instance), proxy ġeospazjali pan-Ewropew, spazjalment konsistenti u bla ħjata, aġġornat kull sena għar-rappurtar tal-użu tal-art taħt ir-regolament LULUCF. Il-prodott jitwassal bħala saff raster wieħed b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ 100 m, derivat minn diversi settijiet tad-data ta’ input ta’ riżoluzzjoni għolja pan-Ewropej tal-Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS). L-Istanza LULUCF hija disponibbli għas-snin ta’ referenza 2018, 2021, 2022 u 2023, bil-produzzjoni tgħaddi għal ċiklu ta’ aġġornament annwali mill-prodott tal-2021. Kull ċellola raster tirrappreżenta klassi dominanti ta’ użu tal-art LULUCF, assenjata skont settijiet ta’ regoli tematiċi u spazjali implimentati matul il-proċess ta’ estrazzjoni. Filwaqt li kull pixel jikkorrispondi primarjament għal waħda mis-sitt kategoriji ewlenin tal-użu tal-art LULUCF - art tal-foresti, mergħat, artijiet tal-għelejjel, insedjamenti, artijiet mistagħdra, u artijiet oħra - is-sett tad-data jiddifferenzja aktar dawn il-kategoriji f’sottoklassijiet, li jirriżultaw f’total ta’ 27 klassi. Din l-istruttura ta’ klassifikazzjoni tappoġġja r-rappurtar tal-gassijiet b’effett ta’ serra u applikazzjonijiet oħra fis-settur LULUCF billi tipprovdi rappreżentazzjoni armonizzata u rilevanti għall-politika tal-użu tal-art madwar l-Ewropa. Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/clcplus-lulucf-instance).

The **High Resolution Water Layer (HRWL).msgid:
The **High Resolution Water Layer (HRWL)** product provides classified maps showing permanent water, temporary water, dry areas, and sea water. It is a multi-annual product, typically covering a **7-year period**, and is updated every 3 years. It is based on the annual Water Cover Duration (WCD) production, which combines water masks from **Sentinel-1** radar and **Sentinel-2** optical imagery with Water/Ice Cover data from Sentinel-2 (WIC S2).

The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **10 m × 10 m**.

**Data availability**: HRWL is available for the reference years 2021 and 2024, covering the periods **01/09/2016**–31/12/2021 and **01/09/2018**–31/12/2024, respectively. The dataset can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-water-layer).
msgstr:
Il-prodott **High Resolution Water Layer (HRWL)** jipprovdi mapep klassifikati li jindikaw ilma permanenti, ilma temporanju, żoni xotti, u ilma tal-baħar. Huwa prodott multi-annwali, li tipikament ikopri **perjodu ta’ 7 snin**, u jiġi aġġornat kull 3 snin. Huwa bbażat fuq il-produzzjoni annwali tal-Water Cover Duration (WCD), li tgħaqqad maskri tal-ilma mir-radar tas-**Sentinel-1** u mill-immaġini ottiċi tas-**Sentinel-2** ma’ data Water/Ice Cover mis-Sentinel-2 (WIC S2).

Il-prodott jiġi ġġenerat fuq skala Ewropea b’riżoluzzjoni spazjali ta’ **10 m × 10 m**.

**Disponibbiltà tad-data**: L-HRWL huwa disponibbli għas-snin ta’ referenza 2021 u 2024, li jkopru l-perjodi **01/09/2016**–31/12/2021 u **01/09/2018**–31/12/2024, rispettivament. Is-sett tad-data jista’ jitniżżel f’diversi projezzjonijiet u spazjar tal-pikseli.

Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-water-layer).

This dataset comprises one cloud-free Ve.msgid:

the French Overseas Departments of French Guiana, Martinique, Guadeloupe, Mayotte and Réunion but excluding French Overseas Territories for a total coverage 
of ~ 6 million square kilometres. The area of interest is extended by a 4 km buffer over the sea and a 500 m buffer over countries bordering the EEA-39 states.

The collection holds Level-2 Land Surfac.msgid:
The collection holds Level-2 Land Surface Temperature (LST) products from OroraTech’s
FOREST satellites, at 200 m ground sampling distance, over selected European pilot sites.
Each product is a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF giving the land surface temperature, in Kelvin.
Daytime and night-time acquisitions from complementary orbits make the collection suited to
studying the daily temperature cycle, urban heat islands, drought and surface water stress.
msgstr:
Il-kollezzjoni fiha prodotti tat-Temperatura tal-Wiċċ tal-Art (LST) tal-Livell 2 mis-satelliti FOREST ta’ OroraTech,
b’distanza ta’ kampjunar tal-art ta’ 200 m, fuq siti pilota Ewropej magħżula.
Kull prodott huwa Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF li jagħti t-temperatura tal-wiċċ tal-art, f’Kelvin.
L-akkwiżizzjonijiet tan-nhar u tal-lejl minn orbiti kumplimentari jagħmlu l-kollezzjoni adattata għall-
istudju taċ-ċiklu ta’ kuljum tat-temperatura, gżejjer tas-sħana urbana, nixfa u stress tal-ilma tal-wiċċ.

This mosaic dataset, directly processed and delivered by the data provider, comprises one cloud-free Very High Resolution optical coverage of 39 European States (EEA-39) including all islands of those countries plus
the French Overseas Departments of French Guiana, Martinique, Guadeloupe, Mayotte and Réunion but excluding French Overseas Territories. The area of
interest (~6 million square kilometres) is extended by a 4 km buffer over the sea and a 500 m buffer over countries bordering the EEA-39 states.
More info [here](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/optical-vhr-coverage-over-europe-vhrimage2024).

Dipartimenti Frangiżi extra-Ewropej tal-Guyana Franċiża, Martinique, Guadeloupe, Mayotte u Réunion iżda esklużi t-Territorji Frangiżi extra-Ewropej. Iż-żona ta’
interess (~6 miljun kilometru kwadru) hija estiża b’buffer ta’ 4 km fuq il-baħar u buffer ta’ 500 m fuq pajjiżi li jmissu mal-istati tal-EEA-39.
Iktar tagħrif [hawn](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/optical-vhr-coverage-over-europe-vhrimage2024).

The Tagged Image File Format (TIFF) can.msgid:
The Tagged Image File Format (TIFF) can hold a large number of bands, however many common image viewers (e.g. Windows Photo Viewer) can't display TIFF images with more than 3 bands.
If this option is enabled, only the first 3 bands will be included in the image.
If this option is disabled, all bands will be included in the image, but you will have to use an application which supports more than 3 bands (e.g. QGIS) to display the TIFF image.
msgstr:
It-Tagged Image File Format (TIFF) jista’ jżomm numru kbir ta’ bandi, iżda ħafna viewers komuni tal-immaġini (eż. Windows Photo Viewer) ma jistgħux juru immaġini TIFF b’aktar minn 3 bandi.
Jekk din l-għażla tkun attivata, l-ewwel 3 bandi biss se jiġu inklużi fl-immaġni.
Jekk din l-għażla tkun diżattivata, il-bandi kollha se jiġu inklużi fl-immaġni, iżda trid tuża applikazzjoni li tappoġġja aktar minn 3 bandi (eż. QGIS) biex turi l-immaġni TIFF.
